12.en: "You may see the trees shaking violently by the pleasant breeze, inhabited by proud birds, drunken honeybees and crowded with cuckoos and other birds (Rama said to Lakshmana)."
12.hi: ध्य देखो, मतवाले पदी बच्चों पर बैठे हैं, मधुपान के भूखे भोरे गँजते हुए फूलों में घुसे बैठे हैं। कोकिलाओं के कुंड के शुड बैठे हैं । देखो, केली सुखावह हवा वह रही है, जो बार बार बक्षों को हिला रही है

13.sa: इति दाशरथीरमो लक्ष्मणम् समभाषत ।बलम् च तत्र विभजच्चास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥६-२४-१३॥।।
13.en: Dasaratha's son Rama thus talked to Lakshmana in that manner and asked to divide the task of the army in accordance with what is said in sastras.

14.sa: शशास कपिसेमाम् ताम् बलादादाय वीर्यवान् ।अङ्गदः सह नीलेन तिष्ठे दुरपि दुर्जयः ॥६-२४-१४॥।।
14.en: Let the valiant Angada who is difficult to win over, who is a terror to the enemies, take the army along with Nila and remain at the centre (of the army structure).
14.hi: हो 6 शशास कपिसेनाया बलभादाय वीयवान्‌ । n 258 2 0 आङ्गद्‌ः सह नीलेन तिष्डेदुरसि दुजंयः

15.sa: तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्या वानरौघसमावृतः ।आशिर्तो दक्षिणम् पार्श्वमृषभो नाम वानरः ॥६-२४-१५॥।।
15.en: Let Rshaba the bull among Vanaras approach the south side of the army accompanied by his troop of Vanara contingent and remain there.
15.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने कहा ) इस वानरसेना की दाहिनी ओर कपिश्रेष्ठ छपभ अपनी अधीनस्थ सेना के साथ रहें

16.sa: गन्धहस्तीव दुर्धर्षस्तरस्वी गन्धमादनः ।तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्याः सव्यम् पक्षमधिष्ठतः ॥६-२४-१६॥।।
16.en: "Let the mighty Gandhamadana, a difficult one to conquer like a proud elephant, take the battalion of army and stay on the right side"

17.sa: मूर्ध्नि स्थास्याम्यहम् यत्तो लक्ष्मणेन समन्वितः ।जाम्बवाम्श्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः ॥६-२४-१७॥।।
17.en: "I and Lakshmana will be alert at the head side. Let Jambavan Sushena and the three chiefs of Bears who are strong and quick at sighting remain protecting the belly of the army."

18.sa: ऋक्षमुख्या महात्मानः कुक्षिम् रक्षन्तु ते त्रयः ।जघनम् कपिसेनायाः कपिराजोऽभिरक्षतु ॥६-२४-१८॥।।
18.en: "Just as Pracheta who is covered by brilliance, rules the western side of the world, let the king of Vanaras protect the hips and loin portion of the Vanara army."

19.sa: पश्चार्धमिव लोकस्य प्रचेतास्तेजपा वृतः ।सुविभक्तमहाव्यूहा महावानररक्षिता ॥६-२४-१९॥।।
19.en: The Vanara army force organized that way to protect the Vanaras, shone like the mass of clouds in heaven.

20.sa: अनीकिनी सा विबभौ यथाद्यौः साभ्रसम्प्लवा ।प्रऋह्य गिरिशृङ्गाणि महतश्च महीरुहान् ॥६-२४-२०॥।।
20.en: Vanaras resolved to go taking peaks of mountains and huge trees to smash Lanka in war.
20.hi: उस समय वह वानरी सेना ऐसी शोभित हुई, जैसे आकाश भेघों से शोभित होता है । वानरगण गिरिश्वङ्गों और बड़े बडे वर्षां को ले

21.sa: आसेदुर्वानरा लङ्काम् मिमर्दयुषवो रणे ।शिखरैर्विकिरामैनाम् लङ्काम् मुष्टिभिरेव वा ॥६-२४-२१॥।।
21.en: Thus resolved the Vanara leaders in their mind to crush Lanka with its mountain peaks into powder with their bare fists, indeed.
21.hi: लङ्का को ध्वस्त करने के लिए चढ़ाई करने की आज्ञा की प्रतीक्षा करने लगे वे सब श्रपने अपने मनों में सोचने लग कि, पर्वेतशिखरों अथवा घंसों से हम लङ्का को पीस डालेंगे । तब श्रीरामचन्द्र ने सुग्रीव से कहा

22.sa: इति स्म दधिरे सर्वे मानाम्सि हरिपुङ्गवाः ।ततो रामो महातेजाः सुग्रीव मिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-२४-२२॥।।
22.en: Having heard Sugriva, there after splendid Rama spoke thus. "The army is divided (placed in position). Suka may be relieved."

23.sa: सुविभक्तानि सैन्यानि शुक एष विमुच्यताम् ।रामस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः ॥६-२४-२३॥।।
23.en: Having heard Rama's words Sugriva, the mighty king of Vanaras was happy and relieved the envoy on the instruction of Rama.
23.hi: मित्र ! सेना तो यथास्थान टिक गई । अब शुक को छोड़ देना चाहिये । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का यह वचन सुन, महाबली कपिराज सुग्रीव ने

24.sa: मोचयामास तम् दूतम् शुकम् रामस्य शासनात् ।मोचितो रामवाक्येन वानरैश्च निपीडितः ॥६-२४-२४॥।।
24.en: Relieved by the word of Rama, tormented Suka who was highly terrified returned to the king of Rakshasas.
24.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की आज्ञा से रावण के उस दूत शुक को छोड़ दिया । श्रीराम की आज्ञा से दटा हुआ ओर वानरों द्वारा सताया हुआ

25.sa: शुकः परमसम्त्रस्तो रक्षोधिपमुपागमत् ।रावणः प्रहसन्नेव शुकम् वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥६-२४-२५॥।।
25.en: Laughing at Suka, Ravana spoke these words. "Why are your wings fastened? Your wings have been clipped, it appears!. I suppose you have not fallen under the clutches of the fickle minded Vanaras!"
25.hi: शुक अत्यन्त डरा हुआ रावण के पास पहुंचा । रावण ने शुक को देख, मुसकुराते हुए पूछा

26.sa: किमिमौ ते सितौ पक्षौ लूनपक्ष्श्च दृश्यसे ।कच्चिन्नानेकचित्तानाम् तेषाम् त्वम् वशमागतः ॥६-२४-२६॥।।
26.en: Laughing at Suka, Ravana spoke these words. "Why are your wings fastened? Your wings have been clipped, it appears!. I suppose you have not fallen under the clutches of the fickle minded Vanaras!"
26.hi: हे शुक ! तुम्हारे ये सफेद पंख नांचे खसोटे क्यों देख पड़ते हैं। तुम कहीं उन चञ्चलमना बानरों के फदे भें तो नहीं फंस गये

27.sa: ततस्प भयसम्विग्न स्तदा राज्ञाभिचोदितः ।वचनम् प्रत्युवाचेदम् राक्षसाधिपमुत्तमम् ॥६-२४-२७॥।।
27.en: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."
27.hi: युद्धकाण्डे वह भयभीत झु, राक्षतराज छार पूछा जाकर, रावण को इस प्रकार उत्तर देता हुआ

28.sa: सागरस्योत्तरे तीरेऽब्रवम् ते वचनम् तथा ।यथासम्देशमक्लिष्टम् सान्त्वयन् श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥६-२४-२८॥।।
28.en: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."

29.sa: क्रुद्धैस्तेरहमुत्प्लुत्य दृष्टमात्रः प्लवङ्गमैः ।गृहितोऽस्म्यपि चारब्धो हन्तुम् लोप्तुम् च मुष्टिभिः ॥६-२४-२९॥।।
29.en: As soon as they saw me, the enraged Vanaras rising up (into the sky) took hold of me and started injuring me and slaying me.

30.sa: न ते सम्भाषितुम् शक्याः सम्प्रश्नोऽत्र न विद्यते ।प्रकृत्या कोपनास्तीक्षिणा वानरा राक्षसाधिप ॥६-२४-३०॥।।
30.en: "O king of Rakshasas! It was not possible to negotiate there with the Vanaras). I had no opportunity to interrogate with them. By nature, Vanaras are violent and are highly furious."

31.sa: स च हन्ता विराधस्य कबन्धस्य खरस्य च ।सुग्रीवसहितो रामः सीतायाः पदमागतः ॥६-२४-३१॥।।
31.en: "The life of Viradha, Kabhanda and Khara has been taken away by Rama. Accompanied by Sugriva they have set their foot into Lanka for Sita's sake."
31.hi: तत्पश्चान्‌ मैंने विराध, कबन्ध और खर को मारने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को देखा, जो सुश्री व के साथ सीता के रने के स्थान का पता पा कर, यहाँ आये हैं

32.sa: स कृत्वा सागरे सेतुम् तीर्त्वा च लवणोदधिम् ।एष रक्षासि निर्धूय धन्वी तिष्ठति राघवः ॥६-२४-३२॥।।
32.en: "Mighty Raghava having crossed the salt sea and reached the shore of Rakshasas, organized them (Vanaras) and stood wielding a bow."
32.hi: समुद्र का पुल बाँच, लवशसागर को पार कर और राक्षसा को तिन के के समान जान; हाथ में धनुष लिये हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र ज्ञी आ पहुँचे हैं

33.sa: ऋक्षवानरसम्घानामनीकानि सहस्रशः ।गिरिमेघनिकाशानाम् चादयन्ति वसुन्धराम् ॥६-२४-३३॥।।
33.en: "Thousands of army forces of monkeys and Bears resembling mountains and clouds have settled on the ground."
33.hi: उनके साथ में बड़े बड़े रीछों और बानरों की हजारों सेनाएँ हैं । वे रीछ और वानर पर्वत अथवा मेघ की तरह विशालकाय हैं और उनकी संख्या इतनी अधिक है कि, वे पुथिवी को ढाँपे हुए हैं

34.sa: राक्षसानाम् बलौघस्य वानरेन्द्रबलस्य च ।नैतयोर्विद्यते सम्धिर्देवदानवयोरिव ॥६-२४-३४॥।।
34.en: Alliance is not possible between Rakshasas and army of Bears and Vanaras, just as alliance is not possible between gods and demons.

35.sa: पुरा प्राकारमायान्ति क्षिप्रमेकतरम् कुरु ।सीताम् वास्मै प्रयच्चाशु युद्धम् वापि प्रदीयताम् ॥६-२४-३५॥।।
35.en: "They will reach the boundary wall. At once you may do one of the two that I suggest you do. I implore you either to give away Sita or give good battle."
35.hi: वे लङ्का पर चढ़ाई करना ही चाहते हैं, अतएव आप अति शीघ्र इन दो में से एक कास कीजिए तो आप तुरन्त सीता को दे दें या सलीभाँति कमर कस व उनसे लड

36.sa: शुकस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्य मब्रवीत् ।रोषसम्रक्तनयनो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ॥६-२४-३६॥।।
36.en: Angry, redeyed Ravana, having heard Suka's words spoke as though he would burn him with his glance.
36.hi: शुक की इन बातों को सुन, रावण कहने लगा । उस समय मारेक्रोध के उसकी आँखें लाल हो रही थींओर ऐसा जान पड़ता था कि मानों वह नेत्राग्नि से शुक को भरम कर डालेगा

37.sa: यदि माम् प्रतियुध्येरन् देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।नैव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्वलोकभयादपि ॥६-२४-३७॥।।
37.en: "Even if gods, Gandharvas and demons come to wage war with me, even if all the worlds threaten me, I shall not give away Sita."

38.sa: कदा समभिधानन्ति मामका राघवम् शराः ।वसन्ते पुष्पितम् मत्ता भ्रमरा इव पादपम् ॥६-२४-३८॥।।
38.en: "Just as drunken bees reach the trees with blossoms in spring when will my arrows attack Rama?"

39.sa: कदा शोणितदिग्धाङ्गम् दीपैः कार्मुकविच्युतैः ।शरैरादीपयिष्यामि उल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम् ॥६-२४-३९॥।।
39.en: "When will the glowing arrows from my quiver, that are fit to pierce in thousands, be able to goad Rama like the burning fire sticks goad the elephants?"

40.sa: तच्चास्य बलमादास्ये बलेन महता वृतः ।ज्योतिषामिव सर्वेषाम् प्रभामुद्यन्दिवाकरः ॥६-२४-४०॥।।
40.en: "Just as the rising Sun light obscures the radiance of all (other stars) when will I obscure him surrounded by his army?"

41.sa: सागरस्येव मे वेगो मारुतस्येव मे बलम् ।न च दाशरथिर्वेद तेन माम् योद्धुमिच्चति ॥६-२४-४१॥।।
41.en: "I have the speed of the ocean and swiftness like the WindGod. Rama does not know this and desires to wage war with me."
41.hi: सागर की तरह मेरा वेग छै और पत्रन की तरह सेरी गति है. । यह बात श्रीराम नहीं जानता, इसीसे तो बह मुझसे लड़ना चाहता है

42.sa: न मे तूणीशयान् बाणान् सनिषानिव पन्नगान् ।रामः पश्यति सम्ग्रामे तेन माम् योद्धुमिच्चति ॥६-२४-४२॥।।
42.en: "Rama has not seen the poisonous arrows in my quiver in battle. Therefore, he is desiring comb at with me."
42.hi: तरकस में, विषधर सांपों की तरह पड़े हुए मेरे विषेले बाण, श्रीराम को नहीं देख पडते, इसीसे वह मेरे साथ लड़ना चाहता है

43.sa: न जानाति पुरा वीर्यम् मम युद्धे स राघवः ।मम चापमयीम् वीणाम् शरकोणैः प्रवादिताम् ॥६-२४-४३॥।।
43.en: "He has not known my valour in war. Entering the enemy's army holding my formidable Veena, making challenging sounds with the sharp heads of arrows, causing tumultuous noise like the sound of cry of destitute and frightened ones with iron arrows, I will play the Veena of my bow in hand."
43.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र ने मेरे साथ पहिले कभी युद्ध नहीं गे । इसीसे वह मेरा बल पराक्रम नहीं जानता । जिस समय शत्रु की सेनारूपी नदी में डुबकी लगा, पनी चॉपसयी बीणा, MR कल १ कोणैः--वीणाबादनदणडैः ( गो० ) २१० युद्धकारडे तीररूप गज से वजञाऊँगा और जब रोदे की टङ्कार . होगी तथा a घायलों और भयभीत हुए सैनिकों का हाहाकार सुन पड़ेगा और तीरों की सनसनाहट सुन पड़ेगी

44.sa: ज्याशबदतुमुलाम् घोरामार्तगीतमहास्वनाम् ।नाराचतलसम्नादाम् ताम् ममाहितवाहिनीम् ॥६-२४-४४॥।।
44.en: "He has not known my valour in war. Entering the enemy's army holding my formidable Veena, making challenging sounds with the sharp heads of arrows, causing tumultuous noise like the sound of cry of destitute and frightened ones with iron arrows, I will play the Veena of my bow in hand."
44.hi: इति चतुर्वि शः सगः उस समय न तो सहदस्नाच इन्द्र की अथवा स्मयं वरुण की अथवा यम की अथवा कुबेर की यह मजाल है कि, इनमें से भो कोई मेरे साथ महायुद्ध में मेरे.बाणाशि का सामना कर सके

45.sa: अवगाह्य महरङ्गम् वादयिष्यान्तगन् रणे ।न वासवेनापि स हस्रचक्षुषा ।युद्धेऽस्मि शक्यो वरुणेन वास्वयम् ।यमेव वा धर्षयितुम् शराग्निना ।महाहवे वैश्रवणेन वा स्वयम् ॥६-२४-४५॥
45.en: "It is not possible (to win over) for the thousand eyed Indra, or even Varuna, the god presiding over water, or even for Yama, the god of death and again even for Kubera the god of wealth to face the fire of my arrows (said Ravana to Suka)." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकावेयुध्दकाण्डेचतुर्विंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: सबलेसागरंतीर्णेरामेदशरथात्मजे ।अमात्यौरावणश्रीमानब्रवीच्छुकसारणौ ॥६-२५-१॥।।
1.en: On hearing about Rama, the son of Dasaratha crossing the shore of the ocean along with the army, exuberant Ravana spoke to his ministers Suka and Saarana.
1.hi: युद्धकाएड का चोबीसबाँ सग पूरा हुआ । ZT वव. पञ्चविंशः सगः = क्ष विजयी विकी सबले सागरं तीण रामे दशरथात्मजे । अमात्यौ रावणः :श्रीमानत्रबीच्छुकसारणौ

2.sa: समग्रंसागरंतीर्णंदुस्तरंवानरंबलम् ।अभूतपूर्वंरामेणसागरेसेतुबन्धनम् ॥६-२५-२॥।।
2.en: "That all the Vanara army together with Rama have crossed the arduous ocean and that the construction of a bridge (is possible) in the sea is not known before."
2.hi: देखो, दुस्तर समस्त सागर को वानरी सेना पार कर | आयी । श्रीराम का समुद्र के ऊपर पुल बाँधना भी एक ऐसा काम है, जो इसके पहिले कभी किसी ने नहीं कर पाया था

3.sa: सागरेसेतुबन्दंतुनश्रद्दध्यांकथञ्चन ।अवश्यंचापिसङ् ख्येयंतन्मयावानरंबलम् ॥६-२५-३॥।।
3.en: "It is not believable even to me that they constructed a bridge in the sea. Surely I wish to know the size of their army."
3.hi: यद्यपि सागर के ऊपर पुल बाँध लेने से मुझे श्रीरामचन्द्र के ऊपर किसी प्रकार श्रद्धा उत्पन्न नहीं होती तथापि मुझे यह जान लेना आवश्यक है कि, श्री रामचन्द्र के साथ कितनी सेना है

4.sa: भवन्तौवानरंसैन्यंप्रविश्यानुपलक्षितौ ।परिमाणंचवीर्यंचयेचमुख्याःप्लवङ्घमाः ॥६-२५-४॥।।
4.en: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."
4.hi: सो तुम छिप कर वानरी सेना में जाओ ओर वहाँ जा कर | देख आओ कि, वानरी सेना कितनी है, उसकी केसी शक्ति है । मुख्य मुख्य बानर कोन कौन हें

5.sa: मन्त्रिणोयेचरामस्यसुग्रीवस्यचसम्मता: ।येपूर्वमभिवर्तन्तेयेचशूराःप्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-२५-५॥।।
5.en: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."
5.hi: श्री रामचन्द्र और सुग्रीव के कौन कौन मंत्री हैं, जिनकी बातें वे दोनों मानते हैं या जिनका वे दोंनो आदर करते हैं। वे कौन शूर हैं, जो सेना के आगे रहते हैं और उनमें जो - । 9 बास्तघ में शूर बानर हैं उन सब का पता लगा लाओ

6.sa: सचसेतुर्यथाबद्धस्सागरेसलिलार्णवे ।निवेशंचयधातेषांवानराणांमहात्मनाम् ॥६-२५-६॥।।
6.en: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."

7.sa: रामस्यव्यवसायंचवीर्यंप्रहरणानिच ।लक्ष्मणस्यचवीर्यंतत्त्वतोज्ञातुमर्हथः ॥६-२५-७॥।।
7.en: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."
7.hi: तुंम लोग इसका भी ठीक ठीक पता लगाना कि राम और -लद््मण क्या करना चाहते हैं, उनमें बल कितना है, वे किन . आयुधो से लड़ते हैं

8.sa: कश्चसेनापतिस्तेषांवानराणांमहौजसाम् ।तच्चज्ञात्वायथातत्त्वंशीघ्रमगन्तुमर्हथः ॥६-२५-८॥।।
8.en: Among those energetic Vanaras, who is the chief of the army? Knowing all these matters, it is fit for you to return quickly.
8.hi: उस बड़ी बलवती वानरी सेना का कौन सेनापति है । इन सब बातों का पता लगा तुम शीघ आ जाओ

9.sa: इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टौराक्षसौशुकसारणौ ।हरिरूपधरौवीरौप्रविष्टौवानरंबलम् ॥६-२५-९॥।।
9.en: Having accepted the order, both the Rakshasa heroes, Suka and Saarana took the form of Vanaras and entered the Vanara army.

10.sa: ततस्तद्वानरंसैन्यमचिन्त्यंरोमहर्षणम् ।सङ् ख्यातुंनाध्यगच्छेतांतदातौशुकसारणौ ॥६-२५-१०॥।।
10.en: There upon both Suka and Saarana did not know the numbers (of the army) at that time as they could not count the numbers from there as it could not be conceived. It caused the raising of their hair.

11.sa: संस्थितंपर्वताग्रेषुनिर्दरेषुगुहासुच ।समुद्रस्यचतीरेषुवनेषूपवनेषुच ॥६-२५-११॥।।
11.en: The ocean of army settled on the mountain summits, in caverns and caves, on the shores of the ocean, in the forests and adjoining gardens some who crossed the sea some in the process of crossing settled all over was witnessed by the Rakshasas. It was never ending and making terrific noise.

12.sa: तरमाणंचतीर्णंचतर्तुकामंचसर्वशः ।निविष्टंनिविश्चैवभीमनादंमहाबलम् ॥६-२५-१२॥।।
12.en: The ocean of army settled on the mountain summits, in caverns and caves, on the shores of the ocean, in the forests and adjoining gardens some who crossed the sea some in the process of crossing settled all over was witnessed by the Rakshasas. It was never ending and making terrific noise.
12.hi: सो भी बहुत सी तो पार हो चुकी थी और बहत सी ) ॥र बहुत सी. पार होने की तैयारी कर रही थी । अनेक डानरसैनिक उस समव डेरे डाल चुके थे । वे सब के सब सिंह की तरह . दहाड़ रहे थे और बड़े बलवान्‌ थे

13.sa: तद्बलार्णवमक्षोभ्यंददृशातेनिशाचरौ ।तौददर्शमहातेजाःप्रतिच्छन्नौचविभीषणः ।आचचक्षेऽथरामायगृहीत्वाशुकसारणौ ॥६-२५-१३॥।।
13.en: Brilliant Vibheeshana saw both Suka and Saarana hidden in the army. He took hold of them and brought to the notice of Rama.
13.hi: वे दोनों राक्षस अपना असली रूप छिपाये, उस सेनारूपी ~ र रा >. (> ००७ अक्षोभ्य सागर को देख ही रहे थे कि, इतने में तेजस्वी विभीषण ने उनको पहचान लिग्ना

14.sa: तस्यैमौराक्षसेन्द्रस्यमन्त्रिणौशुकसारणौ ।लङ्कायस्समनुप्राप्तौचारौपरपुरञ्जय: ॥६-२५-१४॥।।
14.en: "O conqueror of enemy's citadels! these are spies from Lanka, Suka and Saarana who have come to find us out."
14.hi: ओर उन दोनों शुक सारण को पकड़ कर, वे श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास ले गये और कहा--हे शत्र को जीतने वाले ! ये दोनों राक्षस राजा रावण के मंत्री हैं। इनके नाम शुक और सारणे 'हें। ये लङ्का से यहाँ गुप्तचर बन कर आए हैं। वे श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को देख बहुत व्यथित हुए और जीबन की आशा से भी हाथ घो बैठे

15.sa: तौदृष्टवाव्यथितौरामंनिराशौजीवितेतथा ।कृताञ्जलिपुटौभीतौवचनंचेदमूचतुः ॥६-२५-१५॥।।
15.en: The two (Rakshasa spies) got worried to look at Rama and also lost hope of their life. Caught up with fear they lifted their palms greeting Rama and expressed these words.

16.sa: आवामिहागतौसौम्य रावणप्रहितावुभौ ।परिज्ञातुंबलंसर्वंतवेदंरघुनन्दन: ॥६-२५-१६॥।।
16.en: "O noble one! We have come to you assigned by Ravana. O delight of Raghu race, thus we arrived here to know about the entire strength of your army."
16.hi: उन्होंने मारे डर के हाथ जोड़ कर यह कइा--हे सौम्य ! हम दोनों रावण के भेज हुए यहाँ आये हें

17.sa: तयोस्तद्वचनंश्रुत्वारामोदशरथात्मजः ।अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यंसर्वभूतहितेरतः ॥६-२५-१७॥।।
17.en: "On hearing (the spies) Dasaratha's son Rama who remains devoted to the wellbeing of all beings spoke these words smiling at both of them."
17.hi: हे रघुनन्दन £ हम इसलिए भेज गये हैं कि, हम तुम्हारी समस्त सेना की संख्या जान लें । दाशरथि श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उनके ये वचन सुने

18.sa: यदिदृष्टंबलंसर्वंवयंवासुपरिक्षिताः ।यथोक्तंवाकृतंकार्यछन्दतःप्रतिगम्यताम् ॥६-२५-१८॥।।
18.en: After observing our entire army carefully, acting appropriately (according to Ravana's words) and accomplishing your task you may freely return (said Rama to the spies).

19.sa: अथकिञ्चिददृष्टंवाभूयस्तद्द्रष्टुमर्हथः ।विभीषणोवाकात्स्नर्येनभूयस्सन्दर्शयिष्यति ॥६-२५-१९॥।।
19.en: "If you have not seen even a bit, you ought to see. Or else Vibheeshana will show you the total army."
19.hi: क्योंकि बह्‌ सेना ( एक स्थान पर नहीं बहिक ). पर्त शिखरों पर, भरनों के समीप, गिरिगुहाओं में, समुद्र के तट पर बनो और उपवनों में फैली हुई पड़ी थी

20.sa: नचेदंग्रहणंप्राप्यभेत्तव्यंजीवितंप्रति ।न्यस्तशस्त्रौगृहतौवानदूतौवधमर्हतः ॥६-२५-२०॥।।
20.en: As you have been caught by us like this you need not have apprehension of your life. Those who do not possess wield or those who are envoys ought not to be slayed.
20.hi: दद राक्षसेश्वर ! हमें मार डालने के लिए विभीषण ने हमें पकड़ लिआ था ; किन्तु असीम तेजस्वी धर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने हमको देखते ही छोड़ 4दिआ।!

21.sa: प्रच्छमानौविमुञ्चैतौचारौरात्रिंचरावुभौ ।शत्रुपक्षस्यसततंविभीषण: विकर्षिणौ ॥६-२५-२१॥।।
21.en: "Vibheeshana! Even though they are spies seeking to divide the enemy army as both the night rangers have been requesting, you may set them free."
21.hi: क्योंकि तुम शस्त्ररहित पकड़े गए हो और दूत बन कर आए हो अतः तुम मार डालने योग्य नहीं हो । हे विभीषण.! यद्यपि ये रूप बदल कर आए हैं, शत्रु के भेदिए हैं और सुग्रीवादि का भेद लेने आए हैं ; तथापि इन दोनों राक्षसचरों को छोड़ दो। ( विभीषण से यह कह श्रीरामचन्द्र पुनः उन गुप्तचरों से कहने लगे । ) हे राक्षसचरो ! लङ्का में जा कर आप लोग कुबेर के भाई राक्षसराज रावण से, मैं जो कहता हूँ सो ज्यों का त्यों कह्‌ देना । उनसे कहना कि, जिस बलवूते पर तूने मेरी सीता हरी हे

22.sa: प्रविश्यनगरींलङ्कांभवद् भ्यांधनदानुजः ।वक्तव्योरक्षसांराजायथोक्तंवचनंमम ॥६-२५-२२॥।।
22.en: "Upon entering the city of Lanka, you may tell my words to the king of Rakshasas, the younger brother of Kubera just as it was told by me."

23.sa: यद्बलंचसमाश्रित्यसीतांमेहृतवानपि ।तद्दर्शययथाकामंससैन्यस्सहबान्धवः ॥६-२५-२३॥।।
23.en: "Let him display the strength on which he has abducted my Sita along with his army and relations at his will."

24.sa: श्वःकाल्येनगरींलङ्कांसप्राकारांसतोरणाम् ।रक्षसंचबलंपश्यशरैर्विध्वंसितंमया ॥६-२५-२४॥।।
24.en: At dawn tomorrow, you may see how I will crush the arches of the entrance of Lanka city and the strength of Rakshasas."
24.hi: उस अपने बल को अपनी सेना और भाईबन्दों के सहित मुझे दिखला । तू कल सबेरे परकोटे और तोरण दारों सहित लङ्कापुरी कों तथा समस्त राक्षसी सेना को मेरे बाणों से ध्वस्त हुआ देखेगा ! हे रावण! कल सवेरे में सेनालहित तेरे ऊपर अपना भयङ्कर क्रोध वैसे ही प्रकट करूंगा जैसे बज्रधारी इन्द्र दानवों के ऊपर वज्र छोड़ कर, अपना क्रोध प्रकट करते हैं। इस प्रकार अब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उन्न दोनों शुक सारण राक्षसा को आज्ञा दी

25.sa: क्रोधंभीममहंमोक्ष्येससैन्येत्वयिरावण: ।श्वःकाल्येवज्रवान्वज्रंदानवेष्विववासवः ॥६-२५-२५॥।।
25.en: "Tomorrow at the dawn of the day I will release my dreadful anger on Ravana and even on Rakshasas just as the thunderbolt of Indra was released on Rakshasas."

26.sa: इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टौराक्षसौशुकसारणौ ॥६-२५-२६॥।।
26.en: Having heard the reply of Rama, both the Rakshasas Suka and Saarana praising Rama saying, "Victory to you!" reached Lanka and said to the king of Rakshasas as follows.
26.hi: दाशरथी श्रीरामचन्द्र, शोभासम्पन्न लक्ष्मण, विभीषण और महातेजस्वी एबं इन्द्र के समान पराक्रमी सुग्रीव, ये चारों श्रेष्ठज्ञन एक ही स्थान पर टिके हुए हैं। ये लोकपालों को तरह शूर हैं, श्जविद्या में निपुण हैं और बड़े पराक्रमी हूँ

27.sa: जयेतिप्रतिनन्द्यैतौराघवंधर्मवत्सलम् ।आगम्यनगरींलङ्कामब्रूतांराक्षसाधिपम् ॥६-२५-२७॥।।
27.en: Having heard the reply of Rama, both the Rakshasas Suka and Saarana praising Rama saying, "Victory to you!" reached Lanka and said to the king of Rakshasas as follows.
27.hi: तब वे धमवत्सल श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की जयजयकार करते हुए लक्का में जा राक्तसराज रावण से बोले

28.sa: विभीषणगृहीतौतुवधार्तौराक्षसेश्वर: ।दृष्टवाधर्मात्मनामुक्तौरामेणामिततेजसा ॥६-२५-२८॥।।
28.en: "O king of Rakshasas! Vibheeshana held us captive for slaying us. But righteous self, Rama, the highly effulgent one released us on seeing."

29.sa: एकस्थानगतायत्रचत्वारःपुरुषर्षभाः ।लोकपालसमाश्शूराःकृतास्त्रादृढविक्रमा ॥६-२५-२९॥।।
29.en: "Exuberant Rama and Lakshmana, highly brilliant Vibheeshana, and Sugriva who resembles Indra in his valour, are like rulers of the world and are heroic, wielders of weapons and bulls among men. If all four of them come together there in that manner, they will unearth the arch ways and even the city of Lanka. They are capable even if the Vanaras are kept away."

30.sa: रामोदाशरथि्शीमान् लक्ष्मणश्चविभीषणः ।सुग्रीवश्चमहातेजामहेन्द्रसमविक्रमः ॥६-२५-३०॥।।
30.en: "Exuberant Rama and Lakshmana, highly brilliant Vibheeshana, and Sugriva who resembles Indra in his valour, are like rulers of the world and are heroic, wielders of weapons and bulls among men. If all four of them come together there in that manner, they will unearth the arch ways and even the city of Lanka. They are capable even if the Vanaras are kept away."

31.sa: एतेशक्ताःपुरीलङ्कांसप्राकारांसतोरणाम् ।उत्पाट्यसङ्क्रमयितुंसर्वेतिष्ठन्तुवानराः ॥६-२५-३१॥।।
31.en: "Exuberant Rama and Lakshmana, highly brilliant Vibheeshana, and Sugriva who resembles Indra in his valour, are like rulers of the world and are heroic, wielders of weapons and bulls among men. If all four of them come together there in that manner, they will unearth the arch ways and even the city of Lanka. They are capable even if the Vanaras are kept away."
31.hi: थे चार अकेले ही परकोटों और तोरणद्वारों सहित लङ्का को उखाड़ कर फेंक सकते हें ॥ आप समस्त वानर भले ही बैठे रहें

32.sa: यादृश्यंतस्यरामस्यरूपंप्रहरणानिच ।वधिष्यतिपुरींलङ्कामेकस्तिष्ठन्तुतेत्रयः ॥६-२५-३२॥।।
32.en: "If we see Rama's form and his weapon it is enough. He can alone slay even when all the other three keep away."
32.hi: जिस प्रकार का श्रीराम आदि का रूप है. और जैसे उनके हथियार हैं ; उनको देखते हुए कहा जा सकता है कि, श्रीराम अकेले ही लङ्का का नाश कर सकते हैं। लक्ष्मण सुग्रीव ओर विभीषण, इन तीनों की. सहायता की भी. उनको “आवश्यकता नहीं है

33.sa: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्तासासुग्रीवेणचवाहिनी ।बभूवदुर्दर्षतरासर्वैरपिसुरासुरैः ॥६-२५-३३॥।।
33.en: "Even if Rama and Lakshmana are protected, and even Sugriva also, the entire army seems formidable like suras and asuras."
33.hi: संक्रामयित -श्रन्यत्र ्े्दुम्‌ । (गो) -. . ३ क्कामबित अन्यतर बेच्न | (गो) 2. ० 5 २१८ ` ` युद्धकाण्डे श्रीराम लक्ष्मण और सुग्रीव से रक्षित वानरी सेना, इन्द्र “१ सहित देवताओं और दानबों से भी अति अजेय हो गई

34.sa: प्रहृष्टरूपाध्वजिनीवनौकसां ।महात्मनाम् सम्प्रतियोद्धुमिच्छताम् ।अलंविरोधेनशमोविधीयतांप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैदिली ॥६-२५-३४॥।।
34.en: "The army of the great-souled forest-dwellers, its warriors exultant, now desires to fight. Enough of enmity; let peace be made, and let Maithili be given to the son of Dasaratha."
34.hi: हे राजन्‌! बानरी सेना में प्रसन्नता छाई हुई है और वे सब दृढ़ मनस्क हैं और तुरन्त युद्ध करना चाहते हें । अतएब आप अपना क्रोध शान्त कीजिए और दशरथनन्दन श्रीरामचन्द्र को जानकी दै कर, उनके साथ शत्रुता की इतिश्री कर डालिए

1.sa: तद् वचः पथ्यम् अक्लीबम् सारणेन अभिभाषितम् ।निशम्य रावणो राजा प्रत्यभाषत सारणम् ॥६-२६-१॥।।
1.en: Perceiving the truthful and beneficial words spoken by Saarana, without hesitation, King Ravana replied.
1.hi: युद्धकाण्ड का पच्चीसवोँ सग पूरा हुआ । —B— $ र “Rf षड्विशःसगः _ न | तद्वचः पथ्यमक्लीबं सारणेनाभिभाषितम्‌ । निशम्य रावणो राजा प्रत्यभाषत सारणम्‌

2.sa: यदि माम् अभियुन्जीरन् देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ।न एव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्व लोक भयाद् अपि ॥६-२६-२॥।।
2.en: "Even if Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas put together attack me in war and not even for the fear of the whole world will I surrender Sita?"
2.hi: हू षड्विंशः सगः २१६ यदि देवता, गन्धव और दानव मेरे ऊपर चढ़ाई करें, अथवा समस्त लोक ही मेरे विरुद्ध हो जाय, तो भी में भयभीत हो कभी सीता राम को।न दूंगा

3.sa: त्वम् तु सौम्य परित्रस्तो हरिभिर् निर्जितो भृशम् ।प्रतिप्रदानम् अद्य एव सीतायाः साधु मन्यसे ॥६-२६-३॥।।
3.en: As you are vanquished by the noble Vanaras you are frightened like this and thinking it is good to surrender Sita.
3.hi: हे सौम्य ! तुम तो वानरों से कष्ट पा कर डर गए हो । इसी से तो तुम आज ही सीता को लौटा देना अच्छा समझते हो

4.sa: को हि नाम सपत्नो माम् समरे जेतुम् अर्हति ।इति उक्त्वा परुषम् वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ॥६-२६-४॥।।
4.en: "What adversary can win me in war? You ought to know this", said Ravana. Then Ravana, the king of Rakshasas having spoken that way went up to the snow white palace which was of the height of many Palmira trees wishing to see (the Vanaras).
4.hi: ऐसा कौन शत्र है, जो मुझे युद्ध में जीत सके । राक्षासराज रावण, इस प्रकार के कठोर वचन कह

5.sa: आरुरोह ततः श्रीमान् प्रासादम् हिम पाण्डुरम् ।बहु ताल समुत्सेधम् रावणो अथ दिदृक्षया ॥६-२६-५॥।।
5.en: "What adversary can win me in war? You ought to know this", said Ravana. Then Ravana, the king of Rakshasas having spoken that way went up to the snow white palace which was of the height of many Palmira trees wishing to see (the Vanaras).

6.sa: ताभ्याम् चराभ्याम् सहितो रावणः क्रोध मूर्चितः ।पश्यमानः समुद्रम् च पर्वतामः च वनानि च ॥६-२६-६॥।।
6.en: Deluded with anger Ravana along with both the spies observed the sea, the mountains and the woods crowded with monkeys in that region of the earth.
6.hi: सपना शब: । (गोऽ) १, पृषिवीदेश = िकूदाषः प्रदेश (गो०) २२०” युद्धकाण्डे . - उस समय रावण बड़ा कुपित था और उसके साथ वे दोनों रात्तसदूत झुक और सारणा भी थे । उस अटारी से उसने समुद्र नन, त्रिकूटाचल्ल पत की तराई और पहाड़ों पर बंदर ही बंदर देखे । उसने उस अपार असंख्य और बड़े बलवान्‌ बानरों की सेना को देखा

7.sa: ददर्श पृथिवी देशम् सुसम्पूर्णम् प्लवम् गमैः ।तद् अपारम् असम्ख्येयम् वानराणाम् महद् बलम् ॥६-२६-७॥।।
7.en: Ravana seeing the innumerable army force of monkeys which was impossible to count again enquired looking at Saarana.

8.sa: आलोक्य रावणो राजा परिपप्रच्च सारणम् ।एषाम् वानर मुख्यानाम् के शूराः के महाबलाः ॥६-२६-८॥।।
8.en: "Who among the Vanaras is foremost, who is valiant, strong in prowess and most energetic? Who are their equals in the earlier war, you may tell in order?"
8.hi: ॥ आलोक्य राबणो राजा परिपप्रच्छ सारणम्‌ । ` एषां वानरशुख्यानां के शूराः के महाबलाः ॥ ८ ` उस सेना का अवलोकन कर, रावण सारण से पूछने लगा । इन वानरों में कौन कौन मुख्य, कौन कोन वीर और बड़े बड़े बलवान्‌ हैं १

9.sa: के पूर्वम् अभिवर्तन्ते महाउत्साहाः समन्ततः ।केषाम् शृणोति सुग्रीवः के वा यूथप यूथपाः ॥६-२६-९॥।।
9.en: "Whose advice does Sugriva listen to? Who is the chief of the army of Vanaras? Saarana, I wish to know truly."

10.sa: सारण आचक्ष्व मे सर्वम् के प्रधानाः प्लवम् गमाः ।सारणो राक्षस इन्द्रस्य वचनम् परिपृच्चतः ॥६-२६-१०॥।।
10.en: Hearing the words asked by Rakshasendra, Saarana, who knew the important ones, thus spoke out about the important monkey leaders.
10.hi: हे सारण ! तुम ठीक ठीक बतलाओ कि इस वानरी सेना में प्रधान वानर कौन कौन है ! राक्षसराज रावण के इन प्रश्नों को सुन

11.sa: आचचक्षे अथ मुख्यज्ञो मुख्याम्स् ताम्स् तु वन ओकसः ।एष यो अभिमुखो लंकाम् नर्दम्स् तिष्ठति वानरः ॥६-२६-११॥।।
11.en: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."
11.hi: क पाठान्तरे--“मुख्यांस्तांस्तु >) FP षड्वशः सगः २२१. मुख्य अमुख्य वानर बीरों को जानने वाला सारण, मुख्य बानरों के नाम, धाम, बल, बिक्रम का निरूपण करके कहने लगा । बह बोला-हे रावण ! यह वानर जो लङ्का की ओर मुख कर गरज रहा है.

12.sa: यूथपानाम् सहस्राणाम् शतेन परिवारितः ।यस्य घोषेण महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा ॥६-२६-१२॥।।
12.en: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."
12.hi: इसके साथ एक लाख वानर यूथपति हैं । इसके सिंहनाद परकोटे, तोरण द्वारों

13.sa: लंका प्रवेपते सर्वा सशैल वन कानना ।सर्व शाखा मृग इन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ॥६-२६-१३॥।।
13.en: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."
13.hi: पहाड़ों, वनों और उपवनो सहित समस्त लक्का कॉप रही है. आर जो समस्त वानरों के राजा महाबुद्धिमान्‌ सुग्रीव

14.sa: बल अग्रे तिष्ठते वीरो नीलो नाम एष यूथपः ।बाहू प्रगृह्य यः पद्भ्याम् महीम् गच्चति वीर्यवान् ॥६-२६-१४॥।।
14.en: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
14.hi: की सेना के आगे खड़ा है इसका नाम नील है और यह बडा. बीर और यूथपति है । जो बलवान वानर बाँहों को उठाए, प्रथिवी . हर टहल रहा है

15.sa: लंकाम् अभिमुखः कोपाद् अभीक्ष्णम् च विजृम्भते ।गिरि शृन्ग प्रतीकाशः पद्म किन्जल्क सम्निभः ॥६-२६-१५॥।।
15.en: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
15.hi: यह न तो मरने से डरता है ओर न युद्ध से मढ मोडता है। यह मारे क्रोध के थर थर कॉप रहा है और तिरी दृष्टि से देख रहा है । देखिए, पूछ फटकार कर कैसा सिंहनाद कर रहा है तथा अपने बल विक्रम पर निर्भर रह कर, निर्भय हो साल्वेय नामक रमणीय पहाड़ पर रहता है

16.sa: स्फोटयति अभिसम्रब्धो लान्गूलम् च पुनः पुनः ।यस्य लान्गूल शब्देन स्वनन्ति इव दिशो दश ॥६-२६-१६॥।।
16.en: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
16.hi: ओर जो क्रोघ में भर अपनी पूछ बारंबार प्रथिवी पर पटक रहा है और जिसकी पूंछ की फटकार के शब्द से दर्सो. दिखाएँ प्रतिध्वनित हो रही हैं

17.sa: एष वानर राजेन सुर्ग्रीवेण अभिषेचितः ।यौवराज्ये अन्गदो नाम त्वाम् आह्वयति सम्युगे ॥६-२६-१७॥।।
17.en: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
17.hi: सो यह अंगद नाम का वानर है । इसे कपिराज सुग्रीव ने यौत्रराञ्यपद पर अभिषिक्त किया हे ओर यह तुमको युद्ध के लिये ललकार रहा है

18.sa: वालिनः सदृशः पुत्रः सुग्रीवस्य सदा प्रियः ।राघवार्थे पराक्रान्तः शक्रार्थे वरुणो यथा ॥६-२६-१८॥।।
18.en: "He is the son of Vali and is similar to him and is ever beloved of Sugriva. Jus t like Varuna fights for the cause of Indra, he is ready to show his valour for the cause of Rama."
18.hi: यह बालि का पुत्र अङ्गद अपने पिता के समान बलवाने ओर पराक्रमी हे और सुग्रोब का सदा 'प्रिय पात्र है । जिस प्रकार वरुण जी इन्द्र के लिए पराक्रम प्रदर्शित करने को उद्यत रहते हैं ; उसी प्रकार यह भी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के लिए पराक्रम दिखाने को तत्पर रहता है

19.sa: एतस्य सा मतिः सर्वा यद्दृष्टा जनकात्मजा ।हनूमता वेगवता राघवस्य हितैषिणा ॥६-२६-१९॥।।
19.en: "He is a well wisher of Raghava, called Hanuman. He had come to see Janaka's daughter, and his intellect is the cause for all that."

20.sa: बहूनि वानरेन्द्राणामेष यूथानि वीर्यवान् ।परिगृह्याभियाति त्वाम् स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-२०॥।।
20.en: "This valiant Vanara himself with many troops and several battalions of the Vanara king is marching to crush you."
20.hi: बलवान्‌ अङ्गद असंख्य वानस्यूथर्पातयों के साथ तुम्हारा मर्दन करने को आगे बढ़ा आता है. । यह दुर्जेय है

21.sa: अनुवालिसुतस्यापि बलेन महता वृतः ।वीरस्तिष्ठति सम्ग्रामे सेतुहेतुरयम् नलः ॥६-२६-२१॥।।
21.en: "Behind this Vali's son is Nala surrounded by a huge army force. He is heroic in war. He is the cause of construction of the bridge."
21.hi: जिस वीर ने समुद्र के ऊपर पुल बाँधा है, वह नल नामक बीर वानर लड़ने की अभिलाषा करता हुआ बढ़ी भारी सेना के साथ बालिसुत अङ्गद के पीछे खड़ा हुआ है

22.sa: ये तु विष्टभ्य गात्राणि क्ष्वेडयन्ति नदन्ति च ।उत्थाय च विजृम्भन्ते क्रोधेन हरि पुम्गवाः ॥६-२६-२२॥।।
22.en: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. They have made their body stiff, tossing their limbs, and are roaring in anger. They are standing up and stretching their limbs in sandalwood forest. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."
22.hi: ये जो कपिश्रेष्ठ अपने अङ्कां को मल मल कर, ,सिहनाद करते हुए गरज रहे हैं. तथा उचक कर क्रोध में भर जमुहा रहे हैं.

23.sa: एते दुष्प्रसहा घोराः चण्डाः चण्ड पराक्रमाः ।अष्टौ शत सहस्राणि दश कोटि शतानि च ॥६-२६-२३॥।।
23.en: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. They have made their body stiff, tossing their limbs, and are roaring in anger. They are standing up and stretching their limbs in sandalwood forest. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."
23.hi: ये सब शत्रओं के लिये असह्य और प्रचण्ड पराक्रमी हैं.। इनकी संख्या एक खर्व आठ लाख हे

24.sa: य एनम् अनुगच्चन्ति वीराः चन्दन वासिनः ।एष आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-२४॥।।
24.en: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. They have made their body stiff, tossing their limbs, and are roaring in anger. They are standing up and stretching their limbs in sandalwood forest. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."
24.hi: सेतुहेतु:--सेठुकत्ता । (गो०) २ चज ला र विश्व-उसम्नन्य ।( गे | (गार ) ३ श्राशंसते प्राथ॑यते | ( गो० ) २२४ युद्धकाण्डे उनके पीछे जो वीर वानर हें, वे सत्र चन्दनवन “निवासी हैं, ये अपनी सेना द्वारा लङ्का को ध्वस्त करने की आज्ञा पाने के लिए प्राथना करते हैं

25.sa: श्वेतो रजत सम्काशः सबलो भीम विक्रमः ।बुद्धिमान् वानरः शूरस् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ॥६-२६-२५॥।।
25.en: "One who resembles silver in colour is Swetha. He is an intelligent one with terrific prowess, and a warrior is well known in the three worlds. Swetha is quickly coming towards Sugriva, dividing the Vanara army forces and again proceeding swiftly."

26.sa: तूर्णम् सुग्रीवम् आगम्य पुनर् गच्चति वानरः ।विभजन् वानरीम् सेनाम् अनीकानि प्रहर्षयन् ॥६-२६-२६॥।।
26.en: "One who resembles silver in colour is Swetha. He is an intelligent one with terrific prowess, and a warrior is well known in the three worlds. Swetha is quickly coming towards Sugriva, dividing the Vanara army forces and again proceeding swiftly."
26.hi: देखिए, कैसी शीघ्रता से सुग्रीव कें पास जाता और लौट आता है । जो वानरी सेना को विभाजित कर रहा है, जो अपनी सेना को प्रसन्न कर रहा है

27.sa: यः पुरा गोमती तीरे रम्यम् पर्येति पर्वतम् ।नाम्ना सम्कोचनो नाम नाना नग युतो गिरिः ॥६-२६-२७॥।।
27.en: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."
27.hi: जो पहिले गोमती तटवर्ती रमणीक पवत के चारों ओर घूमा करता था, तथा अब अनेक पर्वों से घिरे हुए सङ्कोचन नामक पर्वत पर राज्य करता है । इसका नास कुमुद है और यह भी एक यूथपति दै । यह एक लाख वानर लेकर आया हुआ है

28.sa: तत्र राज्यम् प्रशास्ति एष कुमुदो नाम यूथपः ।यो असौ शत सहस्राणाम् सहस्रम् परिकर्षति ॥६-२६-२८॥।।
28.en: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

29.sa: यस्य वाला बहु व्यामा दीर्घ लान्गूलम् आश्रिताः ।ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः प्रकीर्णा घोर कर्मणः ॥६-२६-२९॥।।
29.en: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

30.sa: अदीनो रोषणः चण्डः सम्ग्रामम् अभिकान्क्षति ।एष एव आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-३०॥।।
30.en: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

31.sa: यस् त्व् एष सिम्ह सम्काशः कपिलो दीर्घ केसरः ।निभृतः प्रेक्षते लंकाम् दिधक्षन्न् इव चक्षुषा ॥६-२६-३१॥।।
31.en: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."
31.hi: जो अदीन हे और बड़ा क्रोधी है इसका नाम चण्ड है. । यह बड़ा संग्रामप्रिय हे । यह भी अपनी सेना को साथ ले लङ्काको ध्वस्त करने की आज्ञा पाने के लिए सुम्रीव से प्राथना करता है ३०। यस्त्वेप सिंहसङ्काशः कपिलो दीपकेसर ¦ । निभृतः१ प्र चते लङ्कां दिधचन्निब चक्षुषा

32.sa: विन्ध्यम् कृष्ण गिरिम् सह्यम् पर्वतम् च सुदर्शनम् ।राजन् सततम् अध्यास्ते रम्भो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२६-३२॥।।
32.en: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."
32.hi: ओर जिसका विन्ध्य, ऋष्णगिरि, सह्या द्र तुझा सुदर्शन नामक तीन परढीतों पर रहने का स्थान है ; हे राजन्‌! वह रम्भ नाम का यूथपति हे.

33.sa: शतम् शत सहस्राणाम् त्रिम्शच् च हरि यूथपाः ।यम् यान्तम् वानरा घोराश्चण्डाश्चण्ड्पराक्रमाः ॥६-२६-३३॥।।
33.en: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."
33.hi: इसको एक करोड़ तीस प्रचण्ड शूरवीर और पराक्रमी वनर घेर कर चलते हैं। यह भो अपने पराक्रम से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चाहता है । देखो, यह जो अपने कानों को सकोड़ता और बार बार जँभाई लेता है

34.sa: परिवार्य अनुगच्चन्ति लंकाम् मर्दितुम् ओजसा ।यस् तु कर्णौ विवृणुते जृम्भते च पुनः पुनः ॥६-२६-३४॥।।
34.en: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."

35.sa: न च सम्विजते मृत्योर् न च यूथाद् विधावति ।प्रकम्पते च रोषेन तिर्यक्च पुनरीक्षते ॥६-२६-३५॥।।
35.en: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."

36.sa: पश्यन् लाङ्गूलमपि च क्स्वेडत्येष महाबलः ।महाबलो वीत भयो रम्यम् साल्वेय पर्वतम् ॥६-२६-३६॥।।
36.en: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."
36.hi: बानरों के बीच वैसे ही बैठा है, जैसे देवताओं के बीच इन्द्र और जिसकी सेना के युद्धाकांची वानरों का महागजन नगाड़ों के शब्द की तरह सुनाई पड़ता है , उत्तस पारियात्र पवत पर रहता है

37.sa: राजन् सततम् अध्यास्ते शरभो नाम यूथपः ।एतस्य बलिनः सर्वे विहारा नाम यूथपाः ॥६-२६-३७॥।।
37.en: "O King! Under him are forty lakhs of strong warriors known as Viharas."

38.sa: राजन् शत सहस्राणि चत्वारिम्शत् तथैव च ।यस् तु मेघ इव आकाशम् महान् आवृत्य तिष्ठति ॥६-२६-३८॥।।
38.en: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

39.sa: मध्ये वानर वीराणाम् सुराणाम् इव वासवः ।भेरीणाम् इव सम्नादो यस्य एष श्रूयते महान् ॥६-२६-३९॥।।
39.en: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

40.sa: घोरः शाखा मृग इन्द्राणाम् सम्ग्रामम् अभिकान्क्षताम् ।एष पर्वतम् अध्यास्ते पारियात्रम् अनुत्तमम् ॥६-२६-४०॥।।
40.en: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

41.sa: युद्धे दुष्प्रसहो नित्यम् पनसो नाम यूथपः ।एनम् शत सहस्राणाम् शत अर्धम् पर्युपासते ॥६-२६-४१॥।।
41.en: "Fifty lakhs of best warriors are under him. They are in separate units."

42.sa: यूथपा यूथप श्रेष्ठम् येषाम् यूथानि भागशः ।यस् तु भीमाम् प्रवल्गन्तीम् चमूम् तिष्ठति शोभयन् ॥६-२६-४२॥।।
42.en: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."
42.hi: युद्ध में इसका वार सहना कठिन है । यह यूथपति है और इसका नाम पनस है। इसके अधीनस्थ डेढ़ लाख वानरवीर ह ४१॥ यूथपा यूथपश्रेष्ठं येपां यूथानि भागशः । यस्तु भौमां प्रवन्गन्ती चसू तिष्ठाति शोभयन्‌

43.sa: स्थिताम् तीरे समुद्रस्य द्वितीय इव सागरः ।एष दर्दर सम्काशो विनतो नाम यूथपः ॥६-२६-४३॥।।
43.en: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."

44.sa: पिबमः चरति पर्णाशाम् नदीनाम् उत्तमाम् नदीम् ।षष्टिः शत सहस्राणि बलम् अस्य प्लवम् गमाः ॥६-२६-४४॥।।
44.en: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."
44.hi: यह घूमता फिरता रहता है और सदा नदियों में श्रष्ठ पर्णासा ( पनासा ) नदी का पानी पिया करता हे । इसकी सेना में साठ लाख वानर हें

45.sa: त्वाम् आह्वयति युद्धाय क्रथनो नाम यूथपः ।विक्रान्ता बलवन्तश्च यथा यूथानि भागशः ॥६-२६-४५॥।।
45.en: "The valiant and powerful troop leaders are a part of units of the army under Vanara called Krodhana. He is challenging you for combat."
45.hi: यह देखिये क्रोधन नामक यूथपति तुमको युद्ध करने के लिए ललकार रहा है । इसके अधीनस्थ सैनिक बड़े बलवान और पराक्रमी हैं और वे सैनिक यूथों में विभक्त हे

46.sa: यस् तु गैरिक वर्ण आभम् वपुः पुष्यति वानरः ।अवमत्य सदा सर्वान्वानरान् बलदर्पितः ॥६-२६-४६॥।।
46.en: "He who is of an orange colour body of hand some form, who nourishes it ever and who is proud of his strength, a glorious one known as Gava ya is coming towards you angrily with disregard for Vanaras."
46.hi: सके शरीर का रंग गेरू जैसा हे और जो युद्ध करने की आशा से आनन्दित हो अपने शरीर को फुला रहा हे और जो अपने बल के दर्प से दर्पिंत हो , अन्य वानरो को सदा तुच्छ समझा करता हे;

47.sa: गवयो नाम तेजस्वी त्वाम् क्रोधाद् अभिवर्तते ।एनम् शत सहस्राणि सप्ततिः पर्युपासते ।एष आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-४७॥।।
47.en: "He has seventy lakhs under his command. Single handed with army force is aspiring to crush Lanka."
47.hi: पुष्यति- युद्धइर्घादभिबर्धयति ( गो० ) FE ”” a & सप्चविशः सगः २२६ तेजस्वी गवय नामक यूथपति हे । यह क्रोध में भरा हुआ आपका सामना करने की वाट जोह रहा है। इसके अधिकार में सत्तर लाख वीर वानर हैं । यह अकेला ही अपनी सेना के साथ लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चाहता है

48.sa: एते दुष्प्रसहा घोरा बलिनः काम रूपिणः ।यूथपा यूथप श्रेष्ठा येषाम् सम्ख्या न विद्यते ॥६-२६-४८॥
48.en: "They are difficult to resist, can change their form at will and are strong. These fierce troops, the best of the monkeys, have their units of army force." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषड्विंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
48.hi: इति षडविशः सगः ॥ हे महाराज ! ये सब के सब दुस्सह, भयङ्कर, बलवान्‌ एवं कासरूपी वानरयूथ और यूथपश्रेष्ठ हें। इनके अधीनस्थ यूथ प्रथक्‌ प्रथक्‌ हैं

1.sa: ताम्स्तु ते सम्प्रक्ष्यामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान् ।राघव अर्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रक्षन्ति जीवितम् ॥६-२७-१॥।।
1.en: "I will describe the Vanara force, who are not caring for their lives for the cause of Raghava. You may see."
1.hi: युद्धकाण्ड का छंब्बीसवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । ---8 याया ट ति सप्तविंशः सगः य त 'स्तु तेऽहं प्रवक्धयामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान्‌ । -घवार्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रबन्ति जीवितम्‌

2.sa: स्निग्धा यस्य बहु श्यामा बाला लान्गूलम् आश्रिताः ।ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः प्रकीर्णा घोर कर्मणः ॥६-२७-२॥।।
2.en: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."
2.hi: स्निग्धा यस्य बहुव्यामा& वाला लाइूलमार्थ्रित:। ह OQ 005 0 ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेता: प्रकीशा घोरकमंण

3.sa: प्रगृहीताः प्रकाशन्ते सूर्यस्य इव मरीचयः ।पृथिव्याम् च अनुकृष्यन्ते हरो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-३॥।।
3.en: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."
3.hi: और जो सूर्य की किरणों की तरह चमक रहे हें और जो पूंछ भटकारने से खड़े हो जाते और जो चलते समय भूमि पर लथिरते जाते हैं, सो वही हर नास यूथपति हं

4.sa: यम् पृष्ठतो अनुगच्चन्ति शतशो अथ सहस्रशः ।वृक्षानुद्यम्य सहसा लङ्का रोहणतत्पराः ॥६-२७-४॥।।
4.en: "Standing in attention near Sugriva are hundreds and thousands of warriors holding huge trees aspiring to climb Lanka and controlling the Vanaras at the back prominently and following."
4.hi: इसके ही पीछे सैकड़ों, हजारों बानरबीर चलते है जो वृक्षों को लिये हुए, सहसा लङ्का पर चढ वरन को तयार हूं

5.sa: यूथपा हरिराजस्य किम्कराः समुपस्थिताः ।नीलान् इव महामेघाम्स् तिष्ठतो याम्स् तु पश्यसि ॥६-२७-५॥।।
5.en: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."
5.hi: हं परपुरञ्जय ! ये सहस्र कोटि बड़े बलवान्‌ वानर तुमको युद्ध में जीतने की आकांक्षा रखते हैं

6.sa: असितान् जन सम्काशान् युद्धे सत्य पराक्रमान् ।असम्ख्येयान् अनिर्देश्यान् परम् पारम् इव उदधेः ॥६-२७-६॥।।
6.en: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."
6.hi: कपिराज के ये सब किङ्कर यूथपति है ( वेतनभोगी यूथपति) और युद्ध करने के लिए उपस्थित हुए हैं हे रावण ! नील सघ की तरह आप जिनको खड़ा देखते हैँ और काले अञ्जन की तरह जिनके शरीर का रंग है और जो युद्ध में यथांथ पराक्रम प्रदर्शित किश्या करते/हैं, असंख्य हैं, समुद्र के अपर पार की तरह इनकी संख्या नहीं बतलाई जा सकती

7.sa: पर्वतेषु च ये केचिद् विषमेषु नदीषु च ।एते त्वाम् अभिवर्तन्ते राजन्न् ऋष्काः सुदारुणाः ॥६-२७-७॥।।
7.en: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."

8.sa: एषाम् मध्ये स्थितो राजन् भीम अक्षो भीम दर्शनः ।पर्जन्य इव जीमूतैः समन्तात् परिवारितः ॥६-२७-८॥।।
8.en: "O king! In the midst of these (Vanaras) stands one with frightening eyes and fearful looks, just like Parjanya (RainGod) is surrounded by clouds, is the Lord of all these Bears called Dhumra. He dwells at the great Rkshavana mountain drinking Narmada's (river) water."
8.hi: हे राजम्‌ ! इनमें से बहुत से तो पहाड़ों पर, बहुत से अटपट ( ऊँची 'नीचो ) जगहों सें और बहुत से नदियों के तटों पर रहा करते हैं । हे राजम्‌! ये सब अत्यन्त दारुण रीछ आपका सामना करने को तैयार हैं

9.sa: ऋक्षवन्तम् गिरि श्रेष्ठम् अध्यास्ते नर्मदाम् पिबन् ।सर्व ऋक्षाणाम् अधिपतिर् धूम्रो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-९॥।।
9.en: "O king! In the midst of these (Vanaras) stands one with frightening eyes and fearful looks, just like Parjanya (RainGod) is surrounded by clouds, is the Lord of all these Bears called Dhumra. He dwells at the great Rkshavana mountain drinking Narmada's (river) water."

10.sa: यवीयान् अस्य तु भ्राता पश्य एनम् पर्वत उपमम्भ्रात्रा समानो रूपेण विशिष्टस् तु पराक्रमे ॥६-२७-१०॥।।
10.en: "See this one like a mountain, he is the brother of Dhumra. Even though he is similar to his brother in body form and his valour is great. As such he is superior among leaders. He is called Jambavan, one of valourous deeds, devoted to elders and intolerant in killing."

11.sa: स एष जाम्बवान् नाम महायूथप यूथपः ।प्रशान्तो गुरु वर्ती च सम्प्रहारेष्व् अमर्षणः ॥६-२७-११॥।।
11.en: "See this one like a mountain, he is the brother of Dhumra. Even though he is similar to his brother in body form and his valour is great. As such he is superior among leaders. He is called Jambavan, one of valourous deeds, devoted to elders and intolerant in killing."
11.hi: इसको देखिये, यह इसका छोटा भाई, पवत की तरह विशाल शरीरघारी है और अपने बड़े भाई जैसा ही रूप वाला दै | किन्तु पराक्रम में अपने भाई से बढ़ कर है

12.sa: एतेन साह्यम् सुमहत् कृतम् शक्रस्य धीमता ।देव असुरे जाम्बवता लब्धाः च बहवो वराः ॥६-२७-१२॥।।
12.en: "His assistance was given to Indra in the war between Devas and demons and in turn he obtained many boons."

13.sa: आरुह्य पर्वत अग्रेभ्यो महाअभ्र विपुलाः शिलाः ।मुन्चन्ति विपुल आकारा न मृत्योर् उद्विजन्ति च ॥६-२७-१३॥।।
13.en: Appearing with hairybody glowing like fire like the Rakshasas and demons, many of them in huge form are climbing mountain peaks without caring for death and go about throwing rocks.
13.hi: जब्र देवासुर-संत्राम हुआ 'था,'तब उस बुद्धिमान ने देवराज क्री बडी सहायता की थी और 'उस सहायता के उपलक्ष्य म उसने बहत से वरदान भौ पाए थे

14.sa: राक्षसानाम् च सदृशाः पिशाचानाम् च रोमशाः ।एतस्य सैन्ये बहवो विचरन्ति अग्नि तेजसः ॥६-२७-१४॥।।
14.en: Appearing with hairybody glowing like fire like the Rakshasas and demons, many of them in huge form are climbing mountain peaks without caring for death and go about throwing rocks.
14.hi: इसकी सेना के बड़े बड़े आकार के रीछ पवतरिखर पर चढ़ कर, वहाँ से बड़ी भारी भारी शिलायें फेंकते हैं ओर मौत से भी नहीं डरते

15.sa: यम् त्व् एनम् अभिसम्रब्धम् प्लवमानम् इव स्थितम् ।प्रेक्षन्ते वानराः सर्वे स्थितम् यूथप यूथपम् ॥६-२७-१५॥।।
15.en: "O king! This Lord of monkeys, whom whether he is jumping like monkeys or standing is the leader of the leaders, whom the monkeys are looking at standing is called Dhamba, a mighty powerful, fearsome leader and Lord of monkeys. He is surrounded by a strong army like the thousand eyed Indra."
15.hi: उसके शारीर में बड़े बड़े बाल हैं, वे राक्षस और पिशाचों की तरह क्रररच भाव हैं। जाम्बवान की अग्नि के समान तेजसम्पन्न बड़ी सेना है, जो इधर.उधर विचरा करती हे

16.sa: एष राजन् सहस्र अक्षम् पर्युपास्ते हरि ईश्वरः ।बलेन बल सम्पन्नो रम्भो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-१६॥।।
16.en: "O king! This Lord of monkeys, whom whether he is jumping like monkeys or standing is the leader of the leaders, whom the monkeys are looking at standing is called Dhamba, a mighty powerful, fearsome leader and Lord of monkeys. He is surrounded by a strong army like the thousand eyed Indra."

17.sa: यः स्थितम् योजने शैलम् गच्चन् पार्श्वेन सेवते ।ऊर्ध्वम् तथैव कायेन गतः प्राप्नोति योजनम् ॥६-२७-१७॥।।
17.en: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."
17.hi: हे राजन्‌ ! यह वानरराज इन्द्र के पास रहने बाला है । देखिये बड़ी भारी सेना को साथ शिये .हुए यह दर्भ नामक यूथप है

18.sa: यस्मान् न परमम् रूपम् चतुष्पादेषु विद्यते ।श्रुतः सम्नादनो नाम वानराणाम् पितामहः ॥६-२७-१८॥।।
18.en: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."
18.hi: यह एक योजन के अन्तर पर स्थित पर्वेत की बगल से कूद जाता है तथा उछुल कर आक्राशमाग से एक योजन तक चला जात है। अथवा जिसके गमनकाल में एक एक कदम में एक एक योजन के पवत पार्श्वस्थ अर्थात्‌ अत्यन्त निकटबती हो जाते हें और जो शरीर से उछलने पर एक) कुलांच में एक योजन कूद जाता है । अर्थात्‌ इसके शरीर की ऊँचाई एक योजन की है

19.sa: येन युद्धम् तदा दत्तम् रणे शक्रस्य धीमता ।पराजयः च न प्राप्तः सो अयम् यूथप यूथपः ॥६-२७-१९॥।।
19.en: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."

20.sa: यस्य विक्रममाणस्य शक्रस्य इव पराक्रमः ।एष गन्धर्व कन्यायाम् उत्पन्नः कृष्ण वर्त्मना ॥६-२७-२०॥।।
20.en: "His valour is equal to that of Indra. He is born to Gandharva, a maiden of the god of fire. He was created for the sake of assisting gods in the war between gods and demons."
20.hi: युद्धकाण्डे (र इसने बुद्धिमान इन्द्र के साथ युद्ध किस्ना, परन्तु हारा नहीं--से। यह भी यूथपतियों का सरदार है

21.sa: तत्र देवासुरे युद्धे साह्यार्थम् त्रिदिवौकसाम् ।यत्र वैश्रवणो राजा जम्बूमुपनिषेवते ॥६-२७-२१॥।।
21.en: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."
21.hi: यह पराक्रम में इन्द्र के समान है । यह गन्धर्वेकन्या के गर्भ से अग्नि द्वारा उत्पन्न हुआ है

22.sa: यो राजा पर्वत इन्द्राणाम् बहु किम्नर सेविनाम् ।विहार सुखदो नित्यम् भ्रातुस् ते राक्षस अधिप ॥६-२७-२२॥।।
22.en: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."
22.hi: देवासुर संग्राम में देवताओं की सहायता करने के लिए यह्‌ उत्पन्न किआ गया था । यह बलवान वानरश्रेछ उस पवत पर रहता है, जो पव॑तों का राजा है, जिसके ऊपर अनेक किन्नर रहा करते हैं और जिप्त पर तुम्हारे भाई राजा कुबेर को बिहार करने में आनन्द प्राप्त होता हे तथा जहाँ पर कुबेर जी जामुन के वृक्ष के नीचे बैठा करते हैं । इसका नाम क्रथन है और युद्ध में क्रियात्मक रूप से पराक्रम प्रदर्शन करता है, ( वाणी से अपने पराक्रम की डींगे नदीं हाँकता । ) यह भी एक यूथपति है.

23.sa: तत्र एष वसति श्रीमान् बलवान् वानर ऋषभः ।युद्धेष्व् अकत्थनो नित्यम् क्रथनो नाम यूथपः ॥६-२७-२३॥।।
23.en: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."

24.sa: वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण हरीणाम् समवस्थितः ।एषैवाशम्सते लङ्काम् स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२७-२४॥।।
24.en: "He is surrounded with thousand crores of his Vanara force and with his own force he intends to crush Lanka."

25.sa: यो गङ्गामनुपर्येति त्रासयन् गजयूथपान् ।हस्तिनाम् वानराणाम् च पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ॥६-२७-२५॥।।
25.en: "There is one who roams around Ganga, frightening herds of elephants, remembering the earlier enmity between elephants and Vanaras. This leader of commanders goes about mountain caves, trees and mountains waging war with elephants."
25.hi: फन > > सँध्तविरी सेरे? २३४ सहस्र कोटि वानरों को साथ ले यह आया है । यह वीर भी केवल अपनी सेना ही से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करने की इच्छा रखता है

26.sa: एष यूथपतिर्नेता गर्जन् गिरिगुहाशयः ।गजान् रोधयते वन्यानारुजम्श्च महीरुहान् ॥६-२७-२६॥।।
26.en: "There is one who roams around Ganga, frightening herds of elephants, remembering the earlier enmity between elephants and Vanaras. This leader of commanders goes about mountain caves, trees and mountains waging war with elephants."
26.hi: जो हाथियों और वानरों के पूर्वकालीन पारस्परिक बैर का स्मरण कर, गजेन्द्रा के यूथपतियों को गङ्गा के निकट डराता है

27.sa: हरीणाम् वाहिनी मुख्यो नदीम् हैमवतीम् अनु ।उशीर बीजम् आश्रित्य पर्वतम् मन्दर उपमम् ॥६-२७-२७॥।।
27.en: "The chief of the army of monkeys and the excellent one among Vanaras revels on the mountain Usirabeejam like the mountain Mandara on the bank of river Hymavathi just as Indra in heaven."
27.hi: सो यह यूथपतियों का सरदार है और घूमफिर कर अर्थात्‌ ढंढाढूंढ कर गिरिगुहाओं में रहने वाले गर्जो, जंगली वृक्षा ओर पहाड़ों से लडाता हे। अर्थात्‌ गर्जा को उठा कर वृक्षों पर दे मारता हे और वृक्षों को उखाड़ कर गजों पर पटक देता हे । इसी प्रकार पवतो पर हाथियों को पटक देता है ओर पर्वत हाथियों पर

28.sa: रमते वानर श्रेष्ठो दिवि शक्र इव स्वयम् ।एनम् शत सहस्राणाम् सहस्रम् अभिवर्तते ॥६-२७-२८॥।।
28.en: "Thousand lakhs of mighty strong Vanaras who are proud of their valour and prowess roaring like lions follow him."
28.hi: यह बानरों की सेना का मुखिया समभा जाता है, यह पवतो- ततम मन्दराचल के उवीरशीज नामक पंबेत पर स्वग में इन्द्र की ` तरह रहता दै । इसके अधीन कई लाख वानर हैं

29.sa: वीर्यविक्रमदृप्तानाम् नर्दताम् बाहुशालिनाम् ।स एष नेता न्हैतेषाम् वानराणाम् महात्मनम् ॥६-२७-२९॥।।
29.en: "He alone is the leader of the great Vanaras, O king. He is called Pramathi, a commander and a difficult one to resist."
29.hi: पाठान्तरे“ दीर्घ लाङगूलमाश्रिता; | २३० युद्धकाण्डे जिसकी पूछ के बाल चिकने ल॑वे आर नड़ सघन हैं. तथा जिनकी रंगत, लाल, पीली, घुमैली, सफेद हैं आर जों पूछ के इंधर उधर छिटक हुए बड़े भयङ्कर जान पड़ते ह

30.sa: स एष दुर्मर्षणो राजन् प्रमाथी नाम यूथपः ।वातेन इव उद्धतम् मेघम् यम् एनम् अनुपश्यसि ॥६-२७-३०॥।।
30.en: "You see him (Pramathi) who resembles a cloud risen up by the wind you may also see the reddish brown dust particles lifted up by excessive whirling of the wind all over and also the furious Vanara army moving swiftly."
30.hi: इसकी सेना के वीर अपने बलपराक्रम के अभिमान में चूर हो, गरजा करते हैं| यह वानर उन संब बलवान वानरों का नायक है

31.sa: अनीकमपि सम्रब्धम् वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम् ।उद्धूतमरुणाभासम् पवनेन समन्ततः ॥६-२७-३१॥।।
31.en: "You see him (Pramathi) who resembles a cloud risen up by the wind you may also see the reddish brown dust particles lifted up by excessive whirling of the wind all over and also the furious Vanara army moving swiftly."
31.hi: हे राजन्‌! इधर देखिये, वायु से प्रेरित मेघ की तरह जो . दिखलाई दे रहा है, सो यह बड़ा दुर्धेषे वानर है। इसका नाम प्रमाथी है और यह भी यूथपति हे

32.sa: विवर्तमानम् बहुशो यत्र एतद् बहुलम् रजः ।एते असित मुखा घोरा गो लान्गूला महाबलाः ॥६-२७-३२॥।।
32.en: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."

33.sa: शतम् शत सहस्राणि दृष्ट्वा वै सेतु बन्धनम् ।गो लान्गूलम् महावेगम् गव अक्षम् नाम यूथपम् ॥६-२७-३३॥।।
33.en: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."
33.hi: बहुत सी धूल का बवंडर वह रहा है । ये काले मुख के भयङ्कर महाबली गोलाङ्ग,ल

34.sa: परिवार्य अभिवर्तन्ते लंकाम् मर्दितुम् ओजसा ।भ्रमर आचरिता यत्र सर्व काम फल द्रुमाः ॥६-२७-३४॥।।
34.en: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
34.hi: लाखों की संख्या में सेतु के ऊपर देख पड़ते हैं, उनका यूथपति गवाक्ष हे जो बड़ा वेगवान है

35.sa: यम् सूर्य तुल्य वर्ण आभम् अनुपर्येति पर्वतम् ।यस्य भासा सदा भान्ति तद् वर्णा मृग पक्षिणः ॥६-२७-३५॥।।
35.en: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
35.hi: इसी गवाक्ष युथपति को घेरे हुए समस्त गोलाङ्गल, लक्का को अपने वल से ध्वस्त करना चाहते हें । जहाँ पर भोरे सदा मँडराया करते हें । और जहाँ वृक्षों में सदा फल लगे रहते हैं

36.sa: यस्य प्रस्थम् महात्मानो न त्यजन्ति महर्षयः ।सर्वकामफला वृक्षाः सर्वे फलसमन्विताः ॥६-२७-३६॥।।
36.en: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
36.hi: सूये अपना वर्ण बाला समझ, जिस पर्वेत की सदा परिक्रमा किआ करते हैं और जहाँ की अरुण कान्ति से उस स्थानवासी समस्त मृग और पक्षी उसी रंग जैसे दैख पड़ते है

37.sa: मधूनि च महार्हाणि यस्मिन् पर्वतसत्तमे ।तत्र एष रमते राजन् रम्ये कान्चन पर्वते ॥६-२७-३७॥।।
37.en: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
37.hi: के शि जी महार रित्याग नहीं करते जिसके शिखर को महात्मा महर्षि कभी परित्याग जहाँ पर सर्वकामना पूरी करने वाले इक्ष सदा फला करते हैं

38.sa: मुख्यो वानर मुख्यानाम् केसरी नाम यूथपः ।षष्टिर् गिरि सहस्राणाम् रम्याः कान्चन पर्वताः ॥६-२७-३८॥।।
38.en: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."
38.hi: पाठान्तरे “ सर्वकामफलद्रुमाः र २३८ युद्धका ए ओर जिस परेत श्रेष्ठ पर बढ़िया मधु आदि मोठे पदार्थ पन्न होते हैं, हे राजन्‌! उसी रमणीय काञ्चनमय पर्वत पर, वानरश्रष्ठां में मुख्य, केसरी नामक यूथपति रसता है। साठ हजार रमणीक काञ्चनमय पवतां के बीच सोवणि नामक पर्वत सब पवतों में वैसा ही श्रेष्ठ है जैसे कि, राक्षसो में आप पाप- रहित पीले, सफेइ,मधुपिङ्गल ( शहद की तरह पीले) रंग के लाल मुख वाले वानर

39.sa: तेषाम् मध्ये गिरि वरस् त्वम् इव अनघ रक्षसाम् ।तत्र एते कपिलाः श्वेतास् ताम्र आस्या मधु पिन्गलाः ॥६-२७-३९॥।।
39.en: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."

40.sa: निवसन्ति उत्तम गिरौ तीक्ष्ण दम्ष्ट्रा नख आयुधाः ।सिम्ह इव चतुर् दम्ष्ट्रा व्याघ्रा इव दुरासदाः ॥६-२७-४०॥।।
40.en: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."

41.sa: सर्वे वैश्वनर समा ज्वलित आशी विष उपमाः ।सुदीर्घ अन्चित लान्गूला मत्त मातम्ग सम्निभाः ॥६-२७-४१॥।।
41.en: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."
41.hi: उस पवतोत्तम पर रहते हैं। उनके शस्त्र हैं उनके पेने पेने दाँत और नख | सिंह की तरह इनके चौघड़े हैं और व्याघ्र की तरह ये दुधष हैं

42.sa: महापर्वत सम्काशा महाजीमूत निस्वनाः ।वृत्तपिङ्गलनेत्रा हि महाभीमगतिस्वनाः ॥६-२७-४२॥।।
42.en: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."
42.hi: यह सब के सब अभि की तरह उप्र हैं और कुपित सर्प के विष की तरह महाभयङ्कर हैं । इनकी बड़ी लंबी और उमठवाँ पूंछ हैं और मतवाले हाथी की तरह ये चलते हें

43.sa: मर्दयन्तीव ते सर्वे तस्थुर्लङ्काम् समीक्ष्य ते ।एष चैषामधिपतिर्मध्ये तिष्ठति वीर्यवान् ॥६-२७-४३॥।।
43.en: "O king! He who is known as Satabali, is a famous one on the earth, is a valiant hero, a leader. He stands in the middle aspiring for victory ever worshipping Sun. He alone with his army is intending to demolish Lanka."
43.hi: बड़े पवत की तरह लंबे तडंगे हैं और महामेघ की तरह गरजा करते हैं । उनकी गोल गोल पीली पोली आँखें हैं। वे बढी ही भयङ्कर गति वाले और डरावनी बोली बोलने वाले हैं

44.sa: जयार्थी नित्यमादित्यमुपतिष्ठति बुद्धिमान् ।नाम्ना पृथिव्याम् विख्यातो राजन् शत बली इति यः ॥६-२७-४४॥।।
44.en: "O king! He who is known as Satabali, is a famous one on the earth, is a valiant hero, a leader. He stands in the middle aspiring for victory ever worshipping Sun. He alone with his army is intending to demolish Lanka."

45.sa: एष एव आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ।विक्रान्तो बलवान् शूरः पौरुषे स्वे व्यवस्थितः ॥६-२७-४५॥।।
45.en: "He is indomitable, strong and heroic. He will not give up his virility. For the pleasure of Rama, he will not feel pity for his life (he will give up his life)."

46.sa: रामप्रियार्थम् प्राणानाम् दयाम् न कुरुते हरिः ।गजो गव अक्षो गवयो नलो नीलः च वानरः ।एक एक एव यूथानाम् कोटिभिर् दशभिर् वृतः ॥६-२७-४६॥।।
46.en: "Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Nila each of these Vanara leaders have ten crores of army under them."
46.hi: यह बुद्धिमान वानर विजय प्राप्त की इच्छा से नित्य सुय की आराधना किआ करता है और हे राजन्‌! इस संसार में यह शातंबली के नास से प्रसिद्ध है ॥ ४३९५४ 58 ६ हि ई एषे बाशंसते सङ्कां स्वेनानीकेन मदि तुम्‌ । विक्रान्तो बलवाञ्शूरः पौरुषे स्वे व्यस्थितः

47.sa: तथा अन्ये वानर श्रेष्ठा विन्ध्य पर्वत वासिनः ।न शक्यन्ते बहुत्वात् तु सम्ख्यातुम् लघु विक्रमाः ॥६-२७-४७॥।।
47.en: "So also, those best of Vanaras of many kinds residing in Vindhya mountain of great valour in large numbers is impossible to count."
47.hi: यह श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की प्रसन्नता सम्पादन करने के लिए अपने प्राणों को तुच्छ समझता है । हे राजन्‌ । गज, गवाक्ष, गवय, नल और नील नामक जो बान्र हैँ

48.sa: सर्वे महाराज महाप्रभावाः ।सर्वे महाशैल निकाश कायाः ।सर्वे समर्थाः पृथिवीम् क्षणेन ।कर्तुम् प्रविध्वस्त विकीर्ण शैलाम् ॥६-२७-४८॥
48.en: "O, Monarch! All of them are highly prominent, their stature equal to high hills and all of them are capable of levelling the earth by uprooting and razing its mountains to the ground in a moment." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेसप्तविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty seventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणम् राक्षस अधिपम् ।बलम् आलोकयन् सर्वम् शुको वाक्यम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-२८-१॥।।
1.en: Then Ravana the king of Rakshasas having heard Saarana's words and described the strength (of Vanaras) Suka spoke these words.
1.hi: युद्धकाण्ड का सत्ताइसवाँ सगे पूरा हुआ विं £ अधष्टाविशः संगः सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणं राच्चसाथिपम्‌ । बलमादिश्य तत्सव शुक्रो वक्यमथात्रवीत्‌

2.sa: स्थितान् पश्यसि यान् एतान् मत्तान् इव महाद्विपान् ।न्यग्रोधान् इव गान्गेयान् सालान् हैमवतीन् इव ॥६-२८-२॥।।
2.en: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."
2.hi: हे राजन्‌ ! a जिन वानरों को मतबाले गजराजों, गङ्गा- तटवतां बटवृक्षो, हिमालयस्थित शालवृक्षों की तरह खड़े हुए देख रहे हें

3.sa: एते दुष्प्रसहा राजन् बलिनः काम रूपिणः ।दैत्य दानव सम्काशा युद्धे देव पराक्रमाः ॥६-२८-३॥।।
3.en: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."
3.hi: ये सब के सत्र दुर्धध, बलवान और इच्छा-रूपधारी हैं और दृत्यदानवॉको तरह बलसम्पन्न तथा युद्ध में देवतओं की तरह पणक्रमी;हें

4.sa: एषाम् कोटि सहस्राणि नव पन्च च सप्त च ।तथा शन्ख सहस्राणि तथा वृन्द शतानि च ॥६-२८-४॥।।
4.en: "These Vanaras are nine, five and seven thousand crores in number. They are in many thousands of Sankhas and Vrindas."

5.sa: एते सुग्रीव सचिवाः किष्किन्धा निलयाः सदा ।हरयो देव गन्धर्वैर् उत्पन्नाः काम रूपिणः ॥६-२८-५॥।।
5.en: "These are allies of Sugriva ever residing at Kishkinda. They are born to celestial gods and Gandharvas and can change their form at their will."
5.hi: ये सब सुग्रीव के सहायक हैं और किष्किन्धा मेर हा करते हैं । इन वानरों की उप्पत्ति, गन्धो से है और ये इच्छानुसार रुप धारण करने वाले हैं

6.sa: यौ तौ पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तौ कुमारौ देव रूपिणौ ।मैन्दः च द्विविदः च उभौ ताभ्याम् न अस्ति समो युधि ॥६-२८-६॥।।
6.en: "Do you see two of them standing there? They are young and have the form of gods. They are Mainda and Dwivida. Both of them are similar in war and none equal them in war."
6.hi: सुग्रीवसचिवाः-सुग्रीवसहायाः । ( गो० ) २ कुमारौ-युवानौ । २४२ युद्धकाण्डे आप जिन देवताओं के समान रूपवान्‌ दो युवकों को बैठा हुआ देख रहे हैं, वे दोनों मेन्द और द्विविद हें । युद में उन दोनों का सामना करने वाला कोई नहीं हे

7.sa: ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाताव् अमृत प्राशिनाव् उभौ ।आशम्सेते युधा लंकाम् एतौ मर्दितुम् ओजसा ॥६-२८-७॥।।
7.en: "They drank the nectar of immortality with the permission of Brahma. These leaders are aspiring to destroy Lanka by their prowess."
7.hi: क्योंकि ब्रह्मा की आज्ञा से. इन दोनों ने अस्त पान ला हे ये दोनों अपने पराक्रम से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चहते हैं

8.sa: यम् तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तम् प्रभिन्नम् इव कुन्जरम् ।यो बलात् क्षोभयेत् क्रुद्धः समुद्रम् अपि वानरः ॥६-२८-८॥।।
8.en: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."

9.sa: एषो अभिगन्ता लंकाया वैदेह्यास् तव च प्रभो ।एनम् पश्य पुरा दृष्टम् वानरम् पुनर् आगतम् ॥६-२८-९॥।।
