9.en: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."

10.sa: ज्येष्ठः केसरिणः पुत्रो वात आत्मज इति श्रुतः ।हनूमान् इति विख्यातो लन्घितो येन सागरः ॥६-२८-१०॥।।
10.en: "He is the eldest son born of Kesari and the son of WindGod and is popularly known as Hanuman. He leapt over the sea and came."

11.sa: काम रूपी हरि श्रेष्ठो बल रूप समन्वितः ।अनिवार्य गतिः चैव यथा सततगः प्रभुः ॥६-२८-११॥।।
11.en: "He is a jewel among Vanaras. He can change his form at his will. He is endowed with physical strength and charm. Being existent everywhere like windgod his cause cannot be prevented like that of wind god."
11.hi: हो पेट अष्टावशाः सँग: २४२ सो इसे आप पहिले देख ही चुके हैं, वद्दी फिर आयां है! यह केसरी का श्रेष्ठ पुत्र हे और वातात्मन अथात्‌ वाउउद्र के नाम से प्रतिद्व हे

12.sa: उद्यन्तम् भास्करम् दृष्ट्वा बालः किल पिपासितः ।त्रियोजन सहस्रम् तु अध्वानम् अवतीर्य हि ॥६-२८-१२॥।।
12.en: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."
12.hi: इसक १ नाम है. और इसीने समुद्र लाचा था। यह ७ कक का कर लेता है, वानरों में श्रेष्ठ है. ओर बड़ा बलवान्‌ है

13.sa: आदित्यम् आहरिष्यामि न मे क्षुत् प्रतियास्यति ।इति सम्चिन्त्य मनसा पुरा एष बल दर्पितः ॥६-२८-१३॥।।
13.en: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."

14.sa: अनाधृष्यतमम् देवम् अपि देव ऋषि दानवैः ।अनासाद्य एव पतितो भास्कर उदयने गिरौ ॥६-२८-१४॥।।
14.en: "Unassailable even for gods, sages and Danavas to reach the Sun god, he fell down near the eastern part."
14.hi: शि वायु की तरह इसकी गति कहीं भी नहीं रुकती, लड़कपन ५ एक दिन इसे भूख लगी । उस समय सूर्य उद्य हो रहा था ॥१३ A Ce त्रियोजनसहस्र तु अध्वानमबताय हि । आदित्यमाहरिष्यामि न मे क्षुत्ततियास्यति

15.sa: पतितस्य कपेर् अस्य हनुर् एका शिला तले ।किम्चिद् भिन्ना दृढ हनोर् हनूमान् एष तेन वै ॥६-२८-१५॥।।
15.en: "By falling on the mountain one of the jaws of the monkey got broken. This is the reason that he is known as Hanuman."

16.sa: सत्यम् आगम योगेन मम एष विदितो हरिः ।न अस्य शक्यम् बलम् रूपम् प्रभावो वा अनुभाषितुम् ॥६-२८-१६॥।।
16.en: "I came to know about him through one of my contacts. His strength, his appearance and glory are indescribable."

17.sa: एष आशम्सते लंकाम् एको मर्दितुम् ओजसा ।येव जाज्वल्यतेऽसौ वै धूमकेतुस्तवाद्य वै ॥६-२८-१७॥।।
17.en: "This monkey is intending to demolish this Lanka single handed. How can you forget about (the task of) setting his tail on fire entrusted by you to Dhoomakethu?"
17.hi: थोड़ी सी टूट गई । क्‍योंकि ठोड़ी इसको बड़ी मजबूत थी, ख इसका नाम हनुमान हुआ । वानरों के सहवास से यद्यपि स॑ने इस वानर का यह हाल जान लिआ हे

18.sa: लंकायाम् निहितश्चापि कथम् विस्मरसे कसिम् ।यः च एषो अनन्तरः शूरः श्यामः पद्म निभ ईक्षणः ॥६-२८-१८॥।।
18.en: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."
18.hi: „चास्य शक्यं बलं रूपं प्रभावो वाऽपि भाषितुम्‌ । एष आशंसते लङ्कामेको मदितुमोजसा ॥ १८. तथापि मैं इसका वल, रूप और प्रभाव वणन नहीं कर सकता" यह अकेला, अपने बल ही से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चाहता है

19.sa: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् अतिरथो लोके विख्यात पौरुषः ।यस्मिन् न चलते धर्मो यो धर्मम् न अतिवर्तते ॥६-२८-१९॥।।
19.en: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."

20.sa: यो ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् वेदामः च वेद वेदविदाम् वरः ।यो भिन्द्याद् गगनम् बाणैः पर्वतामः च अपि दारयेत् ॥६-२८-२०॥।।
20.en: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."
20.hi: धूमकेतुरग्निः | ( रा० ) अ पाठान्तरे--“जाज्वल्यते उसौवे ? श्रष्टाविशः सग; २४५ हनुमान के पास ही जो शूर श्यामवण्‌, कमलनयन, इक्ष्वाकु कुल में अजेय योद्धा और संसार में विख्यात पराक्रमी हैं

21.sa: यस्य मृत्योर् इव क्रोधः शक्रस्य इव पराक्रमः ।यस्य भार्या जन्स्थानात्सीता चापि हृता त्वया ॥६-२८-२१॥।।
21.en: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."
21.hi: जो धर्म से तो कभी डिगते हैं और न धम की मर्यादा को उल्लड्कन ही करते हैं, जो त्रह्माख का चलाना जानते हैं, जो वेदों को केबल जानते ही नहीं, बल्कि वेदवेत्ताओं में श्रेष्ठ माने जाते हैं

22.sa: स एष रामस् त्वाम् योद्धुम् राजन् समभिवर्तते ।यः च एष दक्षिणे पार्श्वे शुद्ध जाम्बू नद प्रभः ॥६-२८-२२॥।।
22.en: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."
22.hi: जो अपने बाणों से आकाश को छेद सकते हे ऑर पंव ता को विदीर्ण कर सकते हैं, जिनका क्रोध, मृत्यु के समान ऑर पराक्रम इन्द्र की तरह दे

23.sa: विशाल वक्षास् ताम्र अक्षो नील कुन्चित मूर्धजः ।एषो अस्य लक्ष्मणो नाम भ्राता प्राण समः प्रियः ॥६-२८-२३॥।।
23.en: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."
23.hi: आर जिनकी खी सीता को तुम जनस्थान से हर लाए हो हे राजन्‌! वे ही श्रीरामचन्द्र तुमसे लड़ने के लिए यहाँ आए हैं

24.sa: नये युद्धे च कुशलः सर्व शास्त्रभृताम् वरः ।अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली ॥६-२८-२४॥।।
24.en: "He is one who does not forgive (Rama's enemies), difficult to win, indomitable, victorious, strong and wise one. He is the right hand of Rama and external breath of his life."

25.sa: रामस्य दक्षिणो बाहुर् नित्यम् प्राणो बहिः चरः ।न हि एष राघवस्य अर्थे जीवितम् परिरक्षति ॥६-२८-२५॥।।
25.en: "For the cause of Rama, he will spare his life. He too is intent upon destroying all Rakshasas."
25.hi: उनकी दहिनी ओर विशुद्ध सुवण वण जैसे, चौड़ी छाती वाले, अरुणनयन तथा नीले रंग के और घुंघराले बालों से RR क Ee # पाठान्तरे--धमै नातिबतेते ।? PROC el le 0 0 का २४६ युद्धकाण्डे एषोऽस्य लक्ष्मणे नाम आता प्राणसमः प्रियः । नये युद्धे च कुशलः सवंशस्रभृतां वरः

26.sa: एष एव आशम्सते युद्धे निहन्तुम् सर्व राक्षसान् ।यस् तु सव्यम् असौ पक्षम् रामस्य आश्रित्य तिष्ठति ॥६-२८-२६॥।।
26.en: "The one who is near Rama's left who sought Rama's refuge and stands surrounded by Rakshasas and protected is the king Vibheeshana."
26.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का अपचार इनसे नहीं सहा जाता, इनको रण में कोई जीत नहीं सकता । ये सबको जीतने बाले है, ये बड़े पराक्रमी, बुद्धिमान्‌ और बलवान्‌ हे । ये श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की दृहिनी बाँह और उनके प्राणों के संरक्षक हैं

27.sa: रक्षो गण परिक्षिप्तो राजा हि एष विभीषणः ।श्रीमता राज राजेन लंकायाम् अभिषेचितः ॥६-२८-२७॥।।
27.en: "He is a prosperous king of the kings of Lanka. He has been consecrated by Rama, filled with anger he is advancing to wage war with you."
27.hi: ये श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की र्षा के लिए अपने प्राणां को हथेली पर रखे हुए, सदा तैयार रहते हे । युद्ध में ये अकेले ही समस्त राक्षसों को मार डालने का उत्साह रखते हे

28.sa: त्वाम् एव प्रतिसम्रब्धो युद्धाय एषो अभिवर्तते ।यम् तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तम् मध्ये गिरिम् इव अचलम् ॥६-२८-२८॥।।
28.en: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

29.sa: सर्व शाखा मृग इन्द्राणाम् भर्तारम् अपराजितम् ।तेजसा यशसा बुद्ध्या ज्ञानेन अभिजनेन च ॥६-२८-२९॥।।
29.en: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

30.sa: यः कपीन् अति बभ्राज हिमवान् इव पर्वतान् ।किष्किन्धाम् यः समध्यास्ते गुहाम् सगहन द्रुमाम् ॥६-२८-३०॥।।
30.en: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."
30.hi: जिनको आप एक अचल पवत की तरह श्रीरामचन्द्र और विभीषण के बीचमें बैठा हुआ देखते हे, वे ही समस्त वानरों के राजा हैं, इनको पराजित करना .सहूज नहीं

31.sa: दुर्गाम् पर्वत दुर्गस्थाम् प्रधानैः सह यूथपैः ।यस्य एषा कान्चनी माला शोभते शत पुष्करा ॥६-२८-३१॥।।
31.en: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."
31.hi: तेजस्विता, यश, ऊहापोहरुपी-ज्ञान, शास्त्रजन्य-ज्ञान तथा, कुल की विशिष्टता के कारण, पवतां में हिमाचल पर्वत की तरह, समस्त वानरों से यह अधिक शोभा पा रहा है

32.sa: कान्ता देव मनुष्याणाम् यस्याम् लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता ।एताम् च मालाम् ताराम् च कपि राज्यम् च शाश्वतम् ॥६-२८-३२॥।।
32.en: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."
32.hi: दे राजन्‌ ! यह वानरराज, वानर यूथपतियाँ के साथ किष्कि- न्धा में एक ऐसी गिरगुहा में , रहते हैं, जो सघन वृक्षा से आच्छादित है और जहाँ पहुँचना बड़ा कठिन है

33.sa: सुग्रीवो वालिनम् हत्वा रामेण प्रतिपादितः ।शतम् शतसहस्राणाम् कोटिमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥६-२८-३३॥।।
33.en: "It is said by wise men that hundred thousand crores multiplied by hundred thousand crores as Sankha."
33.hi: देवताओं और मनुष्यां की बाञ्छनोय लक्ष्मी जिसमें सदा बास करती हैं, वह शतपद्या सोने की माला कपिराज के गले में कैसी शोभित हो रही है

34.sa: शतम् कोटिसहस्राणाम् शङ्कुरित्यभिधीयते ।शतम् शङ्कुसहस्राणाम् महाशङ्कुरिति स्मृतः ॥६-२८-३४॥।।
34.en: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
34.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने यह माला, तारा और वानरं का सनातन ( प्राचीन ) राज्य बाली को मार कर इस सुग्रीव को दिलाया है

35.sa: महाशङ्क्य्सहस्राणाम् शतम् वृन्दमिहोच्यते ।शतम् नृन्दसहस्राणाम् महावृन्दमिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३५॥।।
35.en: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.

36.sa: महावृन्दसहस्राणाम् शतम् पद्ममिहोच्यते ।शतम् पद्मसहस्राणाम् महापद्ममिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३६॥।।
36.en: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
36.hi: सौ हजार शक्ठ का एक महाशङ्घ होता है । सौ हजार महा- शङ्क का एक इन्द होता है

37.sa: महापद्मसहस्राणाम् शतम् खर्वमिहोच्यते ।शतम् खर्वसहस्राणाम् महाखर्वमिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३७॥।।
37.en: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
37.hi: सौ हजार वृन्द का एक महावृन्द होता है । सौ हजार महा- « बृन्द का एक पद्म होता है

38.sa: महाखर्वसहस्राणाम् समुद्रमभिधीयते ।शतम् समुद्रसाहस्रमोघ इत्यभिधीयते ॥६-२८-३८॥।।
38.en: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
38.hi: सौ हजार पद्म का महापद्म और रौ हजार महापद़ा का एक खव होता है

39.sa: शतमोघसहस्राणाम् महौघ इति विश्रुतः ।एवम् कोटि सहस्रेण शन्कूनाम् च शतेन च ॥६-२८-३९॥।।
39.en: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

40.sa: महाशङ्कुसहस्रेण तथा वृन्दशतेन च ।महावृन्दसहस्रेण तथा पद्मशतेन च ॥६-२८-४०॥।।
40.en: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.
40.hi: सौ हजर समुद्र का एक माघ और सौ हजार मोघ का एक महीघ होता दै

41.sa: महापद्मसहस्रेण तथा खर्वशतेन च ।समुद्रेण च तेनैव महुघेन तथैव च ॥६-२८-४१॥।।
41.en: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

42.sa: एष कोटिमहौघेन समुद्रसदृशेन च ।विभीषणेन वीरेण सचिवैः परिवारितः ॥६-२८-४२॥।।
42.en: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

43.sa: सुग्रीवो वानर इन्द्रस् त्वाम् युद्ध अर्थम् अभिवर्तते ।महाबलवृतो नित्यम् महाबलपराक्रमः ॥६-२८-४३॥।।
43.en: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.
43.hi: एक सौ समुद्र और एक सौ कोटि महष संख्यक बानुट्री सेना है, जो समुद्र की तरह देख पड़ती है

44.sa: इमाम् महाराज समीक्ष्य वाहिनीम् ।उपस्थिताम् प्रज्वलित ग्रह उपमाम् ।ततः प्रयत्नः परमो विधीयताम् ।यथा जयः स्यान् न परैः पराजयः ॥६-२८-४४॥
44.en: "O Great King! Observing the ocean of army close by their appearing cruel like a blazing planet, make supreme efforts to be victorious and not to be defeated in the hands of the enemy." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टाविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
44.hi: महाबलबृतो नित्यं महाबलपराक्रमः। ४४.॥ 5 २४० युद्धकाण्डे इतनी बढी वानरी सेना तथा सचिवों सहित विभीषण को साथ लिए हुए कापराज सुग्रीव, आपसे लड़ने को उपस्थित हुए हैं । वानरेन्द्र के साथ बड़ी भारी सेना है ; जो बड़ी बलवान्‌ और पराक्रमी है

45.hi: इति अष्टाविंशः सग; हे महाराज ! जाज्वल्यमान ग्रह की तरह इस उपस्थित वानरी सेना को देख कर, आप ऐसा प्रयत्न करें, जिससे आपकी जीत हो ओर शत्रु से हार खानी न पड़े

1.sa: शुकेन तु समाख्याताम्स् तान् दृष्ट्वा हरि यूथपान् ।लक्ष्मणम् च महावीर्यम् भुजम् रामस्य दक्षिणम् ॥६-२९-१॥।।
1.en: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.
1.hi: युद्धकाण्ड का अट्ठाइसवाँ सगे पूरा हुआ । —B— एकोनत्रिंशः सगः तन £ लान" शुकेन तु समाख्यातांस्तान्‌ दृष्टा हरियूथपान्‌ । समीपस्थं च रामस्य भ्रातर स्वं विभीषणम्‌

2.sa: समीपस्थम् च रामस्य भ्रातरम् स्वम् विभीषणम् ।सर्व वानर राजम् च सुग्रीवम् भीम विक्रमम् ॥६-२९-२॥।।
2.en: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

3.sa: अङ्गदम् चापि बलिनम् वज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् ।हनूमन्तम् च विक्रान्तम् जाम्बवन्तम् च दुर्जयम् ॥६-२९-३॥।।
3.en: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

4.sa: सुषेणम् कुमुदम् नीलम् नलम् च प्लवगर्षभम् ।गजम् गवाक्षम् शरभम् वैन्दम् च द्विविदम् तथा ॥६-२९-४॥।।
4.en: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

5.sa: किम्चिद् आविग्न हृदयो जात क्रोधः च रावणः ।भर्त्सयाम् आस तौ वीरौ कथा अन्ते शुक सारणौ ॥६-२९-५॥।।
5.en: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.
5.hi: इनको देख कर रावण मन ही मन कुछ कुऊ उद्विग्न हुआ अर जब शुक सारण ने अपना कथन£समाप्त किआ, तब उसने क्रोध में भर, उन दोनों वीर शुक सारण की भत्संना को श्रोत्‌ डाटा डपटा

6.sa: अधो मुखौ तौ प्रणताव् अब्रवीत् शुक सारणौ ।रोष गद्गदया वाचा सम्रब्धः परुषम् वचः ॥६-२९-६॥।।
6.en: (That Ravana) with his throat choked with anger spoke indignantly and harshly to both Suka and Saarana who stood with their heads bent down in supplication.
6.hi: PR Corn २५२ : युद्धकाण्डे शुक और सारण अत्यन्त नब्रतापूबक सिर झुकाए खड़े थे । परन्तु रावण क्रोध में भर उनसे वडे कठोर वचन. कहने लेगा

7.sa: न तावत् सदृशम् नाम सचिवैर् उपजीविभिः ।विप्रियम् नृपतेर् वक्तुम् निग्रह प्रग्रहे विभोः ॥६-२९-७॥।।
7.en: "It is not proper for those ministers dependent on a capable ruler who has the power to check and hold forth, to speak that which is unpleasant."
7.hi: तुम लोगों ने मुझसे जैसे वचन कहे हैं, वैसे वचन क्या क्रिसी वेतनभोगी सचिव को अपने उस स्वामी के सामने, जो निग्रह अनुग्रह करने में समर्थ है, कहना उचित है ?

8.sa: रिपूणाम् प्रतिकूलानाम् युद्ध अर्थम् अभिवर्तताम् ।उभाभ्याम् सदृशम् नाम वक्तुम् अप्रस्तवे स्तवम् ॥६-२९-८॥।।
8.en: "Is it appropriate for both of you to praise the enemy this way before war?"
8.hi: युद्ध के लिए प्रस्तुत एवं अपने बिरांधी शत्रुओं की इस प्रकार अनवसर प्रशंसा करना; कया तुम दोनों को उचित था ?

9.sa: आचार्या गुरवो वृद्धा वृथा वाम् पर्युपासिताः ।सारम् यद् राज शास्त्राणाम् अनुजीव्यम् न गृह्यते ॥६-२९-९॥।।
9.en: "You have not grasped that which is the essence of political wisdom in the sastras in spite of waiting upon elders, teachers and parents which was in vain."

10.sa: गृहीतो वा न विज्ञातो भारो ज्ञानस्य वा उच्यते ।ईदृशैः सचिवैर् युक्तो मूर्खैर् दिष्ट्या धरामि अहम् ॥६-२९-१०॥।।
10.en: "Even if you have grasped you have not understood the meaning or out of intensity of your ignorance. Or else I am bearing foolish ones like you who are not fit to be ministers. Out of good luck I am ruling this sovereignty."
10.hi: आचार्या गुखो बद्धा बृथा वां पयंपास्षिताः । सार यद्राजशास्राणामनंजीव्यं न शृह्यते।। & ॥ छिः! आज तक आचाय, गुरु ओर वद्धजनां के पांस रह कर तुमने भाड़ ही भोका । एक वेतन मोगी को जो. समस्त राज- नीति की मुख्य मख्य बातें सीखनी उचित हैं--वे भी तुमने न सीखीं ॥ & ।। ` गृहीतो वा न विज्ञातो भारो ज्ञानस्य वोह्यते । ईदृशैः सचिपैय क्तो मूर्ख दिश्या धराम्यहम्‌ ॥ १०.॥ यदि सीखीं भी तो उनका मर्म तुमने न जाना। तुम तो केवल अज्ञान का बोझ ढो रहे हो । अथात्‌ तुम पल्लेसिरे के अज्ञानी हो ! इसे मैं अपना सौभाग्य ही समझता हूँ कि, तुम जैसे मूख मंत्रियों को, अपने पास रख कर भौ, में आज तक राज्य कर रहा हूँ

11.sa: किम् नु मृत्योर् भयम् न अस्ति माम् वक्तुम् परुषम् वचः ।यस्य मे शासतो जिह्वा प्रयच्चति शुभ अशुभम् ॥६-२९-११॥।।
11.en: "Did you not have fear of death when you spoke such harsh words to me, who can by mere order make good or evil to you?"
11.hi: अरे ! क्या तुमको अपनी जान जाने का ज़रा भी भय नहीं, जो तुमने मुझसे ऐसे कठोर वचन कहे ! क्यो तुम नहीं जानंते लोगों का मरना जीना मेरी जिह्वा के हिलते डुलने पर अर्थात्‌ मेरी आज्ञा पर निभर है.

12.sa: अपि एव दहनम् स्पृष्ट्वा वने तिष्ठन्ति पादपाः ।राज दोष परामृष्टास् तिष्ठन्ते न अपराधिनः ॥६-२९-१२॥।।
12.en: "Trees may remain unscathed even on touching forest fire, but those who are punishable do not remain unpunished on account of the king and are treated harshly."
12.hi: जदोषपराम्‌ः | यह तुम लोग भलीमाँति जान रखो कि, वन में आग लगने पर, उस वन के वृत्त भले ही भस्म होने से बच जाँय, किन्तु राज- द्रोह के अपराधी कभी नहीं वच सकते

13.sa: हन्याम् अहम् इमौ पापौ शत्रु पक्ष प्रशम्सकौ ।यदि पूर्व उपकारैर् मे न क्रोधो मृदुताम् व्रजेत् ॥६-२९-१३॥।।
13.en: "I would have slayed these two sinners who praise the enemy side, if my anger had not softened and remembered their earlier services."

14.sa: अपध्वम्सत गच्चध्वम् सम्निकर्षाद् इतो मम ।न हि वाम् हन्तुम् इच्चामि स्मरन्न् उपकृतानि वाम् ॥६-२९-१४॥।।
14.en: "You get away from here, disappear from here. On the contrary since I remember your earlier actions performed by you, I do not wish to kill you. Indeed, both of you are devoid of love and are ungrateful. You stand killed (already)."
14.hi: आँखों के सामते से इट जाओ, खबरदार अब तुम मेरी आंखों के सामने से इट , छु फ्रि मेरे सामने मत आना । मैं तुम्हें मारना नहीं चाहता । क्योंकि मुझे तुम्हारे उपकारों का स्मरण बना हुआ हे

15.sa: हताव् एव कृतघ्नौ तौ मयि स्नेह परान् मुखौ ।एवम् उक्तौ तु सव्रीडौ ताव् उभौ शुक सारणौ ॥६-२९-१५॥।।
15.en: Ravana, having spoken that way, both Suka and Saarana felt shy and withdrew from speaking words of praise of Ravana saying, 'Let you be victorious'.
15.hi: पछ २% युडूकाण तुम लोग जैसे कृतन्न और मेरे प्रति स्नेहशून्य दो रहे हो, इससे तो तुम निश्चय ही मार डालने योग्य हो । जब रावण ने डन दोनों शुक सारण से इस प्रकार कहा, तत्र वे बहत लज्जित हुए

16.sa: रावणम् जय शब्देन प्रतिनन्द्य अभिनिह्सृतौ ।अब्रवीत् स दशग्रीवः समीपस्थम् महाउदरम् ॥६-२९-१६॥।।
16.en: Ravana, the tenheaded one, then said to Mahodara who was standing nearby swiftly bring spies who are experts in policy to me.
16.hi: तब राक्षसेश्वर रावण ने उनको विश्वस्त) शूर, अपने -में _भक्तिमान और शात्रु,भय से निभय जान कर कहा

17.sa: उपस्थापय शीघ्रम् मे चारान् नीति विशारदान् ।महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तु शीघ्रमाज्ञापयच्चरान् ॥६-२९-१७॥।।
17.en: (Ravana) Having said so, Mahodara ordered the spies to approach the king quickly. On reaching they greeted the king with folded hand s promoting h i m to' be victorious' and stood.

18.sa: ततश्चाराः सम्त्वरिताः प्राप्ताः पार्थिवशासनात् ।उपस्थिथाः प्राञ्जलयो वर्धयित्वा जयाशिषः ॥६-२९-१८॥।।
18.en: (Ravana) Having said so, Mahodara ordered the spies to approach the king quickly. On reaching they greeted the king with folded hand s promoting h i m to' be victorious' and stood.
18.hi: है ततथारा; सन्त्वरिता; प्राप्ताः पाथिवशासनात्‌ । उपस्थिताः ग्राञ्जलयो वर्धयित्वा जयाशिषा ।:१८ ॥ रावणकी आज्ञा सुनते ही चर लोग तुरन्त ही उसके पास जा पहुँचे और “ जय हो ” ऐसा आशीर्वाद दे, हाथ जोड़े हुए खड़े हो गए

19.sa: तान् अब्रवीत् ततो वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ॥६-२९-१९॥।।
19.en: There upon the Lord of Rakshasas, spoke these words to those spies who are dependable ones, warriors devoid of fear of enemies.

20.sa: चारान् प्रत्ययिकान् शूरान् भक्तान् विगत साध्वसान् ।इतो गच्चत रामस्य व्यवसायम् परीक्षथ ॥६-२९-२०॥।।
20.en: "From here you go and reach there you may observe perceptions of Rama and of others close to him, his ministers and those who have reached there in affection to him."
20.hi: तुम लोग यहाँ से श्रीरामचन्द्र के पात जाओ और पता लगाओ कि, उनका इरादा किस समय क्या क्या करने का है। उनके अन्तरंगमंत्रो जो प्रीतिवश उनके साथ आये हैं, उनके कासा की भी टोह लगाना

21.sa: मन्त्रेष्व् अभ्यन्तरा ये अस्य प्रीत्या तेन समागताः ।कथम् स्वपिति जागर्ति किम् अन्यच् च करिष्यति ॥६-२९-२१॥।।
21.en: "You may see how he goes to sleep, how he wakes up etc., what he does, everything. You may come after knowing everything."
21.hi: राम क्या अकेले सोते हैं अथधा वे सोते हैं ओर अन्य लोग सोने के समय जाग कर उनकी रखवाली करते है ? आगे वे क्या करने वाले हैं-इन सब बातों का चुपके चुपके पता लगा कर, चले आना

22.sa: विज्ञाय निपुणम् सर्वम् आगन्तव्यम् अशेषतः ।चारेण विदितः शत्रुः पण्डितैर् वसुधा अधिपैः ॥६-२९-२२॥।।
22.en: "Wise kings of the land, having known about enemies from the spies destroy enemies in war with little effort."
22.hi: क्योंकि जो राजा चतुर होते ह्वै, वे दूतां ही के द्वारा अपने बैरी का सब हाल जान कर, रण में अस्पप्रयास ही से, शत्र, को भगा देते है

23.sa: युद्धे स्वल्पेन यत्नेन समासाद्य निरस्यते ।चारास् तु ते तथा इति उक्त्वा प्रहृष्टा राक्षस ईश्वरम् ॥६-२९-२३॥।।
23.en: The spies then gladly uttered the words 'be it so', went round the king in reverence and departed with Saardula leading in front.
23.hi: चरो ने “ जो आज्ञा ” कह कर और शादूल नामक चर को अपना अगुआ बना कर तथा प्रसन्न हो कर राक्षसेश्‍वर की प्रदक्षिणा की

24.sa: शार्दूलमग्रतः कृत्वा ततश्चक्रुः प्रदक्षिणम् ।ततस्तम् तु महात्मानम् चारा राक्षससत्तमम् ॥६-२९-२४॥।।
24.en: Then the spies circumambulated the great Rakshasa king and having done so went to the place where Rama and Lakshmana were stationed.
24.hi: तब वे चर लोग राक्षसोत्तम रावण की परिक्रमा कर वहाँ गए जहाँ लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ठहरे हुए थे

25.sa: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् जग्मुर् यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः ।ते सुवेलस्य शैलस्य समीपे राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥६-२९-२५॥।।
25.en: Reaching the Suvela mountain in disguise, they saw Rama and Lakshmana along with Sugriva and Vibheeshana.

26.sa: प्रच्चन्ना ददृशुर् गत्वा ससुग्रीव विभीषणौ ।प्रेक्षमाणाश्चमूम् ताम् च बभूवुर्भयविह्वलाः ॥६-२९-२६॥।।
26.en: Those Rakshasas were bewildered with fear on looking at the army. Righteous Vibheeshana recognized them on seeing them.
26.hi: ओर वे “जय जय” कह रावण को प्रणाम कर वहाँ से चले ` गए । तदनन्तर पास बैठे हुए महोदर से रावण ने कहा

27.sa: ते तु धर्म आत्मना दृष्टा राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसाः ।विभीषणेन तत्रस्था निगृहीता यदृच्चया ॥६-२९-२७॥।।
27.en: By chance Vibheeshana seized Saardula, the evil Rakshasa who was moving in that army.

28.sa: शार्दूलो ग्राहितस्त्वेकः पापोऽयमिति राक्षसः ।मोक्षितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-२९-२८॥।।
28.en: As the monkeys attempted to kill him (Saardula), compassionate Rama released him and also the other Rakshasas.
28.hi: ॥ १ निणहीताः=तर्जिताइत्यर्थः | ( गोऽ ) २ यहच्छया-शार्द,ला- तिरिक्तारादसाविभीषणेनदृष्टा अपियहच्छुया विभ्रीषणाज्ञांविनेवण्द्दीताः- शार्द,लस्तु अयमत्यन्तपापइतिकपिभिग्रीहितः | ( रा ) \ A ॥ क्षय 5 शं “ न एकोनत्रिशः सगः २५७ मोचितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः सवड्ठमेः | आ।नृऽशस्यन रामस्य मोचिता राक्षसा; परे ॥२८]| वानर तो उसको मार डालना चाहते थे, किन्तु श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उसे छुड़वा दिया। इसी प्रकार अन्य राक्षसचरों को भी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की दया ने छुड़वा दिया

29.sa: अनृशम्सेन रामेण मोक्षिता राक्षसाः सरे ।वानरैर् अर्दितास् ते तु विक्रान्तैर् लघु विक्रमैः ॥६-२९-२९॥।।
29.en: Harassed by the valorous and swift Vanaras, those Rakshasas lost their senses and returned to Lanka gasping and panting.

30.sa: पुनर् लंकाम् अनुप्राप्ताः श्वसन्तो नष्ट चेतसः ।ततो दशग्रीवम् उपस्थितास् ते ।चारा बहिर् नित्य चरा निशा चराः ।गिरेः सुवेलस्य समीप वासिनम् ।न्यवेदयन् भीम बलम् महाबलाः ॥६-२९-३०॥
30.en: Then those mighty night-ranging spies, ever ranging outside, reported to the ten-necked one the army of Rama that lay near the Suvela mountain.
30.hi: इति एको नत्रिशः सगः Es _. तदनन्तर, परराष्ट्रो का वृत्तान्त जानने के लिए सदा घूसनेः फिरने चाले उन राक्षसचरो ने दशानन रावण के पास जा, सुवे पवत के समीप छावनी डाले हुए पड़ी हुई भयङ्कर बानर- वाहिनी का वृत्तान्त कहा

1.sa: ततस्तमक्षोभ्य बलम् लंका अधिपतये चराः ।सुवेले राघवम् शैले निविष्टम् प्रत्यवेदयन् ॥६-३०-१॥।।
1.en: Thereafter, the spies reported to the king of Lanka that Raghava had camped with an unshakable army at the Suvela mountain.
1.hi: युद्धकाण्ड का उन्तीसवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । १ बहिनित्यचराः-परराष्ट्रे षु बृत्तन्तज्ञानाय सदा संचारशीलाः | (गो०) र ९ न्रिशः सगः —§B— ततस्तमचोम्यबलं लङ्काधिपतये चराः । सुवेले राघवं शैले निविष्टं प्रत्यवेदयन्‌

2.sa: चाराणाम् रावणः श्रुत्वा प्राप्तम् रामम् महाबलम् ।जात उद्वेगो अभवत् किम्चित् शार्दूलम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥६-३०-२॥।।
2.en: On hearing from the spies that Rama has camped with a great army, Ravana got a little panicky and said these words to Saardula.

3.sa: अयथावच् च ते वर्णो दीनः च असि निशा चर ।न असि कच्चिद् अमित्राणाम् क्रुद्धानाम् वशम् आगतः ॥६-३०-३॥।।
3.en: "O Forest ranger! Your face is not as it should be and also pitiable. Hope the angry enemies have not done anything to you."
3.hi: नस ! तेरे मख का बदला हुआ सा रंग हो रहा दै, तू दीन न र ती है, कहीं तु क्रुद्ध बैरियो के द्दार्थो में तो नहीं पड़ गया

4.sa: इति तेन अनुशिष्टस् तु वाचम् मन्दम् उदीरयत् ।तदा राक्षस शार्दूलम् शार्दूलो भय विह्वलः ॥६-३०-४॥।।
4.en: And there after questioned by him (Ravana) Saardula revealed these words overwhelmed by fear, in faint tone to the tiger among Rakshasas.

5.sa: न ते चारयितुम् शक्या राजन् वानर पुम्गवाः ।विक्रान्ता बलवन्तः च राघवेण च रक्षिताः ॥६-३०-५॥।।
5.en: "O King! the Vanara heroes are valiant and highly powerful. They are also protected by Rama. It is not possible to spy on them."
5.hi: हे राजन्‌ ! उस वानरी सेना में जासूसी नहीं हो सकती । यर्कोकि उप्तसें बड़े बड़े पराक्रमी और वलवान्‌ बानर हैं और श्रीरामचन्द्र सदा उनकी रक्षा किआ करते हैं

6.sa: न अपि सम्भाषितुम् शक्याः सम्प्रश्नो अत्र न लभ्यते ।सर्वतो रक्ष्यते पन्था वानरैः पर्वत उपमैः ॥६-३०-६॥।।
6.en: "It is not possible to converse with them or to question and or to examine, since they are guarded all over by mountains like Vanaras."
6.hi: उनसे न तो बातचीत ही हो सकती हे और न कुछ पू छपाँछ ही की जा सकती है। पवतां की तरह आकार बाले बानर, शिविर के रास्तों की चारों ओर रक्षा किश्रा करते हैं । अर्थात्‌ शिविर के मार्गो पर बड़े बड़े बानरों का बिकट पहरा हे

7.sa: प्रविष्ट मात्रे ज्ञातो अहम् बले तस्मिन्न् अचारिते ।बलाद् गृहीतो बहुभिर् बहुधा अस्मि विदारितः ॥६-३०-७॥।।
7.en: "No sooner I entered their army, I was detected. I was forcibly seized by their guards and rolled on the ground."

8.sa: जानुभिर् मुष्टिभिर् दन्तैस् तलैः च अभिहतो भृशम् ।परिणीतो अस्मि हरिभिर् बलवद्भिर् अमर्षणैः ॥६-३०-८॥।।
8.en: "The monkeys had beaten me with fists, bitten my palms with teeth, beaten me intensely and paraded me in the army indignantly."

9.sa: परिणीय च सर्वत्र नीतो अहम् राम सम्सदम् ।रुधिर आदिग्ध सर्व अन्गो विह्वलः चलित इन्द्रियः ॥६-३०-९॥।।
9.en: "With all my limbs wet with bleeding, control over senses lost, after parading, I was led to the assembly of Rama."

10.sa: हरिभिर् वध्यमानः च याचमानः कृत अन्जलिः ।राघवेण परित्रातो जीवामि ह यदृच्चया ॥६-३०-१०॥।।
10.en: "While smitten by the monkeys, offering salutation with folded hands, and pleading for protection from Raghava, luckily, I am alive."
10.hi: जब वानर मुझे मार डालने को तेयार हुए, तेव मैंने हाथ जोड़ कर प्राणों की भिक्षा माँगी । तब श्री रामचन्द्र जी ने अपनी इच्छा से ( किसी के अनुरोध से नहीं ) मेरे प्राण बचाए

11.sa: एष शैलैः शिलाभिः च पूरयित्वा महाअर्णवम् ।द्वारम् आश्रित्य लंकाया रामस् तिष्ठति सायुधः ॥६-३०-११॥।।
11.en: "Having filled the great ocean with rocks and stones in that way, taking position at the entrance of Lanka Rama stands equipped with arms."
11.hi: हे महाराज ! श्रोरामचन्द्र पवंतो और शिलाओं से महा पर पुल बाँध कर, लङ्का के द्वार पर हथियारों से सुसज्जित ता पहुँचे हैं

12.sa: गरुड व्यूहम् आस्थाय सर्वतो हरिभिर् वृतः ।माम् विसृज्य महातेजा लंकाम् एव अभिवर्तते ॥६-३०-१२॥।।
12.en: "O glorious King! After releasing me, Rama is advancing into Lanka surrounded by mountains like a monkey army in the form of Garuda."
12.hi: उन्होंने अपनी सेना का गरुड्व्यूह वना कर बानरों को चारों ओर फैल फुट कर ठहराया है। सुझे तो उन महातेजस्वी ने छोड़ दिआ, पर वे लङ्का की ओर निगाह गड़ाए हुए हँ

13.sa: पुरा प्राकारम् आयाति क्षिप्रम् एकतरम् कुरु ।सीताम् च अस्मै प्रयच्च आशु सुयुद्धम् वा प्रदीयताम् ॥६-३०-१३॥।।
13.en: "Before Rama reaches the boundary, the wall, do one thing quickly. Either give away Sita or set out to give a good war."
13.hi: वे आपकी राजधानी के परकोटे पर चढ़ाई करने ही वाळे हैं, अतः आप शीघ्र ही दो भें से एक काम कीजिए । अर्थात्‌ या 'तो उनको सौता दे डालिए अथवा उनसे खूब डट कर युद्ध कोजिए

14.sa: मनसा सम्तताप अथ तत् श्रुत्वा राक्षस अधिपः ।शार्दूलस्य महद् वाक्यम् अथ उवाच स रावणः ॥६-३०-१४॥।।
14.en: "Having heard what has been said by Saardula, Rakshasa king reviewed in his mind and made a good statement before Saardula."
14.hi: राक्षसाधिप रावण ने शादूल की इन बातों को सुन और उन पर मन ही मन कुछ विचार कर, उससे कहा

15.sa: यदि माम् प्रतियुध्येरन् देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ।न एव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्व लोक भयाद् अपि ॥६-३०-१५॥।।
15.en: "Even if Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas come to wage war with me and even if I have threats from all worlds, I will not give away Sita."

16.sa: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा रावणः पुनर् अब्रवीत् ।चारिता भवता सेना के अत्र शूराः प्लवम् गमाः ॥६-३०-१६॥।।
16.en: Glorious Ravana having spoken like that, again said (to Saardula), "You moved about in the army (camp) there. Tell me who among the monkeys are warriors?"
16.hi: यहु कह कर महातेजस्त्री रावण फिर-कहने लगा--तुमलोग तो वानरी सेना में घूम फिर आए हो, सो यह तों बतलाओ कि, वानरों में शूर कोन कौन हैं

17.sa: कीदृशाः किम् प्रभावाः च वानरा ये दुरासदाः ।कस्य पुत्राः च पौत्राः च तत्त्वम् आख्याहि राक्षस ॥६-३०-१७॥।।
17.en: "Gentle Saardula! Of those who are difficult to encounter, what is their description? Who are the powerful ones among them? Whose sons and grandsons, are they? You may speak."
17.hi: हे राक्षस ! जो वानर ठु्थेषं हे उनके आकार केसे. हें, उनका प्रभाव केसा है ; वे किसके पुत्र और पोत्र हैं ? सो तुम मुझसे ठीक ठीक कहो

18.sa: तथात्र प्रतिपत्स्यामि ज्ञात्वा तेषाम् बल अबलम् ।अवश्यम् बल सम्ख्यानम् कर्तव्यम् युद्धम् इच्चता ॥६-३०-१८॥।।
18.en: "Likewise knowing their strengths and weaknesses from you I wish to know what to do. It is essential to know their numbers and strength before the war."
18.hi: मनसाप्रेक्य-आलोच्य । (गो०); विचार्यं | (शि०) २ किंप्रभाः ~ किप्रभावा: । (गो०) २६२ युद्धकाण्ड जिससे मैं उनके बलाबल को जान कर तदनुसार प्रबन्ध करूं । क्योंकि जो युद्ध करना चाहे, उसे पहिले शत्रु के बलाबल का विचार और उसकी सेना के सेनिर्को की गिनती अवश्य कर लेनी चाहिए

19.sa: अथ एवम् उक्तः शार्दूलो रावणेन उत्तमः चरः ।इदम् वचनम् आरेभे वक्तुम् रावण सम्निधौ ॥६-३०-१९॥।।
19.en: "When Ravana had spoken that way, good spy Saardula proceeded to tell these words in the presence of Ravana."

20.sa: अथ ऋक्ष रजसः पुत्रो युधि राजन् सुदुर्जयः ।गद्गदस्य अथ पुत्रो अत्र जाम्बवान् इति विश्रुतः ॥६-३०-२०॥।।
20.en: "Certainly, king Sugriva, the son of Rksharaja's, is difficult to be conquered in battle. Here is the son of Gadgada, famously called as Jambavan."
20.hi: महाराज ! ऋक्षराज का पुत्र ( सुग्रीब ) तो युद्ध भें बड़ी कठिनाई से जीता जा सकता है ओर यही हाल गद्गद के पोष्यपुत्र का है, जो जाम्त्रबान के नाम से प्रख्यात हे

21.sa: गद्गदस्य एव पुत्रो अन्यो गुरु पुत्रः शत क्रतोः ।कदनम् यस्य पुत्रेण कृतम् एकेन रक्षसाम् ॥६-३०-२१॥।।
21.en: Another son of Gadgada is Dhumra. One who killed many Rakshasas is Hanuman, the son of Kesari, who is the son of Brhaspati.
21.hi: टिप्पणी-जाम्बवान की उत्पत्ति इसके पूर्व ब्रह्म की जँभुआई से कहीं जा चुकी है, यहाँ वह गःगद का पुत्र बतलाया गया है | इस विरोध मीमांसा में टीकाकारों ने जाम्बवान को गद्गद्‌ का पोष्यपुत्र बतलाया है। ] गद्गदस्यैब पुत्रोऽन्योः गुरुपुत्रः शतक्रतोः । कदनं यस्य पुत्रेण कृतमेकेन रचषसांम्र्‌

22.sa: सुषेणः च अपि धर्म आत्मा पुत्रो धर्मस्य वीर्यवान् ।सौम्यः सोम आत्मजः च अत्र राजन् दधि मुखः कपिः ॥६-३०-२२॥।।
22.en: "O king! Here is a heroic and righteous Sushena, the son of the Lord of death (Yamadharma). Here is Dadhimukha son of noble moon."
22.hi: धर्मपुत्र सुवेण बड़ा धर्मात्मा और पराक्रमी है। हे राजन्‌ ! चन्द्र का पुत्र दधिमुख वानर बड़ा सौम्य अर्था] सरल स्वभाव का है

23.sa: सुमुखो दुर्मुखः च अत्र वेग दर्शी च वानरः ।मृत्युर् वानर रूपेण नूनम् सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा ॥६-३०-२३॥।।
23.en: "Vanaras Sumukha, Durmukha and Vegadarsi are surely created by Brahma in the Vanara form of DeathGod."
23.hi: सुमुख, दुर्मुख और वेगदर्शी वानर तो साक्षात्‌ मृत्यु के अवतार ही हैं। मानों ब्रह्मा ने वानररूप में मत्यु को रचा है

24.sa: पुत्रो हुत वहस्य अथ नीलः सेना पतिः स्वयम् ।अनिलस्य च पुत्रो अत्र हनूमान् इति विश्रुतः ॥६-३०-२४॥।।
24.en: "The firegod's son indeed is the army chief known as Nila, and here is windgod's son widely known as Hanuman."
24.hi: अग्निपुत्र नील वानरी सेना का सेनापति है । पवनपुत्र, जो हनुमान के नामसे प्रसिद्धहै, सेना भें है

25.sa: नप्ता शक्रस्य दुर्धर्षो बलवान् अन्गदो युवा ।मैन्दः च द्विविदः च उभौ बलिनाव् अश्वि सम्भवौ ॥६-३०-२५॥।।
25.en: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."
25.hi: इन्द्र का पौत्र अङ्गद भी, जो बलवान्‌ युवा और दुधष है, सेना में है बलवान मैन्द ओर, द्विविद अश्विनीकुमार के पुत्र हैं

26.sa: पुत्रा वैवस्वतस्य अत्र पन्च काल अन्तक उपमाः ।गजो गव अक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्ध मादनः ॥६-३०-२६॥।।
26.en: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."
26.hi: गज, गवाक्ष, गवय, शरभ और गन्धमादन; ये पाँच यमराज ह ~ ह ~ ॥॥ के पुत्र हैं, और ये उन्हीं के तुल्य हैं [ये भी यहाँ आए हुए हैं

27.sa: दश वानरकोट्यश्च शूराणाम् युद्धकाङ्ग्क्षिणाम् ।श्रीमताम् देवपुत्राणाम् शेषम् नाख्यातुमुत्सहे ॥६-३०-२७॥।।
27.en: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."
27.hi: हे राजन्‌ ! इस सेना में दस करोड़ बानर तो देवतार्या के सन्तान हैं । ये सत्र के सब शूरवीर, बलशाली एवं युद्धामिलाषी हे! अवशिष्ट वानरों के वन की शक्ति सुफमें नहीं है

28.sa: पुत्रो दशरथस्येष सिम्हसम्हननो युवा ।दूषणो निहतो येन खरश्च त्रिशिरास्तथा ॥६-३०-२८॥।।
28.en: "That young one whose build is like a lion is Dasaratha's son who slayed Dushana, even Khara, like wise Trisira."

29.sa: नास्ति रामस्य सदृशो विक्रमे भुवि कश्चन ।विराधो निहतो येन कबन्धश्चान्तकोपमः ॥६-३०-२९॥।।
29.en: "Viradha and even Kabhanda who was like the Lord of death were killed by Rama. Perhaps there is none equal to Rama in valour in this world."

30.sa: वक्तुम् न शक्तो रामस्य गुणान् कश्चिन्नरः क्षितौ ।जनस्थानगता येन तावन्तो राक्षसा हताः ॥६-३०-३०॥।।
30.en: "It is not even possible to recount the virtues of Rama who killed all the Rakshasas approaching Janasthana."
30.hi: है वक्त न शक्तो रामस्य नरः करिचद्‌ गुणान्‌ च्षितो। जनस्थानगता येन यावन्तो राक्षसा हताः

31.sa: लक्ष्मणश्चात्र धर्मात्मा मातङ्गवामिवर्षभः ।यस्य बाणपथम् प्राप्य व जीवेदपि वासवः ॥६-३०-३१॥।।
31.en: "Here is righteous Lakshmana, who is like a bull (foremost) resembling a proud elephant. Even Indra will not be alive with in the range of his arrows when he strikes."
31.hi: मातज्ञानामिवर्षभः--गलश्रेष्ठ इव स्थितः । (गो०) तरशः सगः २६५ धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मण भी एक श्रेष्ठगज के समान बलवान्‌ हे । इनके बाणों की सार के भीतर आ जाने पर इन्द्र भी जीता जागता नहीं वच सकता

32.sa: श्वेतो ज्योतिर् मुखः च अत्र भास्करस्य आत्म सम्भवौ ।वरुणस्य च पुत्रो अथ हेम कूटः प्लवम् गमः ॥६-३०-३२॥।।
32.en: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."
32.hi: श्वेत और ज्योतिर्मुख नामक दोनो वानर, सूर्य के पुत्र है। वरुण का पुत्र हेमकूट नाम का वानर है

33.sa: विश्व कर्म सुतो वीरो नलः प्लवग सत्तमः ।विक्रान्तो वेगवान् अत्र वसु पुत्रः सुदुर्धरः ॥६-३०-३३॥।।
33.en: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."
33.hi: ॥ विश्वकर्मा का पुत्र वानरश्रेष्ठ एवं वीर नल है । वसु कां पुत्र सुदुधेर है, जो बड़ा विक्रमी हे और बलवान है

34.sa: राक्षसानाम् वरिष्ठः च तव भ्राता विभीषणः ।परिगृह्य पुरीम् लंकाम् राघवस्य हिते रतः॥६-३०-३४॥।।
34.en: "Here is your brother Vibheeshana the jewel among Rakshasas, who remains as a wellwisher of Rama and has received the city of Lanka (to whom Rama has offered Lanka)."
34.hi: राक्षसा मैं श्रेष्ठ और तुम्हारा भाई बिभीषण, राम से लङ्का का राज्य पाकर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का हितैषी बन गया है

35.sa: इति सर्वम् समाख्यातम् तव इदम् वानरम् बलम् ।सुवेले अधिष्ठितम् शैले शेष कार्ये भवान् गतिः ॥६-३०-३५॥
35.en: "I have described to you everything about the Vanara strength stationed on Suvela mountain. You may decide the rest of the task to be done." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलंलङ्काधिपतयेचराः ।सुवेलेराघवंशैलेनिविष्टंप्रत्यवेदयन् ॥६-३१-१॥।।
1.en: There upon the spies described the unshakeable army of Raghava staying at Suvela mountain, to the king of Lanka.
1.hi: युद्धकार्ड का तेईसवाँ सगे पूरा हुआ । —— ग ° 0 एकत्रिंशः सगः ततस्तमचषोभ्यबलं लङ्काधिपतये चराः । सुवेले राघवं शेले निविष्टं प्रत्यवेदयत्‌

2.sa: चाराणांरावणश्श्रुत्वाप्राप्तंरामंमहाबलम् ।जातोद्वेगोऽभवत्किञ्चित्सचिवानिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-३१-२॥।।
2.en: Having heard from the spies that Rama has come with mighty force, Ravana got perturbed and said to the ministers.

3.sa: मन्त्रिणश्शीघ्रमायान्तुसर्वेवैसुसमाहिताः ।अयंनोमन्त्रकालोहिसम्प्रप्ताइतिराक्षसाः ॥६-३१-३॥।।
3.en: "The time has come for us to call for all the rakshasas and ministers immediately and assemble (said Ravana)."
3.hi: हे राक्षसो ! मेरे समस्त नीतिकुशल द्वारी या सलाहकार मेरे सामने तुरन्त उपस्थित हों--क््योंकि अब मंत्रणा करने का समय आ पहुँचा है

4.sa: तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वामन्त्रिणोऽभ्यागमन् द्रुतम् ।ततस्समन्त्रयामासराक्षसैस्सचिवैस्सह ॥६-३१-४॥।।
4.en: Having been ordered (by Ravana) that way, the ministers along with Rakshasas instantly reached and he started to think with them.
4.hi: रावण की यह आज्ञा पा, सत्र मंत्री तुरन्त आ कर उपस्थित हो गए। तब रावण उन राक्षस मंत्रियों के साथ परामशे करने लगा

5.sa: मन्त्रयित्वासदुर्धर्षःक्षमंयत्समनन्तरम् ।विसर्जयित्वासचिवान्प्रविवेशस्वमालयम् ॥६-३१-५॥।।
5.en: Thereafter, thinking about what is appropriate to do, unassailable Ravana dispensed his ministers and entered his own residence.

6.sa: ततोराक्षसमाहूयविद्युज्जिह्वंमहाबलम् ।मायाविदंमहामायःप्राविशद्यत्रमैथिली ॥६-३१-६॥।।
6.en: Then Ravana of extraordinary skills sent for Vidyujihvam, a learned one in conjuring tricks and went from there to Mythili.
6.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के लङ्का के समीप आने के अनन्तर, रावण की जो करना उचित था, उसके सम्बन्ध में परामश कर चुकने के बाद, ठुधष रावण मंत्रियों को विदा कर, स्वयं भी अपने अन्तःपुर सें चला गया ॥ ₹॥ ततो राक्षसमाहूय विद्युज्जिह्व महाबलम्‌ । मायाविदं महामायः प्राविशधत्र मैथिली

7.sa: विद्युज्जिह्वंचमायाज्ञमब्रवीद्राक्षसाधिपः ।मोहयिष्यावहेसीतांमाययाजनकात्मजाम् ॥६-३१-७॥।।
7.en: Rakshasa king Ravana said to Vidyujihvam who knew conjuring tricks, "We will cheat Sita, daughter of Janaka by a trick."
7.hi: जाने के समय रावण भलोभाँति माया के जानने वाले विद्यू - ब्जिह राक्षस से कहने लगा कि, हे निशाचर! आओ हम दोनों माया की सहायता से अर्थात बाजीगर द्वारा सीता को घोखा * दें

8.sa: शिरोमायामयंगृह्यराघवस्यनिशाचर: ।त्वंमांसमुतिष्ठस्वमहच्चसशरंधनुः ॥६-३१-८॥।।
8.en: "O Night ranger! You make an illusory head of Raghava and come and stand at me holding an arrow with great bow."

9.sa: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्याहविद्युज्जिह्वोनिशाचरः ।दर्शयामासतांमायांसुप्रयुक्तांसरावणे ।तस्यतुष्टोऽभवद्राजाप्रददौचविभूषणम् ॥६-३१-९॥।।
9.en: When the Rakshasa king had spoken that way to Vidyujihvam, he said, "Be it so." Pleased with the dexterous production of Vidyujihvam, Ravana presented to him a beautiful ornament.

10.sa: अशोकवनिकायांतुसीतादर्शनलालसः ।वैरृतानामधिपतिस्संविवेशमहाबलः ॥६-३१-१०॥।।
10.en: Eager to have a look at Sita, the mighty king of Rakshasas entered Asoka grove.
10.hi: महामाय;--ताहशमाया प्रयोग कर्तारं । ( रा० ) २६८ युद्धकाण्डे एवमुक्तस्तथेत्याह विद्य ज्जिह्ो निशाचरः । तस्य तुष्टोऽभवद्राजा प्रददो च विभूषणम््‌ ॥ & ॥ तब मायावी विद्यञ्जिह्न न रावण की आज्ञा मान कर कहा बहुत अच्छा इस पर उसने ( रावण ने ) पारितोषिक में बिद्य ज्ञजिह्न को एक आभूषण दिआ ॥ & ॥ अशोकवनिकायां तु सीतादशनलालसः । नेऋतानामधिपतिः संविवेश महाबलः

11.sa: ततोदीनामदैन्यार्हांददर्शधनदानुजः ॥६-३१-११॥।।
11.en: Thereafter, the younger brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw sad Sita, who did not deserve that piteous condition, who had been reduced to sorrowful state, seated on the ground in Asoka grove, with her head bent down filled with sorrow contemplating on her husband alone.
11.hi: वहाँ कुबेर के छोटे भाई रावण ने उदास मन होने के अयोग्य होने पर भी, सीता को उदास मन हो, गदन झुकाए, शोक से विकल, ज्‌ पीन पर बैठा हुआ देखा

12.sa: अधोमुखींशोकपरामुपविष्टांमहीतले ।भर्तारमेवध्यायन्तीमशोकवविकांगताम् ॥६-३१-१२॥।।
12.en: Thereafter, the younger brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw sad Sita, who did not deserve that piteous condition, who had been reduced to sorrowful state, seated on the ground in Asoka grove, with her head bent down filled with sorrow contemplating on her husband alone.
12.hi: सीता अशोकवाटिका में अपने पति श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ध्यान में डूबी हुई थीं और भयङ्कर राज्षसियाँ उनके समीप इधर 'इत्रर बैठी थीं

13.sa: उपास्यमानांघोराभीराक्षसीभिरितस्ततः ।उपसृत्यततस्सीतांप्रहर्षंनामकीर्तयन् ।इदंचवचनंधृष्टमुवाचजनकात्मजाम् ॥६-३१-१३॥।।
13.en: While she was guarded by dreadful Rakshasa women surrounding her closely, Ravana went near her happily and saw her. He addressed Sita praising her.

14.sa: सान्त्व्यमानामयाभद्रेयमुपाश्रित्यवल्गसे ।खरहन्तासतेभर्ताराघवस्समरेहतः ॥६-३१-१४॥।।
14.en: "O Auspicious one! However, much I have requested you, you did not care for me seeking your husband. Raghava, who killed Khara, has been killed in war."
14.hi: हे भद्रे ! मैंने तुझे बहुत समभाया, पर तू ( आज तक ) जिसके भरोसे मेरे वचनां का अनादर करती रही, खर का बध करने वाला तेरा वह पति राघब युद्ध में मारा गया

15.sa: छिन्नंतेसर्वतोमूलंदर्पस्तेनिहतोमया ।व्यसनेनात्मनस्सीते ममभार्याभविष्यसि ॥६-३१-१५॥।।
15.en: "O Sita! All your roots have been crushed by me. Give up your vanity. By your own accord, you become my wife."

16.sa: विसृजेमांमतिंमूढे: किंमृतेनकरिष्यसि ।भवस्वभद्रे: भार्याणांसर्वेसामीश्वरीमम ॥६-३१-१६॥।।
16.en: "O Foolish one! Give up these thoughts from your mind. What will you do with your deceased husband? O auspicious one! You are the queen of all my wives."
16.hi: अब तू इन ब्रिचारों को त्याग दे । अरे मूर्खां ! अब तू इस मरे हुए शरीर को ले कर क्या करेगी ? हेभद्रे ! अब तू मेरे साथ चल कर मेरी समस्त स्त्रियों की स्वामिनी वन

17.sa: अल्पपुण्ये: निवृत्तार्थे: मूढे: पण्डितमानिनि: ।शृणुभर्तृवधंसीते: घोरंवृत्रवधंयथा ॥६-३१-१७॥।।
17.en: "O woman of less merit! You are one who has given up all worldly actions. Stupid one! You pretend as if you know everything. O Sita! Hear about your husband 's death like that of Vrthasura."

18.sa: समायातस्समुद्रान्तंमांहन्तुंकिलराघवः ।वानरेन्द्रप्रणीतेनबलेनमहतावृतः ॥६-३१-१८॥।।
18.en: "Raghava led by the huge army force of the Vanara king has arrived on the seashore."
18.hi: ग्रीव की एक वडी भारी वानरी सेना को साथ ले राम मुझे मारने के ज्ञिए समुद्र के इस पार अवश्य आया था

19.sa: सन्निविष्टस्समुद्रस्यपीड्यतीरमथोत्तरम् ।बलेनमहतारामोव्रजत्यस्तंदिवाकरे ॥६-३१-१९॥।।
19.en: And when the Sun moved towards the west, Rama encamped on the northern shore of the sea with a huge army to strike.

20.sa: अथाध्वनिपरिश्रान्तमर्धरात्रेस्थितंबलम् ।सुखसुप्तंसमासाद्यचारित्रंप्रथमंचरैः ॥६-३१-२०॥।।
20.en: After having walked all the way they slept well and when they were sleeping at midnight, we found out all about them by sending prime spies.
20.hi: माग चलने की थकावट से आघीरात को सेना वेखवर पड़ी सो रही थी । प्रथम से नियुक्त किए हुए जासूसों से जव यह हाल जाना गया, तब रात को बड़ी भारी सेना लेकर प्रहस्त ने वहाँ चढ़ाई की, जहाँ राम तथा लक्ष्मण थे और उनकी सेना को मार डाला

21.sa: तत्प्रहस्तप्रणीतेनबलेनमहतामम ।बलमस्यहतंरात्रौयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ॥६-३१-२१॥।।
21.en: "There in that camp Lakshmana and Rama are killed by my powerful army led by Prahastha at night."

22.sa: पट्टसान्परिघांश्चक्रान्दण्डान्महायशान् ।बाणजालानिशूलानिभास्वरान्कूटमुद्गरान् ॥६-३१-२२॥।।
22.en: Again, and again lifting spears, iron bars, javelins, huge staffs, sparkling maces, shining iron mallets and clubs, lances and strong Musalas, the Rakshasas hurled at Vanaras.

23.sa: यष्टीश्चतोमरान् शक्तीश्चक्राणिमुसलानिच ।उद्यम्योद्यम्यरक्षोभिर्वानरेषुनिपातितां ॥६-३१-२३॥।।
23.en: Again, and again lifting spears, iron bars, javelins, huge staffs, sparkling maces, shining iron mallets and clubs, lances and strong Musalas, the Rakshasas hurled at Vanaras.

24.sa: अथसुप्तस्यरामस्यप्रहस्तेनप्रमाथिना ।असक्तंकृतहस्तेनशिरश्छिन्नंमहासिना ॥६-३१-२४॥।।
24.en: "There after the head of Rama, who was sleeping, was severed by Prahastha, skilled at striking, with a big sword without any feeling of attachment."
24.hi: तदनन्तर शभुसेन्य को मथन करने वाले.प्रहस्त ने अपने को फुर्ती दिखला कर, एक बड़ी तलवार से झट श्रीरामचन्द्र का सिर काट डाला

25.sa: विभीषणस्समुत्पत्यनिगृहीतोयदृच्छया ।दिशःप्रव्राजितस्सर्वैस्सर्लक्ष्मणःप्लवगैस्सहा ॥६-३१-२५॥।।
25.en: "When Vibheeshana rose up he was caught by chance. Lakshmana and Vanaras fled in all directions."
25.hi: विभीषण को जितना दण्ड देना चाहिए था, उतना दण्ड देने में कसर नहीं की गई । तब लक्ष्मण बचे हुए, सब बानरों को साथ ले भाग गया

26.sa: सुग्रीवोग्रीनयासीतेभग्नयाप्लवगाधिपः ।निरस्तहनुकश्शेतेहनुमान्राक्षसैर्हतः ॥६-३१-२६॥।।
26.en: "O Sita! Vanara Lord Sugriva with his neck broken, Hanuman with chin broken were killed by Rakshasas and are lying down fallen on the ground."
26.hi: , वानरराज सुग्रीव गरदन टूट जाने से रणभूमि में मरा पड़ा हे । राक्वासों ने हनुमान की ठोड़ी तोड़ डाली और तरह भी रणाक्षेत्र में मरा पड़ा है

27.sa: जाम्बवानथजानुभ्यामुत्पतन्निहतोयुधि ।पट्टसैर्बहुभिश्छिन्नोनिकृत्तःपादपोयथा ॥६-३१-२७॥।।
27.en: And while Jambavan was rising on his knees, he was struck by many iron bars in comb at and had fallen down like a tree.
27.hi: जाम्बबान कूद भागना चाहता था, किन्तु राक्षसों ने पटों की मार से उनकी जांधें तोड़ दीं । बह भी कटे हुए पेड़ की तरह वहाँ पर मरा पड़ा हे

28.sa: मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौनिहतौवानरर्षभौ ॥६-३१-२८॥।।
28.en: "Mainda and Dwivida of huge bodies, who are slayers of enemies, the bulls among Vanaras are breathing hard, and bathed in blood roaring, having been cutin the middle of their body."
28.hi: वानरश्रेष्ठ मेन्द और द्विविद लंबी लंबी साँसें लेते और रोते हुए तथा रक्त से (न्हाये हुए)लथपथ हो, मारे गए

29.sa: निश्श्वसन्तौरुदन्तौचरुधिरेणसमुक्षितौ ।असिनाव्यायतौछिन्नौमध्येह्यरिनिषूदनौ ॥६-३१-२९॥।।
29.en: "Mainda and Dwivida of huge bodies, who are slayers of enemies, the bulls among Vanaras are breathing hard, and bathed in blood roaring, having been cutin the middle of their body."

30.sa: अनुतिष्ठतिमेदिन्यांपनसःपनसोयथा ॥६-३१-३०॥।।
30.en: "Panasa is lying down on earth like jackfruit. Darimukha is lying down shattered by many arrows. Brilliant Kumuda too is torn off and silently lying down."
30.hi: दरीमुख अनेक बाणों के प्रहार से मरा हुआ, कन्दरा में पडा सो रहा है। महातेजस्वी कुमुद भी वाणों को मार से सद! के लिए निःशब्द ( मूक-गू ग) बना दिआ गया

31.sa: नाराचैर्बहुभिश्चिन्नश्शेतेदर्यांदरीमुखः ।कुमुदस्तुमहातेजानिष्कूजन्सायकै: कृतः ॥६-३१-३१॥।।
31.en: "Panasa is lying down on earth like jackfruit. Darimukha is lying down shattered by many arrows. Brilliant Kumuda too is torn off and silently lying down."
31.hi: अज्ञद भी राक्षसा द्वारा चलाए हुए अनेक वाणां से क्षत विक्षत ही, भारा गया । उसका बाजू सहित बाहु भूमि पर पड़ा है और उसके सब अड्डों से रुधिर बह रहा हे । अथवा रक्त की वमन करता हुआ वह मरा है

32.sa: अङ्गदोबहुभिश्छिन्नश्शरैरासाद्यराक्षसैः ।पतितोरुधिरोद्गारीक्षितौनिपतिताङ्गदः ॥६-३१-३२॥।।
32.en: "By the many arrows of Rakshasas reaching towards Angada, he lies down chopped up and destroyed, with his armlets dropped down throwing up blood."
32.hi: बक) २७३ अशीर अनेक बानर ५ तो हाथियों के पैरों के नीचे कुचल कर मर गए। बहुत से रथों को चपेटों में आ कर मारे गए । बहुत से सोते हुए कुचले गए। जिस प्रकार हवा के वेग से बादल अदृश्य हो जाते हैं, उसी प्रकार राक्षसी सेना के आक्रमण से सब बानर अदृश्य हो गए हैं

33.sa: हरयोमथितानागैरथजातैस्तथापरे ।शयितामृदिताश्चाश्वैर्यायुवेगैरिवाम्बुदाः ॥६-३१-३३॥।।
33.en: "There, some of the sleeping Vanaras were crushed by elephants, so also, just as by the speed of wind the clouds are crushed the Vanaras are crushed to death."
33.hi: बहुत से वानर तो मारकाट के समय डर कर भागते समय पीछे से मारे गए। बहुत से राक्षसों से पिछियाये जा कर ऐसे भागे जैसे सिह के झपटने पर बड़े बड़े हाथी भागते हैं

34.sa: प्रहृताश्चपरेत्रस्ताहस्यमानाजघन्यतः ।अभिद्रुतास्तुरक्षोभिस्सिंहैरिवमहाद्विपाः ॥६-३१-३४॥।।
34.en: "Some were followed behind as they were speeding like lions and mighty elephants afflicted and frightened, struck by Rakshasas."
34.hi: कोई कोई तो समुद्र में कूद पडे और कोई कोई आकाश में उड़ गए । रीछ वानरों के साथ वृक्षों पर चढ़ गया

35.sa: सागरेपतिताःकेचित्केचिग्दगनमाश्रिताः ।ऋक्षावृक्षानुपारूढावानरींवृत्तिमाश्रिताः ॥६-३१-३५॥।।
35.en: "While a few Vanaras dived into the sea, some took refuge in the sky. Resorting to their natural way the Bears climbed the trees."
35.hi: समुद्र के तट पर, पर्वतां और वनों में जिन बानरों ने आश्रय लिया था उनमें से बहुत से राक्षसों द्वारा मार डाले गए

36.sa: सागरस्यचतीरेषुशैलेषुचवनेषुच ।पिङ्गलास्तेविरूपाक्षैर्बहुभिर्बहवोहताः ॥६-३१-३६॥।।
36.en: "Many fierceeyed Rakshasas killed several Vanaras on the shore of the ocean, in the mountains and woods."
36.hi: oo १ जघन्यतः पृष्ठतः । ( गो» ) २ पिङ्गलाः-वानराः। ( गो० ) ३ विरुपाच्षेः--वानरैः । (गो०) #पाठान्तरे-““बानरौँ बृत्तिमाश्रिताः। 3 काड इस प्रकार तेरा भतो ससैन्य मेरी सेना द्वारा मारा गया । उसका यह कटा हुआ सिर तुझे दिखलाने को लाया गया हे देख, यह रक्त और घूल से सना है

37.sa: एवंतवहतोभर्ताससैन्योममसेनया ।क्षतजार्द्रंरजोध्वस्तमिदंचस्याहृतंशिरः ॥६-३१-३७॥।।
37.en: "In that way the army of your husband has been killed by Rakshasa army and his decayed head drenched in blood covered with dust has been brought."

38.sa: ततःपरमदुर्धर्षोरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः ।सीतायामुपशन्त्यांराक्षसीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-३१-३८॥।।
38.en: Then Ravana, the highly unassailable king of Rakshasas spoke these words to the hearing of Sita.

39.sa: राक्षसंक्रूरकर्माणंविद्युज्जिह्वंत्वमानय ।येनतद्राघवशिरस्सङ्ग्रामात्स्वयमाहृतम् ॥६-३१-३९॥।।
39.en: "Bring that Rakshasa, Vidyujihvam of cruel deeds who brought Rama's head from the battlefield."

40.sa: विद्युज्जिह्वस्ततोगृह्यशिरस्तत्सशरासनम् ।प्रणामंशिरसाकृत्वारावणस्याग्रतस्थितः ॥६-३१-४०॥।।
40.en: Then holding the head along with the bow, Vidyujihvam bowed his head down in salutation and stood in front of Ravana.

41.sa: तमब्रवीत्ततोराजारावणोराक्षसंस्थितम् ।विद्युज्जिह्वंमहाजिह्वंसमीपपरिवर्तिनम् ॥६-३१-४१॥।।
41.en: Then the king, Ravana spoke to Vidyujihvam, the Rakshasa with extended tongue, who stood close by.

42.sa: अग्रतःकुरुसीतायाश्शीघ्रंदाशरधेशशिरः ।अवस्थांपश्चिमांभर्तुःकृपणासाधुपश्यतु ॥६-३१-४२॥।।
42.en: At once place the head of Dasaratha's son before that piteous woman. Let her see the ultimate status attained by her husband at the end (said Ravana).
42.hi: पश्चिमामवस्थां--मरणमित्यथेः । ( गो० ) षकत्रिशः सगः २७४ रम का कटा हुआ सिर सीता के आए के सामने रख दे, जि यह बापुरी gi भर हुये राम को अच्छी तरह देख ले | न एवयुक्त तु तद्र शिरस्तत्प्रियद्शनम्र | उप निक्षिप्य सीतायाः विप्रमन्तरधीयत || 9 द| ज्योंही रावण ने वि राम का कल र (हू से यह कहा, त्योंही वह प्रियदर्शन हो डआ सिर सीता के पास रख, स्वयं तरर अन्तर्धा हा गया

43.sa: एवमुक्तंतुतद्रक्षशशिरस्तत्प्रियदर्शनम् ।उपनिक्षिप्यसीतायाःक्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत ॥६-३१-४३॥।।
43.en: Having spoken immediately placed the head of Rama that was pleasing to see, by the side of Sita and went away.

44.sa: रावणश्चापिचिक्षेपभस्वरंकार्मुकंमहत् ।त्रिषुलोकेषुविख्यातंसीतामिदमुवाचह ॥६-३१-४४॥।।
44.en: Thus addressed Ravana casting down the bright great bow that is famous in the three worlds.
44.hi: यह्‌ तेरे राम का रोदा-सहित धनुष को मार प्रहस्त इसे ले आया है

45.sa: इदंतुतवरामस्यकार्मुकंज्यासमायुतम् ।इहप्रहस्तेनानीतंहत्वातंनिशिमानुषम् ॥६-३१-४५॥।।
45.en: "Prahastha has brought this bow duly tied with the string after killing human Rama in the night."

46.sa: सविद्युज्जिह्वेनसहैवतच्छिरोधनुश्चभूमौविनिकीर्यरावणः ।विदेहराजस्यसुतांयशस्विनींततोऽब्रवीत्तांभवमेवशानुगा ॥६-३१-४६॥।।
46.en: Casting down that head and the bow upon the ground together with Vidyujjihva, he then said to the illustrious daughter of the king of Videha: "Become submissive to me."

1.sa: सा सीता तच्चिरो दृष्ट्वा तच् च कार्मुकम् उत्तमम् । ।सुग्रीव प्रतिसंसर्गम् आख्यातम् च हनूमता ।। ६-३२-१
1.en: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.

2.sa: नयने मुख वर्णम् च भर्तुस् तत् सदृशम् मुखम् ।केशान् केश अन्त देशम् च तम् च चूडा मणिम् शुभम् ।। ६-३२-२
2.en: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.
2.hi: सीता ने देखा कि, उस कटे हुए मस्तक के दोनों नेत्र चेहरे की रंगत और सुख हूबहू उनके पति श्रीरामचन्द्र जी जैसा है। उस कटे हुए सिर के बाल और ललाट भी ज्यों के त्यों वैसे ही हैं और वह श्रेष्ठ चूडामणि भी वही है.

3.sa: एतैह् सर्वैर् अभिज्नानैर् अभिज्नाय सुदुह्खिता ।विजगर्हे अथ कैकेयीम् क्रोशन्ती कुररी यथा ।। ६-३२-३।।
3.en: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.

4.sa: सकामा भव कैकेयि हतो अयम् कुल नन्दनः ।कुलम् उत्सादितम् सर्वम् त्वया कलह शीलया ।। ६-३२-४।।
4.en: "O Kaikeyi! Your desire is fulfilled with the killing of the delight of the race. You, who are given to creating quarrel have ruined the race."
4.hi: हे केके ! अब तो तेरी ध पूरी हुई 6 ८ अब साध पूरा हुई । देख, यह इक्ष् कु- | ऊँशनन्दन मार गय | तुझ कलहप्रिया ने इस कुल डी ज । उखाड़ फेंकी

5.sa: आर्येण किम् नु कैकेय्याः कृतम् रामेण विप्रियम् ।यन्मया चीर वसनस् तया प्रस्थापितो वनम् ।। ६-३२-५।।
5.en: "Kaikeyi, you have given bark robes to prince Rama and sent him to the forest with me. What harm has he done for you? Thinking of this again and again Sita cried."

6.sa: एवम् उक्त्वा तु वैदेही वेपमाना तपस्विनी ।जगाम जगतीम् बाला चिन्ना तु कदली यथा ।। ६-३२-६।।
6.en: That miserable young, Vaidehi, having said so, fell on the ground trembling like a cut off banana plant.
6.hi: इमां ते पश्चिमावस्थां गताउस्मि विधवा कृता । ~ Cr प्रथमं मरणं नायो त्‌ बशुखयशचुचयते ॥&॥ तुम्हारे मरने से मैं तो विधवा हो गई । छी के रहते उस पति का मरना खी के दोष ही से होता है

7.sa: सा मुहूर्तात् समाश्वस्य प्रतिलभ्य च चेतनाम् ।तत् शिरह् समुपाघ्राय विललाप आयत ईक्षणा ।। ६-३२-७।।
7.en: Broadeyed Sita, regaining her consciousness after a while, sat close to the head of Rama and lamented.
7.hi: ह के त केले के पेड़ की तरह जमीन पर गिर पड़ी । न र थांड देर बाद वे सावधान हो सचेत हुई

8.sa: हा हता अस्मि महा बाहो वीर व्रतम् अनुव्रता ।इमाम् ते पश्चिम अवस्थाम् गता अस्मि विधवा कृता ।। ६-३२-८।।
8.en: "O mightyarmed one! Alas you are killed while following heroic vow. I live to see you in the last state of your life, widowed. I am done."
8.hi: छ २७८ युका द्वण्डे ति स्‌घ बिशालनेत्र वाली सर को भली भाँति सूघ कर Ri र ८ के कहने लगी- हे महाबाहो : हे वीरत्रतघारी ' रस हाय मैं मर गई

9.sa: प्रथमम् मरणम् नार्या भर्तुर् वैगुण्यम् उच्यते ।सुवृत्तः साधु वृत्तायाः सम्वृत्तस् त्वम् मम अग्रतः ।। ६-३२-९।।
9.en: "O Rama, you are faithful to your vows, a noble one! It is said that because of a woman's faults, the husband will die. It is not even so as you died in front of a virtuous woman of good conduct."

10.sa: दुह्खाद् दुह्कःअम् प्रपन्नाया मग्नायाः शोक सागरे ।यो हि माम् उद्यतस् त्रातुम् सो अपि त्वम् विनिपातितः ।। ६-३२-१०।।
10.en: "I am in grief and filled with an ocean of sorrow. You who have come to save me and are also killed."
10.hi: सोहे दात ] सो आप मुझ धर्मेचारिणी से म का परलोक लै सिघार गए। मैं तो अत्यन्त दुखी हो, पहिले ही श सागर में डूबी हुई थी

11.sa: सा श्वश्रूर् मम कौसल्या त्वया पुत्रेण राघव ।वत्सेन इव यथा धेनुर् विवत्सा वत्सला कृता ।। ६-३२-११।।
11.en: "O Raghava! Even my motherinlaw Kausalya is separated from her dear son just as cow is separated from calf."
11.hi: आप मेरा उद्धार करने को उद्यत हुए थे, सा आ क मार गए हे राघव ! आप सरीखा पुत्र पा, मेरी सास कौसल्या पु बत्सला कहलाती थी

12.sa: उदिष्टम् दीर्घम् आयुस् ते यैर् अचिन्त्य पराक्रम ।अनृतम् वचनम् तेषाम् अल्प आयुर् असि राघव ।। ६-३२-१२।।
12.en: "O Raghava of incomprehensible valour! the words predicted by astrologers that your life is long is falsified. Your life has been short."
12.hi: सो बह भी बिना बछडे की गौ की तरह निवंत्सला हो ज्योतिषी ने तुम्हारा अचिन्त्य पराक्रम देख, तुमको दीघायु जाया था

13.sa: अथ वा नश्यति प्रज्ना प्राज्नस्य अपि सतस् तव ।पचत्य् एनम् तथा कालो भूतानाम् प्रभवो ह्ययम् ।। ६-३२-१३।।
13.en: "Or else, even the wisdom of a learned one is diffused and lost perhaps! the effect of time which is the cause of all living beings has caused this."
13.hi: है राघव ! ( सो मेरे दुर्भाग्य से) तुम अल्पायु हुए और उनक वचन असत्य ठहरे । अथवा उनका वचन मिथ्या नहीं है अथान वे असत्यवादी नहीं हैं, किन्तु तुम्हारे भाग्यविपर्यय से उनको बुद्धि भी मारी गई

14.sa: अदृष्टम् मृत्युम् आपन्नः कस्मात् त्वम् नय शास्त्रवित् ।व्यसनानाम् उपायज्नः कुशलो ह्यसि वर्जने ।। ६-३२-१४।।
14.en: "You are the knower of all sastras, and capable of warding off all calamities. How did death have a chance to meet you and overtake?"
14.hi: ति काल की करतूत ही ऐसी है । क्योंकि प्राणियों का कारण- [त बही है।हे राम ! तुम तो नीतिशॉस्त्रविशारद थे, उपाय करने में निपुण थे, विपदों के निवारण में समथ हो कर भी, तुम्हारी इस प्रकार अचानक मृत्यु कैसे हुई ? हाय ! भयङ्कर निष्ठुर कालरात्रि ने तुम कमललोचन को मुझसे बरजोरी छीन लिया। हे महाबाहो ! मु क दुखियारी को त्याग कर, प्यारी खरी की नाई प्रथ्वी से लिपट कर तुम कहाँ पडे हो ! मैं तुम्हारे साथ सुगन्थित द्रव्य और पुष्पमालाओं से सदा जिसका पूजन किआ करती थी

15.sa: तथा त्वम् सम्परिष्वज्य रौद्रया अतिनृशंसया ।काल रात्र्या मया आच्चिद्य हृतः कमल लोचन ।। ६-३२-१५।।
15.en: "O lotuseyed Rama! After you have lost contact with me, the most horrible cruel night has killed you cutting you off from me."

16.sa: उपशेषे महा बाहो माम् विहाय तपस्विनीम् ।प्रियाम् इव शुभाम् नारीम् पृथिवीम् पुरुष ऋषभ ।। ६-३२-१६।।
16.en: "O mightyarmed one! A bull among men and a noble one, you are embracing the earth as though it is your beloved and sleeping leaving me in the sky."
16.hi: और जो मुझे अत्यन्त प्यारा था; हे वीर ' उसी तुम्हारे इस - ९ धनप ह क्या दश है ? हे पापरहित ! म सुवणभूषित धनुष की यह क्या दशा है ' हे पापराहित . तु अपने पिता और मेरे पापरहित ससुर महाराज दशरथ ॥ १८ सर्वैश्व पितृभिः साथ नूनं स्वर्ग समागतः । र्र (७ ० ८ १दिवि नक्षत्रभतस्त्वं महत्कमंकृतां प्रियम्‌

17.sa: अर्चितम् सततम् यत्नाद् गन्ध माल्यैर् मया तव ।इदम् ते मत् प्रियम् वीर धनुः कान्चन भूषितम् ।। ६-३२-१७।।
17.en: "O Hero! This bow that was decorated with gold was always worshipped with sandal and flowers diligently by you and me with utmost devotion."

18.sa: पित्रा दशरथेन त्वम् श्वशुरेण मम अनघ ।पूर्वैसः च पितृभिः सार्धम् नूनम् स्वर्गे समागतः ।। ६-३२-१८।।
18.en: "O Sinless one! Surely you have reached heaven where your father, my fatherinlaw Dasaratha and your grandfathers have reached."

19.sa: दिवि नक्षत्र भूतस् त्वम् महत् कर्म कृतम् प्रियम् ।पुण्यम् राज ऋषि वंशम् त्वम् आत्मनः समुपेक्षसे ।। ६-३२-१९।।
19.en: "In heaven, you will be seeing luminaries of the sky who are dear, who have done great deeds and earned merit and the royal sages of your own race."

20.sa: किम् मान् न प्रेक्षसे राजन् किम् माम् न प्रतिभाषसे ।बालाम् बालेन सम्प्राप्ताम् भार्याम् माम् सह चारिणीम् ।। ६-३२-२०।।
20.en: "O King! I have come to you while I was young. I am your companion and wife also. Why are you not seeing me? Why are you not talking to me?"

21.sa: संश्रुतम् गृह्णता पाणिम् चरिष्यामि इति यत् त्वया ।स्मर तन् मम काकुत्स्थ नय माम् अपि दुह्खिताम् ।। ६-३२-२१।।
21.en: "O Kakutstha! while you held my hand (at the time of marriage) you promised that you will be with me and likewise promised to take me, a (wretched one) with you to the other world. Remembering that I am sad."
21.hi: हे राजन्‌ ! तुमने लड़कपने में ही मुझ बाला को अपनी सम- दुःख-सुख भोग करने वाली स्री कह कर अंगीकार किया था ` और पाणिग्रहण के समय तुमने प्रतिज्ञा की थी कि, मैं तेरे साथ रहुँगा

22.sa: कस्मान् माम् अपहाय त्वम् गतो गतिमताम् वर ।अस्माल् लोकाद् अमुम् लोकम् त्यक्त्वा माम् इह दुह्खिताम् ।। ६-३२-२२।।
22.en: "O Jewel among those who attained good state! Why have you gone abandoning me dear? To which world have you gone from here? I am pained by your deserting me."

23.sa: कल्याणैर् उचितम् यत् तत् परिष्वक्तम् मया एव तु ।क्रव्य अदैस् तत् शरीरम् ते नूनम् विपरिकृष्यते ।। ६-३२-२३।।
23.en: "This body which used to be decorated by me with auspicious items, with great respect is dragged by cruel animals."
23.hi: सुक दुखिया को भी त्याग कर, तुम इस लोक से में उड भ ै क से परलोक क्यों चले गये ! तुम्हारे आभूषणों से भूषित होने योग्य जिस शरीर का मैं आलिंगन किआ करती थी

24.sa: अग्निष्तोम आदिभिर् यज्नैर् इष्टवान् आप्त दक्षिणैः ।अग्नि होत्रेण संस्कारम् केन त्वम् तु न लप्स्यसे ।। ६-३२-२४।।
24.en: "Why are you, who performed all kinds of sacrificial rituals of fire with all offerings deserve sanctification without doing fire sacrifice?"
24.hi: उसको मांसभक्षी गिद्ध आदि निश्चय ही नाँचते खसोटते होंगे। बटवास की अवधि समाप्त होने पर तुमको तो पर्याप्त दक्षिणा प्रदान पूर्वक (प्रयश्चित्त त्मक) अरन्याधान ग्रहण करना उचित था और जब तुम्हारी आयु शेष होती तब उसी अग्न्याधान के अग्नि से तुम्हारे शरीर का अग्निसंस्कार होन। चाहिए था, परन्तु यह बीच ही में क्या का क्या हो गया । तुम्हारे सृतशरीर का अत्रिःसंध्कार क्यों नहीं हुआ । ( गो० ) हम तीन वनवासियो में से जब एक ( लक्ष्मण ) लौट कर.अयोध्या में जायगा

25.sa: प्रव्रज्याम् उपपन्नानाम् त्रयाणाम् एकम् आगतम् ।परिप्रक्ष्यति कौसल्या लक्ष्मणम् शोक लालसा ।। ६-३२-२५।।
25.en: "Seeing only Lakshmana returning, of the three exiled, Kausalya will be immersed in grief (will ask)."

26.sa: स तस्याः परिपृच्चन्त्या वधम् मित्र बलस्य ते ।तव च आख्यास्यते नूनम् निशायाम् राक्षसैर् वधम् ।। ६-३२-२६।।
26.en: "When she questions, he may tell that you and your army were killed by the army of friends at night."

27.sa: सा त्वाम् सुप्तम् हतम् श्रुत्वा माम् च रक्षो गृहम् गताम् ।हृदयेन विदीर्णेन न भविष्यति राघव ।। ६-३२-२७।।
27.en: "Raghava! Hearing that you were killed while asleep and I was taken to the home of Rakshasas, Kausalya will not be able to survive with a broken heart."

28.sa: मम हेतोरनार्याया अवघः पार्थिवात्मजः ।रामः सागमुत्तीर्य वीर्यवान् गोष्पदे हतः ।। ६-३२-२८।।
28.en: "On account of an undeserving one, Rama, the son of the emperor, a valiant one who does not deserve to be killed, after having crossed the ocean is killed by a footprint of a cow(easily)."
28.hi: उस समय लक्ष्मण निश्चय ही कहेंगे कि, राते हुए म राक्षसों द्वारा मार डाले गये । तब कोसल्या सात में तुम्हारा मास जाना और मेरा राक्षस के घर में रुद्ध होना सुनेगी ॥२श। हृदयेनावदीणन न भविष्यति राघव । मम हेतोरनायाया द्यनहः पार्थिवात्मजः

29.sa: अहम् दाशरथेनोढा मोहात्स्वकुपांसनी ।आर्यपुत्रस्य रामस्य भार्या मृत्युरजायत ।। ६-३२-२९।।
29.en: "In ignorance as an obloquy of his race, the noble son of Dasaratha married me. For such Rama's wife turned out to be his death."

30.sa: मानमाव्याम् मया जातिम् वारितम् दानमुत्तमम् ।याहमद्येह शोचामि भार्या सर्वातिथेरपि ।। ६-३२-३०।।
30.en: "Undoubtedly I may have obstructed a supreme offering (such as offering a girl in marriage) in some other (previous) life. So now I am pained even though I am the wife of one who is kind to all."
30.hi: दानमुत्तमम्‌ कन्यादानं } ( गो० ) .. क्योकि मैं उत्त राजकुमार की भार्या हो कर उसको मुत्यु का कारण हुई । मैंने पूर्वजन्म में किसी के कन्यादान में अवश्य ही. बाधा डाली होगी

31.sa: साधु पातय माम् क्षिप्रम् रामस्य उपरि रावणः ।समानय पतिम् पत्न्या कुरु कल्याणम् उत्तमम् ।। ६-३२-३१।।
31.en: "O Ravana! You may quickly join me with my husband as it will be highly auspicious for the wife to join the husband."
31.hi: इसीसे वो इस जन्म में सब की रक्षा करने वाले अथवा सब का आतिथ्य करने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र की भाया हो कर भी ओर सुखभोग का समय उपस्थित होने पर भी, सें ऐसी दुदशा में पड़ी हुई हूँ ' हे रावण ! तू बड़ा अच्छा काम करे, जो मुके भो शीघ्र मार कर, राम के ऊपर डाल दे

32.sa: शिरसा मे शिरसः च अस्य कायम् कायेन योजय ।रावण अनुगमिष्यामि गतिम् भर्तुर् महात्मनः ।। ६-३२-३२।।
32.en: "O Ravana! Join my head with his and my body with his body. I will follow him in the same way."

33.sa: इति सा दुह्ख सम्तप्ता विललाप आयत ईक्षणा ।भर्तुः शिरो धनुस् तत्र समीक्ष्य जनक आत्मजा ।। ६-३२-३३।।
33.en: Burning in sorrow, the broad eyed Sita gazing at the head of her husband and the bow again and again lamented.
33.hi: हे -रावण ! मैं अपने महात्मा पति की अनुगामिनी होउँगी । मैं इस प्रकार का ( पति विना ) पापमय जीवन एक क्षण भी घारण करना नहीं चाहती

34.sa: एवम् लालप्यमानायाम् सीतायाम् तत्र राक्षसः ।अभिचक्राम भर्तारम् अनीकस्थः क्ऱ्त अन्जलिः ।। ६-३२-३४।।
34.en: While Sita was wailing in that manner, as said earlier, the Rakshasa guarding her approached the king and offered salutations with both hands.
34.hi: बड़े बड़े नेत्रबाली ठुखिया जानकी पति के कटे सीस और धनुष को बार बार देख कर विलाप कर रही थी क्रि, इतने में रावण की सेना का एक राक्षस आया और रावण के सामने हाथ जोड़ कर खड़ा हो गया

35.sa: विजयस्व आर्य पुत्र इति सो अभिवाद्य प्रसाद्य च ।न्यवेदयद् अनुप्राप्तम् प्रहस्तम् वाहिनी पतिम् ।। ६-३२-३५।।
35.en: The Rakshasa (guard) greeted the king saying, "Let you be victorious!" and announced reverentially, "Prahastha, the army chief has arrived."

36.sa: अमात्यैः स हितः सर्वैः प्रहस्तस्त्वामुपस्थितः ।तेन दर्शनकामेन अहम् प्रस्थापितः प्रभो ।। ६-३२-३६।।
36.en: "O Lord! Accompanied by all ministers Prahastha is waiting and sends me desiring to see you."
36.hi: € टी “आयपुत्र की जय हो” कह कर उसने रावण को प्रणाम केआ ओर रावण को प्रसन्न कर उसने यह समाचार दिल्या कि 2400 सहित सेनापति प्रहस्त उपस्थित हैं । हे प्रभो ! आपसे मिलने की इच्ड्रा से उन्होंने मुझे आपके पाल भेजा है

37.sa: मानमस्ति महारा ज राजभावात् क्षमान्वित ।किंचिद् आत्ययिकम् कार्यम् तेषाम् त्वम् दर्शनम् कुरु ।। ६-३२-३७।।
37.en: "O great king, endowed with forgiveness and royalty! there is a little urgent work. Undoubtedly, they are waiting to see you please."

38.sa: एतत् श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो राक्षस प्रतिवेदितम् ।अशोक वनिकाम् त्यक्त्वा मन्त्रिणाम् दर्शनम् ययौ ।। ६-३२-३८।।
38.en: On hearing the submission of the rakshasa, the tenheaded king left the Asoka grove to see the ministers.

39.sa: स तु सर्वम् समर्थ्य एव मन्त्रिभिः क्ऱ्त्यम् आत्मनः ।सभाम् प्रविश्य विदधे विदित्वा राम विक्रमम् ।। ६-३२-३९।।
39.en: Having known all about Rama's prowess, Ravana and ministers entered the assembly to think carefully about the task to be carried out and how to do it.

40.sa: अन्तर्धानम् तु तत् शीर्षम् तच् च कार्मुकम् उत्तमम् ।जगाम रावणस्य एव निर्याण समनन्तरम् ।। ६-३२-४०।।
40.en: As soon as Ravana departed, that head and the excellent bow vanished from there.
40.hi: मंत्रियों के परामर्श से सब कार्यों का निश्चय कर, वह सभा में गया ओर वहाँ श्रीराम घन्द्र जी के वल विक्रम को भली भाँति समभ वूझ कर, उसने आवश्यक प्रवन्ध' करवाया

41.sa: राक्षस इन्द्रस् तु तैः सार्धम् मन्त्रिभिर् भीम विक्रमैः ।समर्थयाम् आस तदा राम कार्य विनिश्चयम् ।। ६-३२-४१।।
41.en: The king of Rakshasas and the ministers of terrific valour then thought about the course of action to be taken against Rama and decided.
41.hi: जिस समय रावण अशोकवाटिका से प्रस्थानित हुआ था; उसी समय श्रोरामचन्द्र जी का करा हुआ वह बनावटी सिर ओर धनुय भी न जाने कहाँ गायत्र हो गया

42.sa: अविदूर स्थितान् सर्वान् बल अध्यक्षान् हित एषिणः ।अब्रवीत् काल सद्ऱ्शो रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ।। ६-३२-४२।।
42.en: The Rakshasa king who resembled the god of death spoke to the heads of army force and wellwishers who stood close by.

43.sa: शीघ्रम् भेरी निनादेन स्फुट कोण आहतेन मे ।समानयध्वम् सैन्यानि वक्तव्यम् च न कारणम् ।। ६-३२-४३।।
43.en: "Break forth by beating the drums with powerful drumsticks calling the army to assemble without telling the reason."
43.hi: किर निकट ही खड़े हुए अपने हितैषी सेनापतियों से राक्तस- राज रावण ने समयानुकूल बचन कहे

44.sa: ततस् तथा इति प्रतिगृह्य तद् वचो ।स्तदैव दूताः सहसा महाद्बलम् ।समानयंसः चैव समागतम् च ते ।न्यवेदयन् भर्तरि युद्ध कान्क्षिणि ।। ६-३२-४४
44.en: Then the attendants collected the great powerful army saying, 'so be it', to Ravana who was desirous of war. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्दकाण्डेद्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
