7.hi: मेघ के समान बड़े डीलडौल का और मेघ ही की तरह काले टं का तथा मेघ ही की तरह गर्जने वाला ओर कानों में सोने कुण्डल पहिने हर अकम्पन, एक बड़े रथ में बैठ तथा भयङ्कर रात्तसों को साथ ले, बाहिर निकला । बड़े बड़े यद्धो में देवता भी इसको युद्ध में नहीं डिगा सके थे

8.sa: तान् मृत्युवशमापन्नानकम्पनवशं गतान् ।समीक्ष्य हनुमान् ज्ञातीनुपतस्थे महाबलः ।। ६.५६.८ ।।।।
8.en: Having observed that Vanaras are fallen under the sway of Akampana and under the sway of death, mighty Hanuman approached Akampana.
8.hi: राक्षसः संघतो भीमेस्तदा निर्यात्यक्षम्पन; | न है कथयित्‌, शक्यः सुरैरपि महामृधे

9.sa: तं महाप्लवगं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्लवगयूथपाः ।समेत्य समरे वीराः संहृष्टाः पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.५६.९ ।।।।
9.en: Seeing the great monkey, the Vanara troops got together and surrounded him.

10.sa: अवस्थितं हनूमन्तं ते दृष्ट्वा हरियूथपाः ।बभूवुर्बलवन्तो हि बलवन्तं समाश्रिताः ।। ६.५६.१० ।।।।
10.en: Seeing Hanuman, the monkey leaders took their shelter under him, got established firmly and became strong.
10.hi: ॥ अकम्पनस्ततस्तेषामादित्य इव तेजसा । तस्य निधावमानस्य संरब्धस्य युयुत्सया ॥ & ॥ इसीसे इसका अक्रम्पन नाम पड़ है स्‌ | [था । यह तेजस्वी अकम्पन ली न के बीच सूर्य की तरह चमचमा रहा था।यद्ध करने इच्छा कुद हो, दौड़ते हुए अकम्पन के ॥ हु जि न्यमागच्छद्धयानां रथवाहिनाम्‌ | यस्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सब्य युद्धाभिनान्द्नः

11.sa: अकम्पनस्तु शैलाभं हनूमन्तमवस्थितम् ।महेन्द्र इव धाराभिः शरैरभिववर्ष ह ।। ६.५६.११ ।।।।
11.en: On Akampana, who was well established like a mountain, mighty Hanuman showered torrents of arrows like Indra showered rain.
11.hi: उसका चेहरा फोका पड़ गया और कण्ठस्वर घरघराने लगा सुदिन होने पर भी उसके लिये वह दुर्दिन हो गया अर्थात्‌ सूर्य बादल में छिप गये ओर रूखी हवा चलने लगी

12.sa: अचिन्तयित्वा बाणौघान् शरीरे पतितान् शितान् ।अकम्पनवधार्थाय मनो दध्रे महाबलः ।। ६.५६.१२ ।।।।
12.en: Mighty Hanuman unmindful of the volley of arrows pierced in his body thought in his mind only about the destruction of Akampana.
12.hi: समस्त पशुपक्षी कूर और भयावनी बोलियाँ बोलने लगे । सिंह समान ऊचे कन्धो वाला और शादूल के समान विक्रमी अकम्पन,

13.sa: स प्रसह्य महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ।अभिदुद्राव तद्रक्षः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.५६.१३ ।।।।
13.en: Hanuman, the highly energetic son of Maruthi laughing, sprung up causing the earth to shake and rushed to that Rakshasa.
13.hi: इन उत्पार्तो की कुछ भी परवाह न कर, संग्रामभूमि में गया । सेना सहित उसके जाते ही

14.sa: तस्याभिनर्दमानस्य दीप्यमानस्य तेजसा ।बभूव रूपं दुर्धर्षं दीप्तस्येव विभावसोः ।। ६.५६.१४ ।।।।
14.en: As he roared, his brilliance was blazing, his form was burning and became formidable for others to be at him.
14.hi: बड़ा भारी शब्द हुआ, जिसने मानों समुद्र को भी खलबला दिआ। उस शब्द से वह वानरों की बड़ी सेना भी डर गई

15.sa: आत्मानमप्रहरणं ज्ञात्वा क्रोधसमन्वितः ।शैलमुत्पाटयामास वेगेन हरिपुङ्गवः ।। ६.५६.१५ ।।।।
15.en: Vanara leader himself knowing that he is without any weapon, full of anger took up a mountain quickly.
15.hi: दुर्दिनं--मेघच्छुन्नदिनं । ( गो० ) वा० रा० यु०--३३ डने के लिए पेड़ों और शिल्लाओं को लिए हुए खडे बानरों र में महामयङ्कर युद्ध हुआ

16.sa: तं गृहीत्वा महाशैलं पाणिनैकेन मारुतिः ।स विनद्य महानादं भ्रामयामास वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५६.१६ ।।।।
16.en: He, the heroic Maruthi, with one hand alone taking a huge mountain whirled round making loud noises.
16.hi: थे वानर और राक्षस यथाकम श्रीरामचन्द्र और रावण च लिए अपनी अपनी जाने हथेली पर रख हुए थे ग ये सब ही बडे बी ओर बहादुर थे ओर सब के शरीर पर्वतां की तरह विशाल ञ्चे

17.sa: ततस्तमभिदुद्राव राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ।पुरा हि नमुचिं सङ्ख्ये वज्रेणेव पुरन्दरः ।। ६.५६.१७ ।।।।
17.en: Then he went to Akampana and tormented him just as Indra did with his thunderbolt to Namuchi.

18.sa: अकम्पनस्तु तद्दृष्ट्वा गिरिशृङ्गं समुद्यतम् ।दूरादेव महाबाणैरर्धचन्द्रैर्व्यदारयत् ।। ६.५६.१८ ।।।।
18.en: Seeing the peak of the mountain uplifted, Akampana also discharged halfmoon shaped great arrows from a distance.
18.hi: बानर और राक्ष एक दूसरे को जान ल नेको तुले ड झै । इस युद्ध में अति वेग वाले योडाओ के गजल का शब्द ॥ १ - शुश्रवे सुमहान्‌ क्रोधादन्योन्यमभिगज तास्‌ । रजश्रारुणवर्णाम' सुभीममभवद्भृशस्‌

19.sa: तत्पर्वताग्रमाकाशे रक्षोबाणविदारितम् ।विशीर्णं पतितं दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।। ६.५६.१९ ।।।।
19.en: Hanuman seeing the peak of the mountain broken into pieces by Rakshasa's arrows and fallen was deluded with anger.

20.sa: सो ऽश्वकर्णं समासाद्य रोषदर्पान्वितो हरिः ।तूर्णमुत्पाटयामास महागिरिमिवोच्छ्रितम् ।। ६.५६.२० ।।।।
20.en: He (Hanuman) filled with pride and anger quickly uprooted an Aswakarana tree as huge as a mountain and held it.

21.sa: तं गृहीत्वा महास्कन्धं सो ऽश्वकर्णं महाद्युतिः ।प्रहस्य परया प्रीत्या भ्रामयामास संयुगे ।। ६.५६.२१ ।।।।
21.en: He (Hanuman) endowed with great splendour, seizing a huge trunk of Aswakarana tree with great delight, whirled it round on the ground laughing.

22.sa: प्रधावन्नूरुवेगेन प्रभञ्जंस्तरसा द्रुमान् ।हनुमान् परमक्रुद्धश्चरणैर्दारयत् क्षितिम् ।। ६.५६.२२ ।।।।
22.en: Highly enraged Hanuman was running at high speed that his feet were seen breaking the trees and cleaving the earth.
22.hi: उस तुमुल युद्ध में अवश्य सुनाई पड़ता था, किन्तु उनका रूप नहीं देख पड़ता था । उस भयङ्कर अन्कार में अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो वानरों के साथ वानर ही युद्ध करते हुए एक दूसरे को मार रहे थे

23.sa: गजांश्च सगजारोहान् सरथान् रथिनस्तथा ।जघान हनुमान् धीमान् राक्षसांश्च पदातिगान् ।। ६.५६.२३ ।।।।
23.en: Hanuman struck the mahouts, elephants, similarly the chariots and riders of chariots as well as the terrific Rakshasas who fought standing on feet.
23.hi: इसी प्रकार उस अन्धकार में राक्षस भी राक्षर्सा को मार रहे थे। अर्थात्‌ उस अन्धकार में अपने पराए की पहिचान नहीं हो सकती थी | वानर और राक्षस, दोनों अपने अपने शत्रो के साथ ही साथ अपने पक्ष बालों को भी मार रहे थे

24.sa: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं समरे प्राणहारिणम् ।हनुमन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य राक्षसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.५६.२४ ।।।।
24.en: Hanuman, enraged like the spirit of death, took their life (Rakshasas) armed with trees and on seeing him the Rakshasas took to their heels.
24.hi: यह युद्ध ऐसा भयङ्कर हुआ कि, युद्धभूमि में रक्त की कींच हो गई । रुधिर की धार बढ्ने से वहाँ की धूल दब गई

25.sa: तमापतन्तं सङ्क्रुद्धं राक्षसानां भयावहम् ।ददर्शाकम्पनो वीरश्चुक्रोध च ननाद च ।। ६.५६.२५ ।।।।
25.en: The heroic Akampana saw Hanuman coming towards him very angry. Fearing Hanuman, the Rakshasas ran roaring in fear.

26.sa: स चतुर्दशभिर्बाणैः शितैर्देहविदारणैः ।निर्बिभेद हनूमन्तं महावीर्यमकम्पनः ।। ६.५६.२६ ।।।।
26.en: With fourteen pointed powerful arrows, Akampana tormented and split the body of Hanuman.
26.hi: वानर और राक्षस एक दूसरे पर बलपूर्वक प्रहार कर रहे थे । परिघाकार भुजाओं से युद्ध करते हुए पर्वत के समान

27.sa: स तदा प्रतिविद्धस्तु बह्वीभिः शरवृष्टिभिः ।हनुमान् ददृशे वीरः प्ररूढ इव सानुमान् ।। ६.५६.२७ ।।।।
27.en: Valiant Hanuman, even though interrupted several times with rain of arrows, stood still like a mountain full of trees.
27.hi: इधर से तो भयङ्कर कमचारी वानर राक्षर्सा को मार रहे र और उधर से राक्षस भी कुद्ध हो, हाथ में प्रास आर तोमर आदि अत्यन्त दारुण शस्त्र ले, उनसे वानरों को मार रहे थे। साथ ही रादासी सेना का सेनापति अकम्पन अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो,

28.sa: विरराज महाकायो महावीर्यो महामनाः ।पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशो विधूम इव पावकः ।। ६.५६.२८ ।।।।
28.en: The gigantic Hanuman, exceedingly valiant and courageous one shone like a fully blossomed Ashoka tree, resembled smokeless fire.

29.sa: ततो ऽन्यं वृक्षमुत्पाट्य कत्वा वेगमनुत्तमम् ।शिरस्यभिजघानाशु राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ।। ६.५६.२९ ।।।।
29.en: Then Hanuman performed another supreme deed by uprooting a tree and striking on the head of Akampana, the chief of Rakshasas.

30.sa: स वृक्षेण हतस्तेन सक्रोधेन महात्मना ।राक्षशो वानरेन्द्रेण पपात च ममार च ।। ६.५६.३० ।।।।
30.en: Reacting in anger the great Vanara chief struck the Rakshasa with a tree, by which the Rakshasa fell down dead.
30.hi: उन भीम विक्रमी समस्त राक्षर्सा को उत्थाहित कर रहा था | वानर भी बढ़े बढ़े पेड़ों और बड़ी बड़ी शिलाओं रास) ERB) lees को गनछ rind Ib ws १ संहर्घयति--उत्साइयति । (गो) .. ` त ee »>ऋयजी भा ।े षट्पश्चाराः सग; ४८७१ विदाश्यन्त्यभिक्रम्य? शस्त्राणयाब्िद्यर वीयतः एतिस्मिन्नन्तरे बीरा हरयः कुग्रदो नसः

31.sa: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं भूमौ राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ।व्यथिता राक्षसाः सर्वे क्षितिकम्प इव द्रुमाः ।। ६.५६.३१ ।।।।
31.en: Seeing Akampana lying dead on the ground, the Rakshasas were shaken like the trees in the earthquake and were distressed.

32.sa: त्यक्तप्रहरणाः सर्वे राक्षसास्ते पराजिताः ।लङ्कामभिययुस्त्रस्ता वानरैस्तैरभिद्रुताः ।। ६.५६.३२ ।।।।
32.en: Abandoning weapons, all Rakshasas having been defeated, chased by the Vanaras, frightened, ran away into Lanka.

33.sa: ते मुक्तकेशाः सम्भ्रान्ता भग्नमानाः पराजिताः ।स्रवच्छ्रमजलैरङ्गैः श्वसन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.५६.३३ ।।।।
33.en: Perplexed, broken hearted, defeated, hair loosened the Rakshasas sweating all over their limbs, sighing heavily ran away very fast.

34.sa: अन्योन्यं प्रममन्थुस्ते विविशुर्नगरं भयात् ।पृष्ठतस्ते सुसम्मूढाः प्रेक्षमाणा मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ६.५६.३४ ।।।।
34.en: Again, and again looking back in fear, covertly, bewildered, crushing one another, they went into the Lanka city.

35.sa: तेषु लङ्कां प्रविष्टेषु राक्षसेषु महाबलाः ।समेत्य हरयः सर्वे हनुमन्तमपूजयन् ।। ६.५६.३५ ।।।।
35.en: Those Rakshasas, endowed with prowess, on entering Lanka got together and paid respects to Hanuman.

36.sa: सो ऽपि प्रहृष्टस्तान् सर्वान् हरीन् प्रत्यभ्यपूजयत् ।हनुमान् सत्त्वसम्पन्नो यथार्हमनुकूलतः ।। ६.५६.३६ ।।।।
36.en: Hanuman also who was richly endowed with goodness greatly honoured all the Vanaras accordingly.

37.sa: विनेदुश्च यथाप्राणं हरयो जितकाशिनः ।चकर्षुश्च पुनस्तत्र सप्राणानपि राक्षसान् ।। ६.५६.३७ ।।।।
37.en: In an atmosphere of triumph, the monkeys sportively shouted again saying that they are willing to give up their life also.

38.sa: स वीरशोभामभजन्महाकपिः समेत्य रक्षांसि निहत्य मारुतिः ।महासुरं भीमममित्रनाशनं यथैव विष्णुर्बलिनं चमूमुखे ।। ६.५६.३८ ।।।।
38.en: Great Vanara, Maruti shone like a triumphant hero and saviour in front of the army, just as Lord Vishnu, the Lord of Devatas shone after killing the foes (demons).

39.sa: अपूजयन् देवगणास्तदा कपिं स्वयं च रामो ऽतिबलश्च लक्ष्मणः ।तथैव सुग्रीवमुखाः प्लवङ्गमा विभीषणश्चैव महाबलस्तथा ।। ६.५६.३९ ।।
39.en: Thereafter Rama with the army of Devatas, Atibala and Lakshmana, in the same way Sugriva, the army chief, so also, Vibheeshana of exceeding might praised Hanuman. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: अकम्पनवधं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो वै राक्षसेश्वरः ।किञ्चिद्दीनमुखश्चापि सचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ।। ६.५७.१ ।।।।
1.en: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.
1.hi: समर में वानरश्रेष्ठी की बदादुरी देख, अकम्पन बहुत क्रुद्ध हुआ

2.sa: स तु ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु मन्त्रिभिः संविचार्य च ।ततस्तु रावणः पूर्वदिवसे राक्षसाधिपः ।पुरीं परिययौ लङ्कां सर्वान् गुल्मानवेक्षितुम् ।। ६.५७.२ ।।।।
2.en: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, reflected for a while and deliberated with his ministers and proceeded in the forenoon to inspect all posts in Lanka.
2.hi: शत्रणां सारथि वाक्यमत्रवस्‌ ॥ जक ने "कोरा और शत्रुओं उसने क्रद्ध हो अपने धनुष का रोदा टंकोरा र की वीरता देख, वह अपने सारथी से कहने लगा

3.sa: तां राक्षसगणैर्गुप्तां गुल्मैर्बहुभिरावृताम् ।ददर्श नगरीं लङ्कां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ।। ६.५७.३ ।।।।
3.en: Ravana saw Lanka guarded by the Rakshasa army, surrounded by many posts, with flags, posts, and pennants.
3.hi: हे सारथे ! तुम तुरन्त मेरा रथ उस जरा पहुँचा दो, जहाँ पर युद्ध में बहुत से वानर बहुत से राक्ष्सों को मार रहे हैं

4.sa: रुद्धां तु नगरीं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।उवाचामर्षतः काले प्रहस्तं युद्धकोविदम् ।। ६.५७.४ ।।।।
4.en: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the city besieged, spoke to Prahastha who was skilled in warfare for his welfare.
4.hi: जो विपुल-शरीर-घारी वानर वृक्षों और शिलाओं को लिये इए, समर की अभिलाषा से मेरे सामने खड़े हैं, बड़े बल- वान हैं

5.sa: पुरस्योपनिविष्टस्य सहसा पीडितस्य वा ।नान्यं युद्धात् प्रपश्यामि मोक्षं युद्धविशारद ।। ६.५७.५ ।।।।
5.en: "I am not able to see anyone (other than you) knowledgeable in warfare to deliver the city oppressed suddenly and can liberate from war."
5.hi: अतः समर में वड़ाई चाहने वाला, म इन बलवान बानरों को मारना चाहता हूँ। क्‍योंकि इन्हीं लोगों द्वारा समस्त राक्षसी सेना का नाश होता हुआ देख पड़ता है

6.sa: अहं वा कुम्भकर्णो वा त्वं वा सेनापतिर्मम ।इन्द्रजिद्वा निकुम्भो वा वहेयुर्भारमीदृशम् ।। ६.५७.६ ।।।।
6.en: "Either myself or Kumbhakarna, or my CommanderinChief, or you, or Indrajith, or Nikumbha can undertake such a burden."
6.hi: , SMU) DE ४५:५१ नता म 4 $ प्रमुखे शरग्रे | ( गो० ) २ प्रजवनाश्वेन- वेगवदश्वेन । ( गो० ) षट्पश्चाशाः सग; ४८६ रथियों ( बीरों ) में श्रेष्ठ अकम्पन, अत्यन्त तेज चलने वाले घोड़ों के रथ में बैठा हुआ और क्रोध में भर, बहुत से बाण छोड़ता हुआ, वानरों को मारने लगा

7.sa: स त्वं बलमतः शीघ्रमादाय परिगृह्य च ।विजयायाभिनिर्याहि यत्र सर्वे वनौकसः ।। ६.५७.७ ।।।।
7.en: "Therefore, quickly get ready with the army and take charge for conquering the vanaras collected there."
7.hi: न स्थात्‌, वानराः शेकुः किं पुनर्थोद्धुमाहवे । अक्म्पनशरे भग्नाः सर्व एव बिदुद्र्वुः ॥ ७ अकम्पन ने उस समय ऐसी म।रकाट मचाई कि, उसके बाण की मार से सब वानर भाग खड़े हुए, उससे युद्ध करना तो एक ओर रहा, उसके सामने भी कोई न खड़ा रह सका

8.sa: निर्याणादेव ते नूनं चपला हरिवाहिनी ।नर्दतां राक्षसेन्द्राणां श्रुत्वा नादं द्रविष्यति ।। ६.५७.८ ।।।।
8.en: As soon as you go there surely the unsettled Vanara army will run away hearing the uproar and loud noise of Rakshasas.
8.hi: परन्तु महाबली हनुमान जी अपनी जाति वाले ( वानरों ) को अकम्पन के वाणों से विवश और मृत्यु के मुख में जाते देख, अकम्पन का सामना कर ने को आगे बढ़े

9.sa: चपला ह्यविनीताश्च चलचित्ताश्च वानराः ।न सहिष्यन्ति ते नादं सिंहनादमिव द्विपाः ।। ६.५७.९ ।।।।
9.en: "Vanaras, who are fickle minded, undisciplined and volatile, will not endure the roar of lions of glowing Rakshasas."

10.sa: विद्रुते च बले तस्मिन् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ।अवशस्ते निरालम्बः प्रहस्त वशमेष्यति ।। ६.५७.१० ।।।।
10.en: "Prahastha! Knowing your strength, the helpless Vanaras will surely run away and along with Saumithri. Rama will fall into your power."
10.hi: फल हरे केश बलवान हलुमान जी को अकम्पन का सामना करने को खड़ा होते और और उनका सहारा पा, उन भागे हुए वानर यूथपतियों का उत्साह बढ़ा

11.sa: आपत् संशयिता श्रेयो न तु निस्संशयीकृता ।प्रतिलोमानुलोमं वा यद्वा नो मन्यसे हितम् ।। ६.५७.११ ।।।।
11.en: "If uncertain death comes it is good, not when it comes by not encountering. Think what is acceptable to you and what is not acceptable to you and that is acceptable to me."
11.hi: अपने सामने पर्वत की तरह अटल अचल हनुमान जी को खड़ा देख, अकम्पन ने उन पर उसी प्रकार वाणवृष्टि की; जिस प्रकार इन्द्र जल की वृष्टि करते हैं

12.sa: रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाचेदमसुरेन्द्रमिवोशना ।। ६.५७.१२ ।।।।
12.en: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief having heard Ravana, replied to the king of Rakshasas just as the preceptor of Rakshasas spoke to Bali.

13.sa: राजन् मन्त्रितपूर्वं नः कुशलैः सह मन्त्रिभिः ।विवादश्चापि नो वृत्तः समवेक्ष्य परस्परम् ।। ६.५७.१३ ।।।।
13.en: "O king! This was deliberated with capable ministers earlier, is it not It was reviewed with one another, and controversy arose."
13.hi: वे महातेजस्वी पवननन्दन हनुमान जी प्रथ्वी को कंपाते ओर अट्टहास करते हुए, अकम्पन पर झपटे

14.sa: प्रदानेन तु सीतायाः श्रेयो व्यवसितं मया ।अप्रदाने पुनर्युद्धं दृष्टमेतत्तथैव नः ।। ६.५७.१४ ।।।।
14.en: "If Sita is given away it is beneficial and if not given war is foreseen is known to us."
14.hi: उश समय सिंहनाद करते हुए और तेज से दीप्यमान पवन- नन्दन ऐसे जान पड़े, मानों दहकती हुई आग हो | उस समय उनका रूप दुधेष हो गया

15.sa: सो ऽहं दानैश्च मानैश्च सततं पूजितस्त्वया ।सान्त्वैश्च विविधैः काले किं न कुर्यां प्रियं तव ।। ६.५७.१५ ।।।।
15.en: "You have always given me gifts, many honours and praises earlier and worshipped me. When time comes why will I not do"

16.sa: न हि मे जीवितं रक्ष्यं पुत्रदारधनानि वा ।त्वं पश्य मां जुहूषन्तं त्वदर्थं जीवितं युधि ।। ६.५७.१६ ।।।।
16.en: "I do not need to protect my life, sons, wives and wealth also. I am willing to give up my life also in war for you. You will see."
16.hi: बलवान पवननन्दन ने उस पर्वत को एक हाथ में उठा लिआ और उसे घुमाते हुए वे बड़ी जोर से गरजे

17.sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु भर्तारं रावणं वाहिनीपतिः ।उवाचेदं बलाध्यक्षान् प्रहस्तः पुरतः स्थितान् ।। ६.५७.१७ ।।।।
17.en: Prahastha, having submitted to his king Ravana in that way, the CommanderinChief of the army commanded the army that stood before him.
17.hi: उस पर्वत को लिये हुए हनुमान जी उस र।क्षसश्रेछ अकम्पन की ओर वैसे ही दोड़े, जैसे पहिले किसी समय इन्द्र बज लिये हुए नमुचि की ओर दौड़े थे

18.sa: समानयत मे शीघ्रं राक्षसानां महद्बलम् ।। ६.५७.१८ ।।।।
18.en: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

19.sa: मद्बाणशतवेगेन हतानां च रणाजिरे ।अद्य तृप्यन्तु मांसादाः पक्षिणः काननौकसाम् ।। ६.५७.१९ ।।।।
19.en: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

20.sa: इत्युक्तास्ते प्रहस्तेन बलाध्यक्षाः कृतत्वराः ।बलमुद्योजयामासुस्तस्मिन् राक्षसमन्दिरे ।। ६.५७.२० ।।।।
20.en: As soon as the commander in chief ordered in that way, the Rakshasa troops mobilized in the abode of Rakshasas.
20.hi: रोष में भरे हुए हनुमान जी ने अश्वकर्ण ( एक प्रकार का शालवृक्ष ) वृक्ष के समीप जा, तुरन्त उसे उखाड़ लिआ। वह अश्वकर्ण वृक्ष एक बड़े पहाड़ की तरह लंबा था

21.sa: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन तिग्मनानाविधायुधैः ।लङ्का राक्षसवीरैस्तैर्गजैरिव समाकुला ।। ६.५७.२१ ।।।।
21.en: In a short while the whole of Lanka was filled with elephant size Rakshasa warriors gathered with different kinds of weapons.
21.hi: महाद्य तिमान इनुमान जी ने युद्धक्षेत्र में उस मोटे तने के अश्वकर्ण को ले कर, परम प्रसन्न हो और अट्टहास करते हुए, उसे घुमाया

22.sa: हुताशनं तर्पयतां ब्राह्मणांश्च नमस्यताम् ।आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहः सुरभिर्मारुतो ववौ ।। ६.५७.२२ ।।।।
22.en: A fragrant breeze blew past there with Rakshasas propitiating fire god, with offerings and by the worshipping of brahmins the air was pleasant filled with the fragrance of ghee and flowers.

23.sa: स्रजश्च विविधाकारा जगृहुस्त्वभिमन्त्रिताः ।सङ्ग्रामसज्जाः संहृष्टा धारयन् राक्षसास्तदा ।। ६.५७.२३ ।।।।
23.en: Then the Rakshasas rejoiced, wishing victory, consecrated military material with chanting and wore flower garland s.

24.sa: सधनुष्काः कवचिनो वेगादाप्लुत्य राक्षसाः ।रावणं प्रेक्ष्य राजानं प्रहस्तं पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.५७.२४ ।।।।
24.en: Wearing bows and shields, looking at and greeting the king Ravana, they swiftly surrounded Prahastha.
24.hi: काल की तरह क्रुद्ध और युद्ध में प्राणनाश करने वाले इचु- मान जी को देख, राक्षस योद्धा युद्ध छोड़ भाग खड़े हुए

25.sa: अथामन्त्र्य च राजानं भेरीमाहत्य भैरवाम् ।आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं प्रहस्तः सज्जकल्पितम् ।। ६.५७.२५ ।।।।
25.en: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
25.hi: राक्षस सेनापति बीर अकम्पन, राक्षसों को भय उपजाने बाले हनुमान जी को अत्यन्त कऋ.द हो आक्रमण करते देख, अत्यन्त क्रू.द्ध हुआ और गर्जा

26.sa: हयैर्महाजवैर्युक्तं सम्यक् सूतसुसंयतम् ।महाजलदनिर्घोषं साक्षाच्चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् ।। ६.५७.२६ ।।।।
26.en: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
26.hi: उस महाबली अकम्पन ने पैने और शरीर को बिदीण करने वाले १४ बाण हनुमान जी के मार कर, उनको घायल कर दिआ

27.sa: उरगध्वजदुर्द्धर्षं सुवरूथं स्वपस्करम् ।सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तं प्रहसन्तमिव श्रिया ।। ६.५७.२७ ।।।।
27.en: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
27.hi: बहुत से बाणों की वृष्टि से घायल होने पर, वीर हनुमान जी वृक्षों से युक्त एक गिरश्शज्ञ की तरह देख पड़ते थे

28.sa: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय रावणार्पितशासनः ।लङ्काया निर्ययौ तूर्णं बलेन महता वृतः ।। ६.५७.२८ ।।।।
28.en: Then, by the order of Ravana, Prahastha set out immediately and departed from Lanka taking a se at in the chariot, surrounded by the great army.
28.hi: महाकाय, महाबलवान्‌ और महामना हनुमान जी उस समया वैसे शोभायमान दो रहे थे, जैसे फूला हुआ अशोक का उक्त अथ ८ बिना घुएँ की ( घधकती हुई ) आग

29.sa: ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः ।वादित्राणां च निनदः पूरयन्निव सागरम् ।शुश्रुवे शङ्खशब्दश्च प्रयाते वाहिनीपतौ ।। ६.५७.२९ ।।।।
29.en: As the CommanderinChief was going there arose sounds of kettle drums, blasts of fanfares, and noise of blasts of conchs filling the earth was heard.

30.sa: निनदन्तः स्वरान् घोरान् राक्षसा जग्मुरग्रतः ।भीमरूपा महाकायाः प्रहस्तस्य पुरस्सराः ।। ६.५७.३० ।।।।
30.en: Rakshasas of fierce appearance, of huge body size, making dreadful sounds went marching ahead of Prahastha.
30.hi: क्रोध से पूर्ण, महाबली एवं वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमान जी द्वारा वृक्ष के प्रहार से घायल हो, वह राक्षेस उसी चण प्रथ्बी पर गिर कर सर गया

31.sa: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः ।प्रहस्तसचिवा ह्येते निर्ययुः परिवार्य तम् ।। ६.५७.३१ ।।।।
31.en: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnatha, the adjutants of Prahastha went with him.
31.hi: राक्षेसश्रेष्ठ अकम्पन को जमीन पर मरा हुआ पड़ा देख, उसकी सेना के अन्य राक्षेस योद्धा वैसे ही व्यथित हो थरी उठ, जैसे भूकम्प होने पर इत्ते थरा उठते हैं

32.sa: व्यूढेनैव सुघोरेण पूर्वद्वारात् स निर्ययौ ।गजयूथनिकाशेन बलेन महता वृतः ।। ६.५७.३२ ।।।।
32.en: He, emerged from the eastern gate, surrounded by a huge, formidable army formed into a battlearray, which resembled a herd of elephants.
32.hi: उन पराजित राक्षर्सा ने अपने अपने हथियार पटक दिये और बानरों द्वारा खदेड़े जा कर, वे भयभीत हो लङ्का की ओर भाग गए

33.sa: सागरप्रतिमौघेन वृतस्तेन बलेन सः ।प्रहस्तो निर्ययौ तूर्णं कालान्तकयमोपमः ।। ६.५७.३३ ।।।।
33.en: Prahastha emerged in rage surrounded by his forces which was like an ocean that resembled Kala (time spirit), Anthaka (death) and Yama (God of death).
33.hi: इस प्रकार भागते समय उन राक्तंसों की बड़ी दुर्गति हो रही. थी। उनके [सर के बाल बिखर गए थे। उस समय घबड़ाए हुए | ठ्ठ त्त्य ७ 0 गर, होने के कारण और हार जाने के कारण उनका सान भङ्गहो चुका था। उनके शरीरों से पसीना टपक रहा था और दे हाँफते हुए भागे जा रहे थे

34.sa: तस्य निर्याणघोषेण राक्षसानां च नर्दताम् ।लङ्कायां सर्वभूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः ।। ६.५७.३४ ।।।।
34.en: By the sounds of roaring that emerged at the departure of the Rakshasas all beings of Lanka shrieked in unnatural ways.
34.hi: वे सारे डर के आपस में एक दूसरे से लटपटाते किसी तरह लङ्का में पहुँचे । किन्तु सागते समय भी वे बार बार फिर फिर कर अपने पीछे हनुमान जी को देखते जाते थे

35.sa: व्यभ्रमाकाशमाविश्य मांसशोणितभोजनाः ।मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि खगाश्चक्रू रथं प्रति ।। ६.५७.३५ ।।।।
35.en: The birds living on flesh and blood reached the sky and circled anticlockwise around the chariot.
35.hi: उन महाबली राक्षसा के भाग कर लङ्का में घुस जाने पर, सब वानरों ने एकत्र हो (अर्थात्‌ एक स्वर से ) हनुमान जी की प्रशंशा की

36.sa: वमन्त्यः पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरं ववाशिरे ।अन्तरिक्षात् पपातोल्का वायुश्च परुषो ववौ ।। ६.५७.३६ ।।।।
36.en: A meteor fell from the sky, the wind blew violently. Jackals howled vomiting tongues of fire.
36.hi: बलवान्‌ हनुमान जीने भी परम प्रसन्न हो, उन सब बानरों से कहा कि, आप ही लोगों की सहायता से मने यह विजय पाया है । फिर उन्होंने बानरों को गले लगा आर उनके साथ यथा योग्य बातचीत कर उनको उत्साहित किआ

37.sa: अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धा ग्रहाश्च न चकाशिरे ।। ६.५७.३७ ।।।।
37.en: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

38.sa: मेघाश्च खरनिर्घोषा रथस्योपरि रक्षसः ।ववृषू रुधिरं चास्य सिषिचुश्च पुरस्सरान् ।। ६.५७.३८ ।।।।
38.en: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.
38.hi: जिस प्रकार भगवान्‌ विष्णु, महाभयङ्कर एवं रात्र्‌ हन्ता ( मधु केटभादि ) बढ़े बड़े असुरों को मार कर, शोभायमान हुए थे, उसी प्रकार पवननन्दन हनुमान जो राक्षसों को मार वीरो- चित शोभा से शोभायमान हुए

39.sa: केतुमूर्धनि गृध्रो ऽस्य निलीनो दक्षिणामुखः ।तुदन्नुभयतः पार्श्वं समग्रामहरत् प्रभाम् ।। ६.५७.३९ ।।।।
39.en: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.

40.sa: सारथेर्बहुशश्चास्य सङ्ग्राममवगाहतः ।प्रतोदो न्यपतद्धस्तात् सूतस्य हयसादिनः ।। ६.५७.४० ।।।।
40.en: A charioteer and knower of controlling the horses, the whip slipped many times from his hand.

41.sa: निर्याणश्रीश्च या ऽस्यासीद्भास्वरा वसुदुर्लभा ।सा ननाश मुहूर्तेन समे च स्खलिता हयाः ।। ६.५७.४१ ।।।।
41.en: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.

42.sa: प्रहस्तं त्वभिनिर्यान्तं प्रख्यातबलपौरुषम् ।युधि नानाप्रहरणा कपिसेना ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.५७.४२ ।।।।
42.en: Seeing Prahastha, who is well known for his valour coming towards, for war with various weapons, the monkey army stood facing.

43.sa: अथ घोषः सुतुमुलो हरीणां समजायत ।वृक्षानारुजतां चैव गुर्वीरागृह्णतां शिलाः ।। ६.५७.४३ ।।।।
43.en: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.

44.sa: नदतां राक्षसानां च वानराणां च गर्जताम् ।उभे प्रमुदिते सैन्ये रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् ।। ६.५७.४४ ।।।।
44.en: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

45.sa: वेगितानां समर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।परस्परं चाह्वयतां निनादः श्रूयते महान् ।। ६.५७.४५ ।।।।
45.en: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

46.sa: ततः प्रहस्तः कपिराजवाहिनीमभिप्रतस्थे विजयाय दुर्मतिः ।विवृद्धवेगां च विवेश तां चमूं यथा मुमूर्षुः शलभो विभावसुम् ।। ६.५७.४६ ।।
46.en: Thereafter, perverted Prahastha entered into that army of monkey king grown immensely, to conquer the army, just as moth enters into flame, being at the point of death. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेसप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty seventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं दृष्ट्वा भीमपराक्रमम् ।उवाच सस्मितं रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमः ।। ६.५८.१ ।।।।
1.en: Then Rama seeing Prahastha, the tamer of enemies of terrific valour coming towards him, said to Vibheeshana, having a gentle smile.
1.hi: अकम्पन के मारे जाने का संवाद सुन, राक्षसराज रावण क्रद्ध हुआ और उदास हो, अपने मंत्रियों की ओर निहारने लगा

2.sa: क एष सुमहाकायो बलेन महता वृतः ।आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो वीर्यवन्तं निशाचरम् ।। ६.५८.२ ।।।।
2.en: "Oh, Broad shouldered Vibheeshana! Who is this Rakshasa of gigantic form coming surrounded by a great army He seems to be a valiant one. Tell me."

3.sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.५८.३ ।।।।
3.en: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."
3.hi: उस पुरी की मोचेंबंदो देखने को लङ्कापुरी में चारों ओर घूमा । राक्षसा से रक्षित, अनेक मोर्चेबंदियों से युक्त तथा ध्वजा- पताकाओं एवं मालाओं से सुसज्जित लङ्कापुरी की तथा बानरो द्वारा डाले हुए पुरी के घेरों को देख, रादासराज रावण ने,

4.sa: एष सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः ।लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य त्रिभागबलसंवृतः ।वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरः प्रख्यातश्च पराक्रमे ।। ६.५८.४ ।।।।
4.en: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."

5.sa: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम् ।गर्जन्तं सुमहाकायं राक्षसैरभिसंवृतम् ।। ६.५८.५ ।।।।
5.en: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.
5.hi: आर विपत्तिकाल में अपने दितैपी एव' युद्धविशारद पहस्त से कहा-हे युद्धविशारद ! शत्र, की सेना लङ्कापुरी को चारों कोर से घेर कर पुरवासियों को जिस प्रकार तंग कर रही है, उससे तो युद्ध करने के सिवाय, इन लोगों से छुटकारा पाने का, अन्य कोई उपाय मुके नटी देख पड़ता ; किन्तु स्वय से, ` अथवा कुम्मंकर्ण अथवा मेरे सेनापति तुम

6.sa: ददर्श महती सेना वानराणां बलीयसाम् ।अतिसञ्जातरोषाणां प्रहस्तमभिगर्जताम् ।। ६.५८.६ ।।।।
6.en: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.
6.hi: राक्षसश्रेष्ठा का गर्जन सुन वानर इधर उधर भाग जाँयगे। क्योंकि वानर चपल, अशिक्षित और चञ्चलचित्त होते हैं

7.sa: खड्गशक्त्यृष्टिबाणाश्च शूलानि मुसलानि च ।गदाश्च परिघाः प्रासा विविधाश्च परश्वधाः ।। ६.५८.७ ।।।।
7.en: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.
7.hi: अथवा इन्द्रजीत, अथवा निकुम्भ-ये हो इस भार कों उठा : सकते हैं | अतएव तुम सेना को साथ लेकर तथा रथ में सवार हो कर, विजयप्राप्ति के लिए वहाँ शीघ्र जाओ, जहा वे सब वानर ठहरे हुए हैं । तुम्हा रे जाते हो वानरो सेना घबड़ा जायगी

8.sa: धनूंषि च विचित्राणि राक्षसानां जयैषिणाम् ।प्रगृहीतान्यशोभन्त वानरानभिधावताम् ।। ६.५८.८ ।।।।
8.en: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.

9.sa: जगृहुः पादपांश्चापि पुष्पितान् वानरर्षभाः ।शिलाश्च विपुला दीर्घा योद्धुकामाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.५८.९ ।।।।
9.en: The Vanaras burning with desire to fight, for their part went with huge trees in bloom, huge and long rocks.

10.sa: तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्य सङ्ग्रामः सुमहानभूत् ।बहूनामश्मवृष्टिं च शरवृष्टिं च वर्षताम् ।। ६.५८.१० ।।।।
10.en: Each of them approached one another with showers of rocks and many arrows and by that a great war happened.
10.hi: वे तुम्हारा गजेन तजन वेत ही न सह सकेंगे, जैसे हाथी सिंह का गजन नहों सह सकता । जब वानरी सेना भाग जायगी, तब लक्ष्मण सहित राम

11.sa: बहवो राक्षसा युद्धे बहून् वानरयूथपान् ।वानरा राक्षसांश्चापि निजघ्नुर्बहवो बहून् ।। ६.५८.११ ।।।।
11.en: In the course of war many Rakshasas killed many Vanara leaders and many Vanaras killed many Rakshasas also.
11.hi: प्रभुत्वरहित और निरालंब हो, तुम्हारे अधीन हो जाँयगे। हे प्रहस्त ! इस समय सन्देह तो हार ही में है, हमारे विजय में तो जुरा मी संशय नहीं है । अथवा हे प्रहस्त ! इस समय यह नहीं कहा जा सकता कि, कोन मारा जायगा; किन्तु हम लोगों की जीत निरसंशय हे

12.sa: शूलैः प्रमथिताः केचित् केचिच्च परमायुधैः ।परिघैराहताः केचित् केचिच्छिन्नाः परश्वधैः ।। ६.५८.१२ ।।।।
12.en: Indeed, some were killed by Rakshasas with pikes, some by javelins, a few with iron bars, and a few were hacked with axes.
12.hi: ऐसी दशा में मेरे इस कथन के प्रतिकूल या अनूकूल, जिसमें मेरा हित तुम समझो, वही करो । जब रावण ने इस प्रकार कहा तब सेनापति प्रहस्त

13.sa: निरुच्छ्वासाः कृताः केचित् पतिता धरणीतले ।विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदिषुसन्धानसन्दिताः ।। ६.५८.१३ ।।।।
13.en: Few got cut and deprived of life and fell on the ground. Some struck by arrows had their hearts broken into pieces.
13.hi: रावण से बैसे ही बोला, जैसे दैत्यराज से शुक्राचायं बोलते हैं। हे राजन्‌! हम लोगों ने कुशल मंत्रियों के साथ इस सम्बन्ध में परामशे किआ था

14.sa: केचिद्द्विधा कृताः खड्गैः स्फुरन्तः पतिता भुवि ।वानरा राक्षसैः शूलैः पार्श्वतश्चावदारिताः ।। ६.५८.१४ ।।।।
14.en: Few Vanaras cut into two by Rakshasas fell down and few Vanaras fell on the ground sides of the body cleft ceased life.
14.hi: आवशः=प्रसुत्वरहितः । (गो०) २ आपत्‌-मृर्यु पर दुःख हुबा। ( रा० ) ३ भयो -विजयस्दु । ( रा० ) वा० रा० यु०--३४ विवादश्चापि नो वृत्तः समवेवथ परस्परम्‌ प्रदानेन तु सीतायाः श्रेयो व्यवसितं मया । 34 60) न [पस में विवाद उठ खड़ा हुझ की मु डो हाई । (किन्तु) वैर आपको सीता के दे, डालने का परामशे दिआ था ऑर इसी में भलाई समझी थी

15.sa: वानरैश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धै राक्षसौघाः समन्ततः ।पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च सम्पिष्टा वसुधातले ।। ६.५८.१५ ।।।।
15.en: Then the highly enraged Vanaras completely crushed Rakshasas in groups by crushing them on the earth's surface with trees and mountain peaks.
15.hi: उस समय मैने यह भी कह दिशा था कि, यदि सीता न दी गई, तो युद्ध करना ही पड़ेगा। सो वही युद्ध करने समय प्राप्त हुआ है । हे राच्चसराज ' समय समय पर भूषणा वी कर तथा मुझसे प्रिय भाषण (मेरा जीवन तुम्हारे ही अधीन हे आदि बातें कह ) कर, तुमने सदा मुझे सम्मानित किआ अथवा मेरा उत्कर्ष बढ़ाया है

16.sa: वज्रस्पर्शतलैर्हस्तैर्मुष्टिभिश्च हता भृशम् ।वैमुः शोणितमास्येभ्यो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणाः ।। ६.५८.१६ ।।।।
16.en: Hit by fists and hands that had the impact of thunderbolt, teeth and eyes smashed and fallen out, the Rakshasas vomited blood from their mouth excessively.
16.hi: आर विविध प्रकार से सममा बुरा कर धैयें बँघाया है । अत: इस विपत्तिकाल में, में तुम्हारे हित साधन का काम क्यों न करूँगा ? अब.मुमे न तो अपने प्राणों की रक्षा की चिन्ता है ओर न पुत्र खी तथा धनधान्य की कुछ ममता ही दे

17.sa: आर्तस्वनं च स्वनतां सिंहनादं च नर्दताम् ।बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो हरीणां रक्षसां युधि ।। ६.५८.१७ ।।।।
17.en: Tumultuous noise like the roar of lions arose in the battlefield with Vanaras and Rakshasas cries of pain.

18.sa: वानरा राक्षसाः क्रुद्धा वीरमार्गमनुव्रताः ।विवृत्तनयनाः क्रूराश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ।। ६.५८.१८ ।।।।
18.en: Following the path of heroes and infuriated, their eyes reeling, the vanaras and rakshasas carried out their deeds without fear.

19.sa: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः ।एते प्रहस्तसचिवाः सर्वे जघ्नुर्वनौकसः ।। ६.५८.१९ ।।।।
19.en: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnata, all these associates of Prahastha made short work of the monkeys.

20.sa: तेषामापततां शीघ्रं निघ्नतां चापि वानरान् ।द्विविदो गिरिशृङ्गेण जघानैकं नरान्तकम् ।। ६.५८.२० ।।।।
20.en: Rushing at great speed, the Rakshasas and also killing the Vanaras in that way, Dwivida alone struck down Naranthaka with a mountain peak.
20.hi: इस प्रक्रार जब प्रहस्त ने कहा, तब वे सेनाध्यच शोघ्रतापूवेक अहस्त के घर ही पर सेना एकत्र करने लगे

21.sa: दुर्मुखः पुनरुत्थाय कपिः स विपुलद्रुमम् ।राक्षसं क्षिप्रहस्तस्तु समुन्नतमपोथयत् ।। ६.५८.२१ ।।।।
21.en: Dhurmukha monkey uprooting a huge tree holding it in hand killed the Rakshasa Samunnata.
21.hi: सा बभूव मुहर्तेन तिग्मनानाविधाय थैः । लङ्का रोच्तसी रैस्तैगजैरिव समाकुला ।। २१:॥ थोड़ी देर में विविध प्रकार के आयुधधारी भयङ्कर वीर राक्षसों से, गर्जो की तरह लड्कापुरो भर गई

22.sa: जाम्बवांस्तु सुसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम् ।पातयामास तेजस्वी महानादस्य वक्षसि ।। ६.५८.२२ ।।।।
22.en: Energetic Jambavantha, enraged, took a huge rock, and hurled at the chest of Mahanada who fell down.
22.hi: मङ्गलकामना के लिए अनेक राक्षत हवन करने लगे । बहुतों ने ब्राह्मणों की बन्दना की । होम किए हुए घो की सुगन्धि मिलने के कारण सुगन्धित हवा चलने लगी

23.sa: अथ कुम्भहनुस्तत्र तारेणासाद्य वीर्यवान् ।वृक्षेणाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि प्राणान् सन्त्याजयद्रणे ।। ६.५८.२३ ।।।।
23.en: And thereafter, valiant Tara closed with Kumbhahanu and attacked him with a tree on the head and he lost his life.
23.hi: युद्ध में जाने के लिए उद्यत अनेक राक्षस, मत्र से अभिमंत्रित विविध प्रकार के फूलों की मालाए ले आर उनको धारण कर बड़े प्रसन्न हुए

24.sa: अमृष्यमाणस्तत्कर्म प्रहस्तो रथमास्थितः ।चकार कदनं घोरं धनुष्पाणिर्वनौकसाम् ।। ६.५८.२४ ।।।।
24.en: Then intolerant of the exploit, Prahastha got on to the chariot with bow in hand and caused dreadful havoc among the monkeys.
24.hi: धनुष लिये और कवच पहिने हुए राक्षसों ने सवारियों से नीचे उतर अपने राजा रावण को प्रणाम किआ और प्रहस्त के पास जा और उसे घेर कर वे खड़े हो गए

25.sa: आवर्त इव सञ्जज्ञे उभयोः सेनयोस्तदा ।क्षुभितस्याप्रमेयस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः ।। ६.५८.२५ ।।।।
25.en: Then the sound of both armies was like an agitated, boundless ocean, whirling round and frightening.
25.hi: फिर अति घोर भेरी बजवा आर-रावण से आज्ञा ले, प्रहरत सजे हुए एक दिव्य रथ पर चढा

26.sa: महता हि शरौघेण प्रहस्तो युद्धकोविदः ।अर्दयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो वानरान् परमाहवे ।। ६.५८.२६ ।।।।
26.en: In that major conflict, highly furious Prahastha, an expert in war tormented the Vanaras with a stream of arrows.
26.hi: उस रथ में बड़े शीघ्रगामी घोडे जुते हुए थे ओर बड़ा चतुर रथवान उनको हाँकता था । जब वह रथ चलता था, तब बादलों की गड़गड़ाहट जैसा शब्द होता था। वह चन्द्र सूय की तरह प्रकाशमान था

27.sa: वानराणां शरीरैश्च राक्षसानां च मेदिनी ।बभूव निचिता घोरा पतितैरिव पर्वतैः ।। ६.५८.२७ ।।।।
27.en: The bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas strewn on the ground, seemed like mountains had fallen.
27.hi: रावणंप्रेच्य--स्वामितया प्रधानंरावणं श्रभिबन्धेत्यथः । (गो०) . ७ उसके ऊपर सर्पाकार ध्वजा फदरा रही थी, शके ऊपर के कलस सुन्दर थे | वह सुत्रणं से;भूषित।था अथवा उसमें सोने की जाली लगी हुई थी । वह अपने को देख अपनो सुन्दरता की शोभा से मानों आप हा हँस रहा था

28.sa: सा मही रुधिरौघेण प्रच्छन्ना सम्प्रकाशते ।सञ्छन्ना माधवे मासि पलाशैरिव पुष्पितैः ।। ६.५८.२८ ।।।।
28.en: That battlefield drenched with blood shone bright as though veiled with blossoms of Palasa in the month of Magha.
28.hi: ऐसे दिव्य रथ पर सवार हो और रावण को आज्ञा ले प्रहस्त बड़ी भारी राक्षसो सेता सहित तुरन्त लङ्का से निकला

29.sa: हतवीरौघवप्रां तु भग्नायुधमहाद्रुमाम् ।शोणितौघमहातोयां यमसागरगमिनीम् ।। ६.५८.२९ ।।।।
29.en: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.

30.sa: यकृत्प्लीहमहापङ्कां विनिकीर्णान्त्रशैवलाम् ।भिन्नकायशिरोमीनामङ्गावयवशाद्वलाम् ।। ६.५८.३० ।।।।
30.en: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.
30.hi: जिस समय प्रहस्त चला, उस समय शङ्क को ध्वनि सुत पड़ी । उसके आगे आगे गर्जते हुए राक्षस चल्ने

31.sa: गृध्रहंसगणाकीर्णां कङ्कसारससेविताम् ।मेदःफेनसमाकीर्णामार्तस्तनितनिस्वनाम् ।तां कापुरुषदुस्तारां युद्धभूमिमयीं नदीम् ।। ६.५८.३१ ।।।।
31.en: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.

32.sa: नदीमिव घनापाये हंससारससेविताम् ।राक्षसाः कपिमुख्याश्च तेरुस्तां दुस्तरां नदीम् ।। ६.५८.३२ ।।।।
32.en: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.
32.hi: भयङ्कर रूपधारी बड़े बढ़े डीलडोल के राक्षस प्रहत के आगे आगे चलते थे । नरान्तक, कुम्भइनु, महानाद, समुन्नत | ३१ झार चलते 7 "Tr UR पन य नज % पाठान्तरे“ सागरम्‌ । › ~ ¢ Q प्रहस्तसचिवा ह्य ते निर्ययुः परिषाय तम्‌ । व्यूढेनेव सुधोरेण पूवद्वारात्स निययौ ३२ ॥ ये प्रहस्त के सचिव थे और ये सब उसको चारों ओर से घेर कर जा रहे थे । घार व्यूह की रचना कर, प्रहस्त लङ्का के पूवेद्वार से बाहिर निकला

33.sa: यथा पद्मरजोध्वस्तां नलिनीं गजयूथपाः ।। ६.५८.३३ ।।।।
33.en: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.
33.hi: उस समय उसके साथ हाथियों के कुंड की तरह एक बड़ी भारी सेना थी | वह सागर को तरह अपार सेता से घिरा हुआ जा र्दा था

34.sa: ततः सृजन्तं बाणौघान् प्रहस्तं स्यन्दने स्थितम् ।ददर्श तरसा नीलो विनिघ्नन्तं प्लवङ्गमान् ।। ६.५८.३४ ।।।।
34.en: Further Nila saw Prahastha seated and trembling and discharging a volley of arrows with vehemence exterminating monkeys.
34.hi: समस्त लङ्कावासी जीव विकट स्वर से चिल्लाने लगे। मेघशून्य आकाश में उडते हुए रुधिर धोर माँसभोजी

35.sa: उद्धूत इव वायुः खे महदभ्रबलं बलात् ।समीक्ष्याभिद्रुतं युद्धे प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।रथेनादित्यवर्णेन नीलमेवाभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.५८.३५ ।।।।
35.en: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.

36.sa: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठो विकृष्य परमाहवे ।नीलाय व्यसृजद्बाणान् प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।। ६.५८.३६ ।।।।
36.en: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.

37.sa: ते प्राप्य विशिखा नीलं विनिर्भिद्य समाहिताः ।महीं जग्मुर्महावेगा रुषिता इव पन्नगाः ।। ६.५८.३७ ।।।।
37.en: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief of the army, supreme among wielders of bow, stretched his best bow and drew it and began to discharge arrows at Neela.
37.hi: आकाश से उल्कापात होने लगा--रूखी इवा भी चलने लगी । क्रुद्ध हो आपस में ग्रहों का युद्ध होने लगा । अतः समस्त ग्रह प्रभाहीन हो गए

38.sa: नीलः शरैरभिहतो निशितैर्ज्वलनोपमैः ।स तं परमदुर्धर्षमापतन्तं महाकपिः ।। ६.५८.३८ ।।।।
38.en: The arrows discharged by Prahastha, penetrated piercing into Nila's body at great speed like infuriated serpents and went straight into the earth.

39.sa: प्रहस्तं ताडयामास वृक्षमुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५८.३९ ।।।।
39.en: Great Vanara, a valiant one, Nila having been hit with arrows sharp as tongues of fire, struck Prahastha, who is most difficult to encounter and rushing towards him by uprooting a tree.

40.sa: स तेनाभिहतः क्रुद्धो नदन् राक्षसपुङ्गवः ।ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि प्लवङ्गानां चमूपतौ ।। ६.५८.४० ।।।।
40.en: Great Vanara, a valiant one, Nila having been hit with arrows sharp as tongues of fire, struck Prahastha, who is most difficult to encounter and rushing towards him by uprooting a tree.
40.hi: रणभूमि में अनेक बार गए हुए, अनेक युद्धो में सम्मिलित हो चुकने वाले, सूतङुल में उत्पन्न रथ हाँकनेबाले रथवान के हाथ से चाबुक गिर पड़ा

41.sa: तस्य बाणगणान् घोरान् राक्षसस्य महाबलः ।अपारयन् वारयितुं प्रत्यगृह्णान्निमीलितः ।। ६.५८.४१ ।।।।
41.en: Having been struck by Nila, the Rakshasa leader became furious, and began to roar and showered rain arrows on the monkeys.
41.hi: युद्धयात्रा करते समय प्रकाशमान और अष्टवसुओं के लिए भी दुलेभ जो श्री प्रहस्त की थी, वह थोड़ी ही देर में नष्ट हो गई और समतल भूमि में दौड़ते हए घोड़े गिर पड़े

42.sa: यथैव गोवृषो वर्षं शारदं शीघ्रमागतम् ।एवमेव प्रहस्तस्य शरवर्षं दुरासदम् ।निमीलिताक्षः सहसा नीलः सेहे सुदारुणम् ।। ६.५८.४२ ।।।।
42.en: Not able to check the volley of arrows released by the Rakshasa, Nila received them with closed eyes.
42.hi: प्रसिद्ध बल पौरुष बाले प्रहस्त वो निकलते देख, रणभूमि में वानरगण वृक्ष शिला आदि विविध प्रकार के आयुध ले, उससे लड़ने को तैयार हो गए

43.sa: रोषितः शरवर्षेण सालेन महता महान् ।प्रजघान हयान्नीलः प्रहस्तस्य मनोजवान् ।। ६.५८.४३ ।।।।
43.en: Just as a mighty bull faces sudden downpour of autumnal rain, in the same way Nila precisely tolerated the rain of arrows of Prahastha, which are difficult to face, with eyes closed.

44.sa: ततः स चापमुद्गृह्य प्रहस्तस्य महाबलः ।बभञ्ज तरसा नीलो ननाद च पुनःपुनः ।। ६.५८.४४ ।।।।
44.en: Neela endowed with great prowess, became angry (by the rain of arrows showered on him) and hurled a huge Sala tree at Prahastha.
44.hi: एक ओर राक्षस नाद्‌ कर रहे थे दूसरी ओर बानर गर्ज रहे थे ।राक्षसी और वानरी दोनों सेनाओं में हषे छाया हुआ था

45.sa: विधनुस्तु कृतस्तेन प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।प्रगृह्य मुसलं घोरं स्यन्दनादवपुप्लुवे ।। ६.५८.४५ ।।।।
45.en: Thereupon, Neela firmly holding the bow of mighty Prahastha broke it again and again and roared
45.hi: वसुदुलं भा-श्रष्टबसुदुलंभा | (गो ०) २ _आरुजठां-उन्मूलयतां । (गो०) अ ्् ये बलवान राक्षस और वेगवान वानर दोनो' ही एक दूसरे का नाश करने के लिए फुर्तीले और युद्ध करने में समर्थ तथा एक दूसरे का नाश करने की अभिलाषा रखने वाले योद्धा युद्ध करने के लिए एक दूसरे को ललकार रहे थे। अतः बड़ा भारी होहल्ला सुन पड़ता था

46.sa: तावुभौ वाहिनीमुख्यौ जातवैरौ तरस्विनौ ।स्थितौ क्षतजदिग्धाङ्गौ प्रभिन्नाविव कुञ्जरौ ।। ६.५८.४६ ।।।।
46.en: Deprived of bow and chariot, Prahastha, the CommanderinChief seizing a terrific mallet jumped down from the chariot.
46.hi: इति सप्तपञ्चाशः सगे: ॥ तदनन्तर राक्षसो सेना का सेनापति खोटी बुद्धि वाला ्रहस्त, युद्ध में विजय प्राप्त झरने की इच्छा से, प्रत्यन्त वेग से वानरो की सेना पर वैसे ही झपटा, जैसे अपने प्राण गँवाने के लिए पतंग दइकते हुए अग्नि पर झपटता है

47.sa: उल्लिखन्तौ सुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम् ।सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ ।। ६.५८.४७ ।।।।
47.en: Both Nila and Prahastha, deadly enemies, CommanderinChief of the armies, their limbs disfigured, wetted with blood, stood like elephants.

48.sa: विक्रान्तविजयौ वीरौ समरेष्वनिवर्तिनौ ।काङ्क्षमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुं वृत्रवासवयोः समौ ।। ६.५८.४८ ।।।।
48.en: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.

49.sa: आजघान तदा नीलं ललाटे मुसलेन सः ।प्रहस्तः परमायत्तस्तस्य सुस्राव शोणितम् ।। ६.५८.४९ ।।।।
49.en: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.

50.sa: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रगृह्य सुमहातरुम् ।प्रहस्तस्योरसि क्रुद्धो विससर्ज महाकपिः ।। ६.५८.५० ।।।।
50.en: Then Prahastha struck speedily with a mallet and hit Neela on the forehead and blood flowed from there.

51.sa: तमचिन्त्य प्रहारं स प्रगृह्य मुसलं महत् ।अभिदुद्राव बलिनं बलान्नीलं प्लवङ्गमम् ।। ६.५८.५१ ।।।।
51.en: Then drenched with blood, Neela was enraged and took hold of a huge tree and hurled at the chest of Prahastha.

52.sa: तमुग्रवेगं संरब्धमापतन्तं महाकपिः ।ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महावेगो महाशिलाम् ।। ६.५८.५२ ।।।।
52.en: He (Prahastha), not caring for the wound, taking a huge mallet went towards that courageous monkey (Neela).

53.sa: तस्य युद्धाभिकामस्य मृधे मुसलयोधिनः ।प्रहस्तस्य शिलां नीलो मूर्ध्नि तूर्णमपातयत् ।। ६.५८.५३ ।।।।
53.en: Then, seeing Prahastha waging and coming towards him, the great monkey, Neela, endowed with high speed threw a huge rock.

54.sa: सा तेन कपिमुख्येन विमुक्ता महती शिला ।बिभेद बहुधा घोरा प्रहस्तस्य शिरस्तदा ।। ६.५८.५४ ।।।।
54.en: Fighting with the mallet, Neela quickly dropped the rock on that Prahastha's forehead

55.sa: स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः ।पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ।। ६.५८.५५ ।।।।
55.en: Hurled by Neela, the foremost of monkeys, the huge rock broke the head of Prahastha into pieces.

56.sa: प्रभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् ।शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणं यथा ।। ६.५८.५६ ।।।।
56.en: Life, splendour, strength, and senses departed Prahastha fell instantly on the ground like a tree cut at the bottom.

57.sa: हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तदकम्प्यं महद्बलम् ।रक्षसामप्रहृष्टानां लङ्कामभिजगाम ह ।। ६.५८.५७ ।।।।
57.en: From his shattered head much blood flowed from all over the body just as a spring from a mountain.

58.sa: न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं निहते वाहिनीपतौ ।सेतुबन्धं समासाद्य विकीर्णं सलिलं यथा ।। ६.५८.५८ ।।।।
58.en: Prahastha having been killed by Neela, the cheerless Rakshasas and unshakeable troops could not stay there any more.

59.sa: हते तस्मिंश्चमूमुख्ये राक्षसास्ते निरुद्यमाः ।रक्षःपतिगृहं गत्वा ध्यानमूकत्वमास्थिताः ।प्राप्ताः शोकार्णवं तीव्रं निस्सञ्ज्ञा इव ते ऽभवन् ।। ६.५८.५९ ।।।।
59.en: The CommanderinChief having been killed the troops could not remain there just as water reached a breached dam.

60.sa: ततस्तु नीलो विजयी महाबलः प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा ।समेत्य रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन च प्रहृष्टरूपस्तु बभूव यूथपः ।। ६.५८.६० ।।
60.en: CommanderinChief killed, those Rakshasas reduced to speechlessness went to the abode of their Lord and remained without consciousness.

1.sa: तस्मिन् हते राक्षससैन्यपाले प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे ।भीमायुधं सागरतुल्यवेगं विदुद्रुवे राक्षसराजसैन्यम् ।। ६.५९.१ ।।।।
1.en: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.
1.hi: भीम पराक्रमी प्रहस्त को लङ्का से बाहिर निकलते देख, शत्र - हन्ता श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने मुसक्या कर विभीषण से कहा

2.sa: गत्वा ऽथ रक्षोधिपतेः शशंसुः सेनापतिं पावकसूनुशस्तम् ।तच्चापि तेषां वचनं निशम्य रक्षोधिपः क्रोधवशं जगाम ।। ६.५९.२ ।।।।
2.en: Having gone to the king of Rakshasas, the survivors said, "Prahastha is killed by the son of fire god." Thereafter, the king of Rakshasas fell prey to anger.
2.hi: हे महाबाहो ! मुझे बतलाओ यह वीर्यंबान और बड़े डील- डौल बाला कौन निशाचर है,जिसके साथ बड़ी विशाल सेना है

3.sa: सङ्ख्ये प्रहस्तं निहतं निशम्य शोकार्दितः क्रोधपरीतचेताः ।उवाच तान्नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यानिन्द्रो यथा चामरयोधमुख्यान् ।। ६.५९.३ ।।।।
3.en: Even as Rakshasas revealed about Prahastha's death, tormented by grief and anger Ravana spoke to Rakshasa troops just as Indra spoke to celestial troops.
3.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ये वचन सुन उत्तर में विभीपण ने कहा-- यह रावण का सेनापति हे । इस राक्षस का नाम प्रहस्त हे

4.sa: नावज्ञा रिपवे कार्या यैरिन्द्रबलसूदनः ।सूदितः सैन्यपालो मे सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ।। ६.५९.४ ।।।।
4.en: "No low opinion to be entertained with regard to an enemy by whom my commander in chief of the army was killed, who is capable of killing the army of Indra with his followers and elephants."
4.hi: लङ्का में रावण के अधीन जितनी सेना है, उसमें से एक तिहाई सेना इसके अधीन है। यह असरों का चलाना जानता है और एक प्रसिद्ध पराक्रमी हे

5.sa: सो ऽहं रिपुविनाशाय विजयायाविचारयन् ।स्वयमेव गमिष्यामि रणशीर्षं तदद्भुतम् ।। ६.५९.५ ।।।।
5.en: "I shall go myself without thinking to that wonderful battle scene and put an end to the enemy and succeed."

6.sa: अद्य तद्वानरानीकं रामं च सहलक्ष्मणम् ।निर्दहिष्यामि वाणौघैर्वनं दीप्तैरिवाग्निभिः ।। ६.५९.६ ।।।।
6.en: "Now I will go and burn up that army of Vanaras along with Lakshmana and Rama with the stream of my arrows just as forest fire without the use of fire."
6.hi: उसने वानरों की बड़ी बलवान सेना को देखा, जो उसे ( प्रहस्त को ) देख अत्यन्त कुपित हो गजे रही थी

7.sa: स एवमुक्त्वा ज्वलनप्रकाशं रथं तुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् ।प्रकाशमानं वपुषा ज्वलन्तं समारुरोहामरराजशत्रुः ।। ६.५९.७ ।।।।
7.en: Ravana, the enemy of the king of Devatas, having spoken like that ascended a chariot yoked to the best of horses, shining by virtue of its form (golden) and luminous like fire.
7.hi: % एक संस्करण में इसके पूर्व यह और है--“ग्रागच्छुति महावेगः किंरूपबलपौरुषः |? छ € रै खङ्गशक्त्यष्टियाणाशच शूलानि मुसलानि च | गदाश्च परिघाः प्रासा विविधाश्च परश्वधाः

8.sa: स शङ्खभैरीपणवप्रणादैरास्फोटितक्ष्वेलितसिंहनादैः ।पुण्यैः स्तवैश्चाप्यभिपूज्यमानस्तदा ययौ राक्षसराजमुख्यः ।। ६.५९.८ ।।।।
8.en: As the foremost king of the Rakshasas went forth, a blast of sounds of conchs, beat of drums and clapping of arms and the roaring sounds followed by the chanting of auspicious verses sung by the Rakshasas eulogizing and honouring the king highly.

9.sa: स शैलजीमूतनिकाशरूपैर्मांसादनैः पावकदीप्तनेत्रेः ।बभौ वृतो राक्षसराजमुख्यो भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवासुरेशः ।। ६.५९.९ ।।।।
9.en: The Rakshasa king surrounded by Rakshasas who resembled mountains and clouds in form seemed like Rudra surrounded by asuras.

10.sa: ततो नगर्याः सहसा महौजा निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् ।महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितं ददर्शं समुद्यतं पादपशैलहस्तम् ।। ६.५९.१० ।।।।
10.en: Thereafter, Ravana possessed with great splendour stopped at the city and saw the army of Vanaras collected together looking like an ocean of clouds wielding trees and rocks.
10.hi: परस्पर दोनों सेनाएँ जब भिड़ गई ; तब बड़ा बिकट युद्ध हुआ । दोनों ही ओर के योद्धा, एक दूसरे के ऊपर शिलां और बार्णो की वर्षा करने लगे

11.sa: तद्राक्षसानीकमतिप्रचण्डमालोक्य रामो भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः ।विभीषणं शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठमुवाच सेनानुगतः पृथुश्रीः ।। ६.५९.११ ।।।।
11.en: Rama, whose arms were like the king of serpents, shining with splendour, followed by army, seeing the army of Rakshasas exceedingly furious, spoke to Vibheeshana the foremost of the wielder of weapons.

12.sa: नानापताकाध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टं प्रासासिशूलायुधशस्त्रजुष्टम् ।सैन्यं गजेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टं कस्येदमक्षोभ्यमभीरुजुष्टम् ।। ६.५९.१२ ।।।।
12.en: "Under whose command is this unshakeable army with several kinds of flags, posts and weapons armed with missiles, tridents, swords spikes and darts, with elephants the size of Mahendra mountain"

13.sa: ततस्तु रामस्य निशम्य वाक्यं विभीषणः शक्रसमानवीर्यः ।शशंस रामस्य बलप्रवेकं महात्मनां राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् ।। ६.५९.१३ ।।।।
13.en: Thereupon, Vibheeshana, equal to Indra in valour, on hearing the great soul Rama, revealed about the Rakshasa army endowed with great strength.

14.sa: यो ऽसौ गजस्कन्धगतो महात्मा नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः ।प्रकम्पयन्नागशिरो ऽभ्युपैति ह्यकम्पनं त्वेनमवेहि राजन् ।। ६.५९.१४ ।।।।
14.en: "O King! the one seated on the elephant, by whose weight the elephant head is shaking, whose coppery face is like the rising sun, a gigantic one is Akampana."

15.sa: यो ऽसौ रथस्थो मृगराजकेतुर्धून्वन् धनुः शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् ।करीव भात्युग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः स इन्द्रजिन्नाम वरप्रधानः ।। ६.५९.१५ ।।।।
15.en: "The one on the chariot, distinguished by the sign of a lion, and making sound with his bow, splendid as Indra's bow with terrific teeth projected forward looks like an elephant, eminent by virtue of the boons bestowed is Indrajith by name."

16.sa: यश्चैष विन्ध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पो धन्वी रथस्थो ऽतिरथो ऽतिवीरः ।विस्फारयंश्चापमतुल्यमानं नाम्ना ऽतिकायो ऽतिविवृद्धकायः ।। ६.५९.१६ ।।।।
16.en: "He who resembles Vindhya Mountain in the west (where the sun sets) and the Mahendra mountain (in size) seated on the chariot, is a great chariotwarrior, a hero unequalled in size, wielding a bow whose body is grown out of size, who is coming in sight is by name Atikaya."

17.sa: यो ऽसौ नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुरारुह्य घण्टानिनदप्रणादम् ।गजं खरं गर्जति वै महात्मा महोदरो नाम स एष वीरः ।। ६.५९.१७ ।।।।
17.en: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."

18.sa: यो ऽसौ हयं काञ्चनचित्रभाण्डमारुह्य सन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् ।प्रासं समुद्यम्य मरीचिनद्धं पिशाच एषो ऽशनितुल्यवेगः ।। ६.५९.१८ ।।।।
18.en: "He who is mounted on horses decorated with gold shining, like a mountain crowned with cloud, radiant as the Sun holding the shining yokes coming at high speed is by name Pisacha."

19.sa: यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य विद्युत्प्रभं किङ्करवज्रवेगम् ।वृषेन्द्रमास्थाय गिरिप्रकाशमायाति यो ऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी ।। ६.५९.१९ ।।।।
19.en: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."

20.sa: असौ च जीमूतनिकाशरूपः कुम्भः पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः ।समाहितः पन्नगराजकेतुर्विस्फारयन् भाति धनुर्विधून्वन् ।। ६.५९.२० ।।।।
20.en: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."

21.sa: यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं दीप्तं सधूमं परिघं प्रगृह्य ।आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतस्त्वसौ निकुम्भो ऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा ।। ६.५९.२१ ।।।।
21.en: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."

22.sa: यश्चैष चापासिशरौघजुष्टं पताकिनं पावकदीप्तरूपम् ।रथं समास्थाय विभात्युदग्रो नरान्तको ऽसौ नगशृङ्गयोधी ।। ६.५९.२२ ।।।।
22.en: Again, comes Naranthaka, with multitude of swords and arrows, mounted on top of a chariot with flags, blazing like fire, who fights with mountain peaks.

23.sa: यश्चैष नानाविधघोररूपैर्व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्त्रैः ।भूतैर्वृतो भाति विवृत्तनेत्रैः सो ऽसौ सुराणामपि दर्पहन्ता ।। ६.५९.२३ ।।।।
23.en: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

24.sa: यत्रैतदिन्दुप्रतिमं विभाति च्छत्रं सितं सूक्ष्मशलाकमग्र्यम् ।अत्रैष रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवावभाति ।। ६.५९.२४ ।।।।
24.en: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

25.sa: असौ किरीटी चलुकुण्डलास्यो नगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः ।महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता रक्षोधिपः सूर्य इवावभाति ।। ६.५९.२५ ।।।।
25.en: "There is the king of Rakshasas shining like Sun, whose countenance shines with hanging earrings, of terrible form like the Himalayas and Vindhya, who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama."

26.sa: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमम् ।अहो दीप्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ६.५९.२६ ।।।।
26.en: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."

27.sa: आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्षो रश्मिभिर्भाति रावणः ।सुव्यक्तं लक्षये ह्यस्य रूपं तेजस्समावृतम् ।। ६.५९.२७ ।।।।
27.en: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."

28.sa: देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत् ।यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतत् प्रकाशते ।। ६.५९.२८ ।।।।
28.en: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.

29.sa: सर्वे पर्वतसङ्काशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः ।सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधाश्चास्य महौजसः ।। ६.५९.२९ ।।।।
29.en: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."

30.sa: भाति राक्षसराजो ऽसौ प्रदीप्तैर्भीमविक्रमैः ।भूतैः परिवृतस्तीक्ष्णैर्देहवद्भिरिवान्तकः ।। ६.५९.३० ।।।।
30.en: "The Rakshasa king is surrounded by sharp, furious beings of terrible valour shining like the god of death."

31.sa: दिष्ट्या ऽयमद्य पापात्मा मम दृष्टिपथं गतः ।अद्य क्रोधं विमोक्ष्यामि सीताहरणसम्भवम् ।। ६.५९.३१ ।।।।
31.en: "By his good luck, this sinful one has come under my sight. I will give vent to my wrath born of Sita's abduction."

32.sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ।लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम् ।। ६.५९.३२ ।।।।
32.en: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.

33.sa: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि ।द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः ।। ६.५९.३३ ।।।।
33.en: There upon the great soul, the king of Rakshasas thus spoke to the strong army of Rakshasas, "Fully complacent, free from any apprehension be stationed at the gates and the buildings of the four main streets."

34.sa: इहागतं मां सहितं भवद्भिर्वनौकसश्छिद्रमिदं विदित्वा ।शून्यां पुरीं दुष्प्रसहां प्रमथ्य प्रधर्षयेयुः सहसा समेताः ।। ६.५९.३४ ।।।।
34.en: "Coming to know that I am here with you, this side, considering it to be a weak point, the forest dwellers may enter the vacant city and Devastate all united."

35.sa: विसर्जयित्वा सहितांस्ततस्तान् गतेषु रक्षस्सु यथानियोगम् ।व्यदारयद्वानरसागरौघं महाझषः पूर्णमिवार्णवौघम् ।। ६.५९.३५ ।।।।
35.en: After the counsellors departed from there Ravana pierced through the ocean of Vanaras just as gigantic fish would pierce in the sea.

36.sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।महत् समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं दुद्राव रक्षोधिपतिं हरीशः ।। ६.५९.३६ ।।।।
36.en: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.

37.sa: तच्छैलशृङ्गं बहुवृक्षसानुं प्रगृह्य चिक्षेप निशाचराय ।तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य बिभेद बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.३७ ।।।।
37.en: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.

38.sa: तस्मिन् प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम् ।महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः ।। ६.५९.३८ ।।।।
38.en: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.

39.sa: स तं गृहीत्वा ऽनिलतुल्यवेगं सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् ।बाणं महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगं चिक्षेप सुग्रीववधाय रुष्टः ।। ६.५९.३९ ।।।।
39.en: Seizing an arrow which shone like sparks of fire and had the speed of wind, nay vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, he (Ravana) released an arrow in anger.

40.sa: स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः शक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुः शिताग्रः ।सुग्रीवमासाद्य बिभेद वेगाद् गुहेरिता क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्तिः ।। ६.५९.४० ।।।।
40.en: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.

41.sa: स सायकार्तो विपरीतचेताः कूजन् पृथिव्यां निपपात वीरः ।तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसञ्ज्ञं नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः ।। ६.५९.४१ ।।।।
41.en: That hero (Sugriva) hurt by the arrow lost senses and fell on the ground groaning in the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas shouted joyfully overtaken by evil spirits.

42.sa: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्रस्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नभश्च ।शैलान् समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।। ६.५९.४२ ।।।।
42.en: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.

43.sa: तेषां प्रहारान् स चकार मोघान् रक्षोधिपो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः ।तान् वानरेन्द्रानपि बाणजालैर्बिभेद जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.४३ ।।।।
43.en: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.

44.sa: ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणैर्भिन्ना विपेतुर्भुवि भीमकायाः ।ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः ।। ६.५९.४४ ।।।।
44.en: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.

45.sa: ते वध्यमानाः पतिताः प्रवीरा नानद्यमाना भयशल्यविद्धाः ।शाखामृगा रावणसायकार्ता जग्मुः शरण्यं शरणं स्म रामम् ।। ६.५९.४५ ।।।।
45.en: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.

46.sa: ततो महात्मा स धनुर्धनुष्मानादाय रामः सहसा जगाम ।तं लक्ष्मणः प्राञ्जलिरभ्युपेत्य उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थयुक्तम् ।। ६.५९.४६ ।।।।
46.en: The great soul Rama who was holding a bow went seizing it. Lakshmana approached him immediately with folded hands and addressed Rama with words consonant with truth.

47.sa: काममार्यः सुपर्याप्तो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः ।विधमिष्याम्यहं नीचमनुजानीहि मां प्रभो ।। ६.५९.४७ ।।।।
47.en: "I will exterminate the evil minded Ravana. Oh! noble brother, may I be permitted to complete the task"

48.sa: तमब्रवीन्महतेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।। ६.५९.४८ ।।।।
48.en: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."

49.sa: गच्छ यत्नपरश्चापि भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे ।रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणे ऽद्भुतपराक्रमः ।त्रैलोक्येनापि सङ्क्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः ।। ६.५९.४९ ।।।।
49.en: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."

50.sa: तस्य च्छिद्राणि मार्गस्व स्वच्छिद्राणि च लक्षय ।चक्षुषा धनुषा यत्नाद्रक्षात्मानं समाहितः ।। ६.५९.५० ।।।।
50.en: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."

51.sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा परिष्वज्याभिपूज्य च ।अभिवाद्य ततो रामं ययौ सौमित्रिराहवम् ।। ६.५९.५१ ।।।।
51.en: On hearing Raghava's words, son of Sumitra embraced him and offered prayers, paying respects sallied forth for the encounter.

52.sa: स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहुर्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम् ।प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालैस्तान् वानरान् भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ।। ६.५९.५२ ।।।।
52.en: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.

53.sa: तमालोक्य महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।निवार्य शरजालानि प्रदुर्द्राव स रावणम् ।। ६.५९.५३ ।।।।
53.en: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.

54.sa: रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।त्रासयन् रावणं धीमान् हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.५४ ।।।।
54.en: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.

55.sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सह राक्षसैः ।अवध्यत्वं त्वया प्राप्तं वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम् ।। ६.५९.५५ ।।।।
55.en: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."

56.sa: एष मे दक्षिणो बाहुः पञ्चशाखः समुद्यतः ।विधमिष्यति ते देहाद्भूतात्मानं चिरोषितम् ।। ६.५९.५६ ।।।।
56.en: "I raised this right arm that way with five branches (five fingers) at you that will expel your subtle self (made up of the five subtle elements) from your body."

57.sa: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः ।संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.५७ ।।।।
57.en: Ravana of truly fierce valour, hearing Hanuman's words, his eyes became blood red and spoke to Hanuman this way.

58.sa: क्षिप्रं प्रहर निश्शङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि ।ततस्त्वां ज्ञातविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर ।। ६.५९.५८ ।।।।
58.en: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."

59.sa: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वायुसूनुर्वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।प्रहृतं हि मया पूर्वमक्षं स्मर सुतं तव ।। ६.५९.५९ ।।।।
59.en: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."

60.sa: एवमुक्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।आजघानानिलसुतं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५९.६० ।।।।
60.en: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.

61.sa: स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः ।स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तेजस्वी स्थैर्यं कृत्वा महामतिः ।आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ।। ६.५९.६१ ।।।।
61.en: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.

62.sa: ततस्तलेनाभिहतो वानरेण महात्मना ।दशग्रीवः समाधूतो यथा भूमिचले ऽचलः ।। ६.५९.६२ ।।तिः ।।।
62.en: Thereupon, struck by the great soul, Vanara, the ten headed Ravana was shaken like the earthquake on the mountain together.

63.sa: सङ्ग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्वा रावणं तलताडितम् ।ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुरैः ।। ६.५९.६३ ।।।।
63.en: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.

64.en: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"

65.sa: साधु वानर वीर्येण श्लाघनीयो ऽसि मे रिपुः ।रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु मारुतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.६५ ।।।।
65.en: Ravana having spoken in that way, Maruti said "Oh Ravana! What a shame on my valour, you survived."

66.sa: धिगस्तु मम वीर्येण यस्त्वं जीवसि रावण ।सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे ।ततस्त्वां मामिका मुष्टिर्नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ।। ६.५९.६६ ।।।।
66.en: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."

67.sa: ततो मारुतिवाक्येन क्रोदस्तस्य तदा ऽज्वलत् ।। ६.५९.६७ ।।दानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे ।संरक्तनयनो यत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।पातयामास वेगेन वानरोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५९.६८ ।।।।
67.en: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

68.en: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

69.sa: विह्वलं तु तदा दृष्ट्वा हनुमन्तं महाबलम् ।रथेनातिरथः शीघ्रं नीलं प्रति समभ्यगात् ।। ६.५९.७० ।।।।
69.en: Hit on his chest, Hanuman got hurt again and reeled. Seeing Hanuman's power, overcome with fear, the best charioteer Ravana drove quickly towards Neela.

70.en: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

71.sa: स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलः कपिचमूपतिः ।करेणैकेन शेलाग्रं रक्षोधिपतये ऽसृजत् ।। ६.५९.७२ ।।।।
71.en: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

72.sa: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी समाश्वस्तो महामनाः ।विप्रेक्षमाणो युद्धेप्सुः सरोषमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.७३ ।।।।
72.en: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.

73.sa: नीलेन सह संयुक्तं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।अन्येन युद्ध्यमानस्य न युक्तमभिधावनम् ।। ६.५९.७४ ।।।।
73.en: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

74.sa: रावणो ऽपि महातेजास्तच्छृङ्गं सप्तभिः शरैः ।आजघान सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैस्तद्विकीर्णं पपात ह ।। ६.५९.७५ ।।।।
74.en: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

75.sa: तद्विकीर्णं गिरेः शृङ्गं दृष्ट्वा हरिचमूपतिः ।कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल क्रोधोन परवीरहा ।। ६.५९.७६ ।।।।
75.en: Ravana, endowed with extraordinary energy attacked that peak hurled by Neela with seven sharp arrows and it fell broken into pieces.

76.sa: सो ऽश्वकर्णान् धवान् सालांश्चूतांश्चापि सुपुष्पितान् ।अन्यांश्च विविधान् वृक्षान्नीलश्चिक्षेप संयुगे ।। ६.५९.७७ ।।।।
76.en: On seeing the crushed peak, Neela, the killer of stupendous foes, shone like fire at universal destruction in anger.

77.sa: स तान् वृक्षान् समासाद्य प्रतिचिच्छेद रावणः ।अभ्यवर्षत् सुघोरेण शरवर्षेण पावकिम् ।। ६.५९.७८ ।।।।
77.en: In the battle Neela hurled Aswakarana, Sala and Mango trees in good bloom and several other trees at Ravana.

78.sa: अभिवृष्टः शरौघेण मेघेनेव महाचलः ।ह्रस्वं कृत्वा तदा रूपं ध्वजाग्रे निपपात ह ।। ६.५९.७९ ।।।।
78.en: Ravana broke those trees in return and showered rain of formidable arrows at Neela.

79.sa: पावकात्मजमालोक्य ध्वजाग्रे समुपस्थितम् ।जज्वाल रावणः क्रोधात्ततो नीलो ननाद च ।। ६.५९.८० ।।।।
79.en: When Neela was covered by Ravana's arrows, it was just as clouds cover mountain peaks. Neela reduced his size and landed on top of Ravana's bow.

80.sa: ध्वजाग्रे धनुषश्चाग्रे किरीटाग्रे च तं हरिम् ।लक्ष्मणो ऽथ हनूमांश्च दृष्ट्वा रामश्च विस्मिताः ।। ६.५९.८१ ।।।।
80.en: Neela stood on top of the post of the bow of Ravana. On seeing that Ravana was burning in anger while Neela roared.

81.en: Then, when Ravana was unable to release the arrow from the bow on Neela, who was shifting from the top of the post to the crown. Seeing that Lakshmana, Rama and Hanuman were amazed.

82.sa: ततस्ते चुक्रुशुर्हृष्टा लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमाहवे ।। ६.५९.८३ ।।।।
82.en: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.

83.sa: वानराणां च नादेन संरब्धो रावणस्तदा ।सम्भ्रमाविष्टहृदयो न किञ्चित् प्रत्यपद्यत ।। ६.५९.८४ ।।।।
83.en: Thereafter, seeing Neela's feat in the war, Ravana was agitated and the Vanaras were cheerful for having achieved their wish and shouted in joy.

84.sa: आग्नेयेनाथ संयुक्तं गृहीत्वा रावणः शरम् ।ध्वजशीर्षस्थितं नीलमुदैक्षत निशाचरः ।ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ६.५९.८५ ।।।।
84.en: Provoked by the clamour of the vanaras, Ravana's heart was full of anger and did not know what to do.

85.sa: कपे लाघवयुक्तो ऽसि मायया परया ऽनया ।जीवितं खलु रक्षस्व यदि शक्तो ऽसि वानर ।। ६.५९.८६ ।।।।
85.en: And then the night ranger Ravana taking up, fitting the arrow charged with fire, looked at Neela resting on top of the bow.

86.en: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy said, "Oh monkey, you are unfair, very tricky and further deceptive."

87.sa: तथापि त्वां मया युक्तः सायको ऽस्त्रप्रयोजितः ।जीवतं परिरक्षन्तं जीविताद् भ्रंशयिष्यति ।। ६.५९.८८ ।।।।
87.en: "Oh monkey! You are taking different forms and doing different deeds. If you have the ability, save your life."

88.sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहू रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।सन्धाय बाणमस्त्रेण चमूपतिमताडयत् ।। ६.५९.८९ ।।।।
88.en: "The arrow released by me now is charged with a missile and will destroy your life. You have been protecting (changing your forms) your life."

89.sa: सो ऽस्त्रयुक्तेन बाणेन नीलो वक्षसि ताडितः ।निर्दह्यमानः सहसा निपपात महीतले ।। ६.५९.९० ।।।।
89.en: Speaking like that, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas chanting the mantras and fixing the arrow struck the commander in chief (Neela) of the Vanara army.

90.en: Struck by the arrow propelled by the missile (of Ravana) on the chest, Neela fell on the ground.

91.sa: विसञ्ज्ञं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः ।रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.५९.९२ ।।।।
91.en: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.

92.sa: आसाद्य रणमध्ये तु वारयित्वा स्थितो ज्वलन् ।धनुर्विस्फारयामास कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.५९.९३ ।।।।
92.en: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.

93.sa: तमाह सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो विस्फारयन्तं धनुरप्रमेयम् ।अभ्येहि मामेव निशाचरेन्द्र न वानरांस्त्वं प्रतियोद्धुमर्हः ।। ६.५९.९४ ।।।।
93.en: In the midst of the battlefield stood Ravana, intercepting with his glowing bow making loud sounds as though shaking the earth.

94.sa: स तस्य वाक्यं प्रतिपूर्णघोषं ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा ।आसाद्य सौमित्रिमवस्थितं तं कोपान्वितो वाक्यमुवाच रक्षः ।। ६.५९.९५ ।।।।
94.en: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."

95.sa: दिष्ट्या ऽसि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं प्राप्तो ऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः ।अस्मिन् क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः ।। ६.५९.९६ ।।।।
95.en: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.

96.sa: तमाह सौमित्रिरविस्मयानो गर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् ।राजन्न गर्जन्ति महाप्रभावा विकत्थसे पापकृतां वरिष्ठ ।। ६.५९.९७ ।।।।
96.en: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."

97.sa: जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च ।अवस्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिरागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन ।। ६.५९.९८ ।।।।
97.en: Saumithri, not surprised at the screaming of Ravana with his projected teeth, said, "You are great in sinful action. People of great valour do not display such bluster. Do not shout like that."

98.sa: स एवमुक्तः कुपितः ससर्ज रक्षोधिपः सप्त शरान् सुपुङ्खान् ।तान् लक्ष्मणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खैश्चिच्छेद बाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः ।। ६.५९.९९ ।।।।
98.en: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"

99.sa: तान् प्रेक्षमाणः सहसा निकृत्तान्निकृत्तभोगानिव पन्नगेन्द्रान् ।लङ्केश्वरः क्रोधवशं जगाम ससर्ज चान्यान्निशितान् पृषत्कान् ।। ६.५९.१०० ।।।।
99.en: Lakshmana, having spoken in that manner, the Lord of Rakshasas released seven arrows with beautiful plumes. Lakshmana tore them into pieces with sharp pointed and sharpheaded arrows with gold shafts.

100.sa: स बाणवर्षं तु ववर्ष तीव्रं रामानुजः कार्मुकसम्प्रयुक्तम् ।क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः शरांश्च चिच्छेद न चुक्षुभे च ।। ६.५९.१०१ ।।।।
100.en: Seeing the arrows cut down with force broken pieces like coils of serpents, the Lord of Lanka overtaken by anger let go another sharp arrow.

101.sa: स बाणजालान्यथ तानि तानि मोघानि पश्यं स्त्रिदशारिराजः ।विसिष्मिये लक्ष्मणलाघवेन पुनश्च बाणान्निशितान् मुमोच ।। ६.५९.१०२ ।।।।
101.en: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.

102.sa: स लक्ष्मणश्चाशु शरान् शिताग्रान् महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगान् ।सन्धाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशान् ससर्ज रक्षोधिपतेर्वधाय ।। ६.५९.१०३ ।।।।
102.en: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.

103.sa: स तान् प्रचिच्छेद हि राक्षसेन्द्रश्छित्त्वा च ताँल्लक्ष्मणमाजघान ।शरेण कालाग्निसमप्रभेण स्वयम्भुदत्तेन ललाटदेशे ।। ६.५९.१०४ ।।।।
103.en: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.

104.sa: स लक्ष्मणो रावणसायकार्तश्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य ।पुनश्च सञ्ज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्राच्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः ।। ६.५९.१०५ ।।।।
104.en: The Rakshasa king broke into pieces those arrows of Lakshmana and struck him on the forehead with the arrow gifted to him by Brahma, that was bright like the fire at the time of universal destruction.
